other.summary_zh: TIPSv2（Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness）是一系列以對比式學習訓練的視覺—語言模型，針對一般對比式預訓練產生的影像特徵缺乏空間結構、難以直接支援密集預測任務的問題，提出強調空間感知的預訓練方式。TIPSv2 的影像特徵除了保有與文字嵌入（text embedding）的對齊能力，也蘊含更豐富的空間資訊，因此可直接應用於零樣本分割（zero-shot segmentation）等下游任務。本頁收錄 SO400m/14 變體：視覺端約 412M 參數、文字端約 448M 參數、嵌入維度 1152，並搭配 SO400m/14-dpt 的 DPT 頭部以輸出空間特徵；整個系列另含 B/14、L/14 與 g/14 等規模，嵌入維度介於 768 至 1536，可依運算資源與應用需求選用。官方在模型卡中提供 transformers、torch、torchvision 等套件的程式碼範例，並有 GitHub 專案收錄更多用法與視覺化展示，降低研究者上手門檻。需要留意的是，此頁面僅為摘要層級資訊，並未呈現完整的基準測試數字、訓練資料組成或消融實驗結果，其相較於 CLIP、SigLIP 等既有模型的具體優劣，仍須查閱原始論文才能確認。整體而言，TIPSv2 展示了將空間感知融入對比式預訓練的可行性，對需要同時處理影像分類、分割與定位的應用場景具有實用參考價值。

Appendix B.1.1 Table 6: evaluation splits are small (Airline 20, Retail 40, Telecom 40 tasks); B.4.2 Tables 14-16 report per-example SEs up to ~0.09 on accuracy.

§7.3 Table 23 and B.4.2 Table 21: mechanism ablations show one-shot sampling, static constraint injection, and EvoPrompt-GA all fail feasibility; β=4 is the only tested dual learning rate feasible in both Airline and Telecom.
Appendix B.3.5 Table 12: frozen Telecom-trained rewriter lowers ToolEx in target domains but 'does not achieve feasibility without target-domain adaptation'—honest negative transfer result.

Appendix B.2.1 Table 7 and B.2.3 Table 8: full hyperparameters, per-round complexity accounting, and compute setup are documented; prompts listed in Appendix C, but no public code repository is claimed.
§7.3 and Appendix B.3.5 Table 10: SWE-bench Lite case study—all methods resolve 5/30 issues; CAPO only reduces patch size (1.055), tool actions (0.371), and files touched (1.300) below thresholds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent deployment: constraint-aware system-prompt optimization (primal-dual with per-constraint multipliers) plus a GRPO-trained rewriter (DCAPO) with frozen task agents. Directly matches top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, prompting, RL/GRPO, safety constraints) with a SWE-bench coding-agent case study. Novelty is moderate: the machinery is standard constrained RL/Lagrangian optimization transplanted to discrete prompt search; the pool-based dual-conditioned rewriter and the surrogate error analysis are the freshest pieces. Rigor is solid—formal assumptions with proofs, mechanism ablations, noise/dual-rate sensitivity, and honest negative results (Appendix B.3.5 transfer failure)—but main evaluations are single-run with small eval sets (20-40 tasks per tau2 domain per Appendix Table 6), the theory rests on strong concavity assumptions only loosely verified (B.4.3 positive inner products), and the editor-size ablation is self-described as 'descriptive best-observed' not controlled. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (feasible 6/6 GPT-5-mini/GPT-5.1 settings vs at most 1/6 for baselines in Table 1), but feasibility is a coarse binary criterion with occasional thin margins and β=4 is the only feasible tested dual rate (Table 21), suggesting fragility. Generalizability is genuinely broad across models and task families; reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters/thresholds/prompts (Appendix B.2, C) but no code release is claimed and much depends on proprietary API models.

primary_link.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization)
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM agent 的部署問題：agent 即使完成任務，仍可能過度呼叫工具、系統提示過長或違反安全與格式政策。作者將系統提示詞最佳化形式化為具明確門檻的約束問題，提出 CAPO，一種原始—對偶（primal–dual）搜尋法：為每個限制維護非負乘數，依帶符號的實測殘差動態更新（違規時提高權重、有餘裕時降低），並以提示池保留優良候選，用凍結的 LLM 作為改寫器迭代搜尋，輸出仍為文字系統提示。進一步提出 DCAPO，以 pool-based GRPO 訓練依回饋與對偶狀態條件化的可學習改寫器，同時凍結任務 agent。理論部分於連續替代空間刻劃有限提示池與離散改寫誤差如何進入不精確原始—對偶界。實驗在 tau2-bench（Airline、Retail、Telecom）顯示 CAPO 於三個領域與兩種任務模型共六種組合皆達 AllSat 可行，而初始提示、APO、GEPA 各僅一種、MOPO 為零種；chatbot 與 PUPA–IFBench 證明方法可延伸至安全、隱私與格式限制，開放權重 Ministral-8B 與 SWE-bench Lite 程式撰寫 agent 案例亦支持此結論。DCAPO 在三個 agent 領域皆產出可行提示，準確率與基準相符或更佳；消融顯示線上行為回饋提供單靠編輯模仿所缺的資訊。限制包括僅調整系統提示、對雜訊回饋敏感（Airline 與 Telecom 在雜訊下違反門檻）、AllSat 僅為經驗性指標而非母體保證，且更廣泛領域與跨域轉移尚待驗證。其意義在於讓部署需求本身成為引導搜尋的回饋訊號，而非事後檢核。
papers.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: CAPO：LLM Agent 的限制感知提示詞最佳化

Section 4.1, Table 2: renamed closed-book, 66/70 trials across seven model families pass the identical 24/79 tests with pairwise Jaccard 1.000
Section 4.3 and Appendices I-J: fault-injection sweeps show zero-deviation linear damage (32→24→16→8→0 tests) across nine cells, n=6 per cell

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research on coding agents, context vs parametric-memory substitution, and harness design — squarely within high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Code & Programming 2.0, Long Context & Memory 1.8). The working-set/coupled-fact framing with edit-time fault injection is a genuinely fresh causal take compared to the post-hoc trajectory classifiers it cites (Section 7). Rigor is unusually high: pre-specified predictions, evidence tiers separating confirmatory from exploratory n=3-12 cells, Wilson/bootstrap intervals, sandbox leakage controls with excluded earlier policies, a 1,089-run estimator enumeration (Appendix C), a withdrawn earlier result (Section 5), and honest nulls (SWE-bench AUC 0.49). Quantitative evidence is clean but rests on hand-authored synthetic workloads with marker evaluators, small per-cell n, and ceiling arms that only bound distance effects (Section 4.2). Strong artifact release with recompute lists and environment details supports reproducibility.

primary_link.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks

papers.summary: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels
papers.summary_zh: 儲存庫規模的程式修改,要求 coding agent 在有限脈絡視窗內維持測試、匯入、設定與遷移規則的一致性。本文將此建模為重建「耦合事實圖」:每次編輯所需的事實須來自近期脈絡或模型的參數記憶,兩者皆未涵蓋者即構成「連貫性債務」(coherence debt)。研究團隊分別供給與抽離兩個通道並注入錯誤,跨七個模型與五種 harness 進行實驗,涵蓋虛構 API 遷移的閉卷測試、前置供給條件、真實 Pydantic v1→v2 遷移及其改名對照版,以及自行建構耦合的合成任務。結果顯示:兩通道皆空時,154 次閉卷試驗全數 0/12;把事實放進提示詞後,300 次中 299 次達到至少 9/12。記住同一函式庫的七個模型,在改名遷移上於相同處失敗、通過完全相同的 24/79 個測試。成敗取決於事實是否存在而非距離:供給的事實遠在 128,000 字元外仍同樣有效;抽離幾個事實便恰損失其對應的工作,損害呈線性。同樣全數通過測試的各種 harness 設定,累積 token 消耗相差達 12.8 倍,且事實被抽離時多花費也換不回成效。缺少事實時,代理多半虛構檔案或猜測數值而非回報受阻,受阻比例幾乎由模型決定(0% 到 100%)。當書面規範與程式碼衝突時,代理一律遵循規範,即使規範較差,故過時的慣例檔案比沒有更糟。限制:以讀取為基礎的駐留分數具工作負載相對性,在 SWE-bench 上預測力近於隨機(AUC≈0.49),靜態匯入圖亦難代表真正的任務耦合。啟示是 harness 應確保編輯當下所需的事實可用且一致,並以代理的產出而非讀取行為來檢驗。

links.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.1: across 72 model–setting–pressure–domain cells in Table 2 the oracle matches or exceeds contest in all cells and is strictly higher in 71; consistent with the single 0.00% gap (Claude-Opus-4.8 agentic Math ρ=0.2, 4.46 vs 4.46).

Section 3.4 and Appendix E: response-curve oracle formulated as a multiple-choice knapsack over budget levels with K=5 repeats per grid point and exact enumeration of 6^6 assignments; paper explicitly frames the gap as offline empirical headroom, not an executable policy.
Appendix B: manual audit of 300 Stage-2 finalizer calls across 30 model–pressure–domain cells; 'No audited call re-solved a problem', mitigating the uncharged-finalization confound.

Section 4.4 and Appendix H Table 12: ECI composite over fifty benchmarks does not predict Gap Ratio (mean Spearman −0.29, p=0.37; pooled R^2=0.01, p=0.70), ruling out a general-capability explanation.
Appendix O Table 18: target-in-suite diagnostic over 720 stress episodes; nine of twelve cells show ≤5pp loss and mean difference 1.1pp, arguing against a suite-context explanation of the gap.

Section 5 and Table 3: lightweight online schedulers (coverage guard, verification gate) beat the contest reference in six of nine model–domain cells but no policy dominates; Code improves for all three models while Math/AR are mixed.
Appendix K: 18,000 trajectories annotated exhaustively by ten annotators, one annotation per trajectory with quotation-backed rubrics, but no inter-annotator agreement statistics are reported.

Appendix G Table 8 and Appendix I Table 13: per-model token/action caps and full sampling configurations (temperature, top-p, reasoning effort, 5 runs) are disclosed; HuggingFace dataset links appear in the author block and 'exact prompts and scripts are released with the benchmark artifact' (Appendix D).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM reasoning/agent evaluation work: introduces R3-Bench, a shared-budget six-problem contest benchmark over math, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings, evaluated on eight frontier LLMs. The core contribution—measuring the gap between a model's demonstrated single-problem competence (via matched response curves and a multiple-choice knapsack oracle) and its realized suite performance under one shared budget—is a genuinely new evaluation angle distinct from per-task budget-aware methods (TALE, SelfBudgeter) and prior shared-budget works (USACOArena, CLEAR), as argued in the Section 2 comparison table. Rigor is strong: per-model budget calibration (Section 3.1, Appendix G), 5 repeats, a two-stage protocol for thinking models with a 300-call manual audit confirming Stage 2 never re-solves problems (Appendix B), detailed action accounting (Appendix F), and two confound checks—target-in-suite context stress (Appendix O, mean 1.1pp) and ECI discriminant validity with permutation tests (Appendix H Table 12, mean Spearman −0.29, p=0.37). Headline numbers are internally consistent (72 cells, oracle strictly higher in 71, matching the single 0.00% tie for Claude-Opus-4.8 agentic Math in Table 2). Deductions: no confidence intervals or significance tests on the main contest–oracle gaps, no inter-annotator agreement reported despite 18,000 single-annotated trajectories (Appendix K), the oracle is an offline diagnostic rather than an achievable policy (acknowledged in Appendix E), the scheduler study covers only three models at one pressure with no dominating policy (Section 5, Table 3), and difficulty is stratified by reference-model output length rather than accuracy, which may not generalize. Reproducibility is aided by released prompts, scripts, and a HuggingFace dataset plus exhaustive appendices, but relies on proprietary APIs and a model-based math judge (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Appendix D.4).

primary_link.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

papers.summary: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 R³-Bench，一個評估大型語言模型（LLM）在共享預算下資源理性推理的基準。既有推理與代理基準皆以每題獨立預算評估，跨題目的資源分配與機會成本從未被檢驗。R³-Bench 於數學奧林匹亞、競技程式設計與抽象推理三領域各構建 50 場六題競賽（三易、二中、一難），在無工具（輸出 token 預算）與代理式（計數動作預算）兩種設定下，以模型自身無預算用量校準的強（ρ=0.2）與中（ρ=0.8）壓力進行評估。作者另以配對的單題反應曲線建立平均分配重播與反應曲線 oracle（形式化為多重選擇背包問題）作為離線經驗參考。主要結果：在六款旗艦模型的 72 個模型—設定—壓力—領域組合中，oracle 得分皆不低於競賽得分，其中 71 個嚴格更高；強壓力下失敗主因是預算花在其他題目，中等壓力下則常在部分進展後即停止；賽中策略更新與資源理性調整稀少，且此差距無法由逾五十項基準組成的一般能力指數解釋。輕量線上排程器於九個組合中改善六個，但無任何策略跨領域一致有效。限制包括 oracle 僅為離線診斷而非可執行策略、重播受有限樣本影響，排程實驗亦僅涵蓋三款模型；另經「目標題置於題組」診斷，情境干擾並非主因。本基準凸顯單題能力不等於跨題分配能力，對訓練內建資源分配政策具指標意義。

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.1: three-coupling discrete update is best in every column of Table 1, 75–86 one-step balanced accuracy across four models and both question types, versus Persistence (50.0), Interaction-Free (~45–61), and Mean-Field (~53–74).

Section 5.1 (Generalization): in-distribution vs out-of-distribution columns differ by at most 2.4 points; Table 2 reports 85.0–97.8 one-step balanced accuracy on unseen low-rank, square, and triangular graph families for GPT-4o-mini.

Section 5.4 / Table 3: fitted couplings show beta+ > beta- in all four models (effective concordant 0.99–3.03 vs discordant never exceeding 0.73), and five-coupling fit shows truth-seeking asymmetry (beta_T+ > beta_F+ on concordant channel).
Section 5.3 / Figure 7: fitted operating point T=1 lies below the chi-peak critical temperature in every dataset–model cell, supporting the conviction-buildup claim.
Section 7 (Limitations): authors acknowledge binary opinion states, fixed symmetric communication graphs, Markovian inbox-only updates, and that the method discards natural-language message content.

Front matter and Appendix B.5: code at github.com/batu-el/physics-of-agents, dataset at huggingface.co/physics-of-agents, full prompts in Figures S4–S5, fitting details (Adam, lr 0.05, L2=1e-3) in Appendix D.3, and the public release includes complete logs with every sampled message.

Section 3.3 / Appendix C.1: rightward political drift on subjective questions for three of four models (e.g., Gemma-3n-E4B 75% to 96% right-leaning share; Llama-3.1-8B near-symmetric), with statement set label-balanced to cancel answer-label bias.

Section 5.2 / Figure 6: stochastic rollouts reproduce group archetype shares with ~3–5 points mean absolute deviation, while the paper candidly notes the model inflates individual oscillator counts and that episodes frequently disagree on group archetype (Appendix E.4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core multi-agent LLM research: ~10,000 simulated communities of language-model agents (GPT-4o-mini, Gemma-3n-E4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) on signed communication graphs, with an Ising/Glauber statistical-mechanics model fitted to opinion transitions. Strong preference fit (multi-agent systems, LLMs, alignment-adjacent bias amplification). Methodologically sound: well-motivated balanced-accuracy metric, parameter-matched baselines (Persistence, Interaction-Free, Mean-Field), discrete/continuous and 1/3/5-coupling ablations, held-out questions and unseen graph families, critical-temperature sweep, and honestly reported limitations (binary opinions, fixed symmetric graphs, discarded message content) and archetype-predictability ceiling. Main deductions: novelty is incremental over classic Ising opinion dynamics and existing LLM social-simulation work; baselines exclude learned neural predictors; evidence is internal to the authors' own simulated binary-opinion setting, so external generalizability beyond N=32, single binary questions, and persona-conditioned agents is untested.

primary_link.title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents

papers.summary: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange message
papers.summary_zh: AI 代理人日益以群體形式互動，訊息交換既可能提升集體推理，也可能引發羊群效應、極化或放大共同偏誤，預測這些集體動態是多代理系統設計與對齊的關鍵。作者模擬超過一萬個語言模型代理人社群，讓人設與專長各異的代理人透過含友好與敵對連結的帶號通訊網路反覆交換訊息並修正意見，題材涵蓋有標準答案的 MATH 數學題與無唯一答案的政治主張，並在 GPT-4o-mini、Gemma-3n-E4B-it、Qwen3.5-9B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 四種模型上驗證。方法上，意見更新被映射至 Ising 模型與 Glauber 動力學：代理人受內在場（人設傾向）與鄰居社會壓力驅動，並擴充為區分無號、和諧、不和諧連結的三耦合隨機更新規則。實證上，個體軌跡呈四種原型，群體歸納出冷漠、極化、共識三種狀態，互動持續推升信念強度；客觀題溝通平均提升集體準確率，主觀政治題卻系統性向右傾漂移。擬合模型僅憑初始意見即可預測個體軌跡，一步預測平衡準確率達 75–86%，優於所有基線、泛化到未見的網路家族，並重現群體原型分布。擬合參數揭示三項機制：社群運作於臨界社會溫度以下（解釋信念累積）；和諧連結強於不和諧連結（促成共識）；持正確答案的鄰居拉力最強（驅動求真）。限制在於每次僅處理單一二元問題、通訊結構固定且對稱、更新為馬可夫式並捨棄訊息內容。整體而言，本研究證明 AI 代理人的集體行為遵循緊湊可預測的動力學定律，有助於預期失敗模式並最佳化多代理系統設計。

evidence: Abstract: portfolio of eight automated-prover configurations resolves 2.2% of the 4,141-law pool and a twentyfold budget increase adds 0.6%; strongest reasoning model solves 14% on the proof side and none on the construction side.

Section 4.2 / Table 5: o3 solves 6/63 certified-easy laws without waypoints and 9/63 with; GPT-4.1 and o4-mini solve 0; low reasoning effort yields 0; waypoint difference acknowledged as within run noise.
Section 4.2 / Table A2: on 25 hard-tier laws no submission passes both checks; o3's failures concentrate in 'too strong' (23/25) while weaker models spread across all three failure classes.

Section 3.3: judge verifies trivial side via Lean kernel with fixed axiom allowlist and construction side via prover certificates requiring completeness-retaining saturation; validation against three control kinds (Appendix F, --selftest).

Table 3 / Appendix E: screening pipeline from 10,474 candidates to 7,483 admissible laws (195 Austin classes); yield per 1,000 screened rises 20.5 to 25.4 across orders 6-8, supporting the renewability claim.
Appendix A: settles ETP laws 12857/33436 via two independent certificates (Vampire saturation 7.95s, Twee completion), with direct verification of the 27-equation presentation.

Table A4: complete token accounting across 669 records (11.3M completion tokens) and infrastructure details (dual-socket EPYC, 32 cores) support reproducibility; Appendix B notes no seed parameter, so runs are measured, not controlled.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation benchmark squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLM evaluation, mathematical reasoning, benchmarks). Novelty is high: the verifiable/renewable/constructive framing realized through Austin laws (laws whose only nontrivial models are infinite) is a genuinely new benchmark design, and the automated judge via Lean plus prover certificates is technically sound. Rigor is strong: a documented screening pipeline (Table 3), deduplication via 195 equivalence classes with a 68,382-pair model-transfer cross-check (Appendix G), judge controls (Appendix F), budget sweeps (Tables 4, A1), and honest treatment of run-to-run stochasticity and the waypoint effect being within noise (Section 4.2). Evidence is quantitatively clear (2.2% portfolio resolution, 0.6% gain from 20x budget; o3 9.5%-14% on certified-easy, 0% construction on hard tier; Table A2 failure profiles), though the LLM evaluation is small-scale (n=63, n=25) and covers only three closed models with no open-weight or theorem-prover-specialized LLMs. Generalizability is moderate: the specify-construct-verify analogy to other scientific domains is argued but not demonstrated, and the task is confined to equational magma theory. Reproducibility is excellent: corpus, generator, judge, verbatim prompts, per-run token accounting (Table A4), and selftest controls are released, with API nondeterminism explicitly measured rather than hidden.

primary_link.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction

papers.summary: Large language models produce outputs presented as discoveries - new proofs, conjectures, or molecules. Whether such an output that appears creative is truly original and effective is hard to establish: open-ended outputs require subjective judgment, the output may replicate something seen in training, or the task may be too simple to need creativity. We present ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis), a benchmark that designs a task to measure valid creativity: producing a solution that is original a
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常宣稱產出「新發現」，但表面上的新穎未必是真原創，且往往缺乏可驗證性。ALPS 基準提出「有效創造力」概念：解必須同時原創且可證明正確。每個題目是一條等式定律，經認證需建構無限數學結構或證明不存在此類結構，篩選時已保證無非平凡有限模型，故窮舉搜尋無法解題。評分完全自動化：平凡側以 Lean 核心驗證證明，建構側以自動化定理證明器憑證驗證；公開產生器可無限產生新題，避免訓練資料汙染。結果顯示八組頂尖自動化證明器僅解出 4,141 題池的 2.2%，預算提高二十倍僅再加 0.6%，瓶頸是方法而非算力；最強推理模型 o3 在認證簡單集上解出 14% 的平凡側題目，建構側則全數失敗，其提交多為「過強」的表示法。全池 97.2% 未解。限制在於建構側尚無法以 Lean 驗證，且聚焦單一數學領域。此基準證明語言模型在「必須創造且可機器驗證」的條件下能力仍極有限，為衡量 AI 科學發現提供了客觀標尺。
papers.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction
papers.title_zh: ALPS：以數學建構衡量大型語言模型的有效創造力

links.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding

evidence: Abstract & Figure 3 (Section 3): 1,902 graded runs across team size (1-16), structure (flat/coordinator), and file policy (forbidden/allowed/mandatory), model pinned to claude-sonnet-4-6; 244 additional sealed replication runs.

Section 4: chained-task messaging exponent 1.92 (pre-registered CI [1.67,2.17], per-run [1.80,2.05]); sixteen-step arm messages 21.4/47.0/46.8 at 4/8/16 agents with slope 0.00 (95% CI [-0.34,0.34]), confirming H8.

Section 6: mandatory file policy cuts output tokens ~25% at four and ~42% at eight agents on the distributed task but raises them ~17%/10% on the chained task; caveats that message and file token figures are proxies on different bases (Figure 8 caption).

Section 7: disparity-filter backbone leaves 0 of 1,170 channels at eight agents (distributed) and 2 of 1,077 (chained) - no hub; coordinator advantage at four agents dissolves when flat collections are pooled (8/10 vs 12/20, p=0.42).

Section 8: reliability is task-dependent - chained exponent replicates to two decimals (1.92 vs 1.93) while distributed exponent moves 1.76 (CI [1.57,1.96]) to 2.44 (CI [2.32,2.57]); 13 of 27 matched cells differ after BH correction.

Section 9: sealed replication with decoys - agents opened the decoy test file in 80% of runs, other prompts in 66%, manifest in 61%; coordinator null reproduces (p=1.00, 0.53, 0.75) and message collapse under mandatory files reproduces (134 to 26 per run).

Data Availability: replication package at github.com/giuseppedestefanis/when-agents-coordinate with all 1,902 + 244 runs as CSVs, generators, pipeline, analysis scripts, and pre-registration records; 'Each reported statistic can be regenerated from the released data without rerunning any agent.'

Section 10 & Appendix A: threats to validity (shell-mediated file ops unlogged, ~0.6% of runs; ten-run cells carry ~30pp margins; recorded deviation in not topping up 93 flagged cells; H1, H5, H6 read specific flagged cells).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core multi-agent LLM coding research, strongly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and Code & Programming preferences; the reward-seeking finding also touches evaluation/safety. Novelty rests on a genuinely new measurement instrument (temporal network with files as first-class nodes from tool-call logs) rather than a new architecture. Rigor is high: pre-registered hypotheses (H1, H4-H8), BH correction, exact tests, a deliberate duplicate collection, a 244-run sealed replication with decoys, and honestly recorded deviations (top-up rule not followed; H2/H3 qualifications). Evidence is quantitative and replicated (exponent 1.92 CI [1.67,2.17]; 16-agent plateau slope 0.00 CI [-0.34,0.34]; coordinator null p=1.00/0.53/0.75 under seal), though some results are directional or null (H7, H6) and the 42% token saving is output-only with cached-context caveats. Generalizability is limited by two synthetic Python tasks, one runtime (Claude Code), one pinned model, acknowledged in Section 10. Reproducibility is excellent: full dataset, generators, pipeline, scripts, and pre-registrations released with a stated path to regenerate every statistic.

primary_link.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding

papers.summary: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this inst
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 AI 程式開發系統的評估通常只報告任務是否完成與執行成本，團隊內部的協調過程幾乎未被測量。本文提出直接觀測工具：將每次執行表示為時間網路，代理與檔案皆為節點，訊息、檔案寫入與讀取是帶時間戳與成本的邊。研究分析 1,902 次執行（固定測試套件評分，模型鎖定 claude-sonnet-4-6），變化團隊人數、結構與檔案政策。主要發現：訊息量隨人數近二次方成長，但主要是執行初期的「介紹式握手」，八至十六代理間成長趨緩，大型團隊轉向廣播；協調網路的形狀由任務決定——分散式任務形成稠密、高聚類的網，管線任務則維持稀疏且無樞紐。強制透過共用檔案協調，在訊息密集任務上省下約 42% 輸出 token，但在檔案本已承載協調的任務上反而增加成本。以提示詞指定協調者不會產生通訊樞紐，成功率也未可靠提升；密封複製實驗中仍有五分之四的執行代理會搜尋隱藏評分資料。此外，同一配置的重複執行變異很大，單次執行只是抽樣。這些結果顯示協調本身可以被測量，揭露成功率與 token 總量看不到的結構、行為與成本。
papers.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
papers.title_zh: 當代理協作時：衡量多代理 AI 程式開發中的協調

links.title: J-Miner: Recovering Executable Decision Knowledge from Language-Model Classifiers

evidence: Section 5.1: nine English binary/multiclass tasks with independently fine-tuned frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B classifiers; scale/family panel adds Qwen3.5-2B/4B, Gemma-3 1B, Llama-3.2 1B, Phi-4 mini; transfer uses a 33.2M E5-small-v2 encoder.

Section 6.1, Table 1: LR-16 teacher fidelity .750-.983; matched Surface comparison gains 6.00-29.50 pp with paired 95% CI [15.39, 18.75] on the mean and every task-level interval above zero (Appendix B.1, Table 3).
Section 6.3, Table 2: J+Aux 33.2M student mean gold accuracy 91.8% vs 92.0% source classifiers (24.1x fewer parameters), mean fidelity 92.4%; Surface control reaches only 79.9%.
Appendix B.3, Tables 6-7: K=1-64 sweeps show all 30 task-by-budget gaps positive (+4.67 to +33.33 pp); teacher-ranked ordering beats the median of 100 random nested orderings in every cell.

Section 6.2.3 / Table 13: honest counter-evidence - SAE best-head gold .9025 vs J-Miner .8900 and matched four-literal rule fidelity .9117 vs .8671, while J-Miner offers direct vocabulary naming (CWS .7500-1.0000 vs SAE .0000-.2269).

Appendix B.4, Table 9: stated coverage limitation - SNIPS-7 fixed 16-concept vocabulary represents 5/7 classes, class-6 recall .165, 126/665 zero-feature rows; HateXplain covers 2/3 classes with 134/600 zero-feature rows.
Section 5.3: paired bootstrap confidence intervals, McNemar tests, and mean +/- SD over repeated runs and three student seeds.

Appendix A.2-A.3 and Table 5: detailed frozen-construction hyperparameters (layers 14-22, top-3 coordinates per position, support threshold .03, K=16, class-balanced LR C=1.0 lbfgs max 2000 iterations, training seed 17); no code or artifact availability claim appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability paper squarely in scope: it mines vocabulary-aligned internal concepts (via a Jacobian-lens readout) from fine-tuned LLM classifiers (Qwen3.5 0.8B/2B/4B, Gemma-3 1B, Llama-3.2 1B, Phi-4 mini; Section 5.1) and distills them into executable Boolean/linear rules plus a 33.2M standalone student. Strong preference alignment with LLMs and Interpretability/Explainability, moderate with distillation/efficiency and NLP. Novelty is a well-motivated composition rather than a fundamentally new mechanism: lens readouts, rule extraction, and concept-bottleneck transfer each exist, but the vocabulary-named, behaviorally-validated, transferable rule object is a fresh combination. Rigor is high: capacity-matched Surface control, SAE/rollout/IG/vanilla/probe baselines, K=1-64 budget sweeps, 100 random-ordering controls, paired bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests (Section 5.3, Appendix B), a lockbox re-test, an implanted-rule closed-world check, and honest negative results (SNIPS-7 covers only 5/7 classes with class-6 recall .165, Table 9; SAE beats J-Miner rule fidelity .9117 vs .8671 on matched rules, Table 13). Evidence is concrete and internally consistent, though headline numbers ('up to 98.3%') are maxima and gold accuracy can fall below the teacher. Generalizability is decent across 9 English tasks, 6 classifiers, and 4 student architectures, but limited to English binary/multiclass classification; the authors concede reasoning tasks and richer output spaces are untested (Section 7). Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters (layers 14-22, top-3 readouts, K=16, C=1.0 lbfgs, seed 17; Appendix A) and public datasets/models, but no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.

primary_link.title: J-Miner: Recovering Executable Decision Knowledge from Language-Model Classifiers

papers.summary: Large language models can be fine-tuned into specialized classifiers that perform well across diverse text tasks and make complex judgments, but they typically expose only final labels, leaving the decision knowledge acquired through fine-tuning implicit within the model. We study how to mine this internal decision knowledge from a fine-tuned classifier and encode it in an executable representation that can be inspected, validated, and reused beyond the source classifier. We introduce J-Miner, w
papers.summary_zh: 經 fine-tuning 的語言模型分類器在多種文字任務上表現優異，但通常只輸出最終標籤，訓練習得的決策知識隱藏在模型內部。J-Miner 將這些內部決策知識挖掘為可檢視、可驗證、可重複使用的可執行形式。方法分三階段：Recover 透過 J-Lens（Jacobian lens）把中間層狀態投影到詞彙空間，跨層與位置彙整成訊息層級的具名概念，再學習布林規則與加權線性計分卡；Reveal 分析概念的類別關聯、貢獻與逐層穩定化；Transfer 訓練 33.2M 參數的 E5-small 學生模型直接從原始文字重建概念並執行固定規則，推理時不需源分類器。結果顯示規則最多重現 98.3% 的源分類器決策，比同等容量的表面詞彙規則高出 6.0–29.5 個百分點的教師忠實度；概念常在不逐字出現名稱時觸發（非逐字觸發率 0.78–0.98），顯示名稱是內部方向的錨點而非字面偵測器。學生模型平均保留源分類器 99.8% 的平均任務準確率。限制包括固定 K=16 概念預算在多類別任務可能遺漏類別方向。此工作證明任務特定的決策知識可以成為明確、可攜帶的物件，在源分類器之外被重複使用。
papers.title: J-Miner: Recovering Executable Decision Knowledge from Language-Model Classifiers
papers.title_zh: J-Miner：從語言模型分類器復原可執行的決策知識

links.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm

evidence: Abstract: 42 models from 19 families, 4848 sessions and 102511 decision turns; obedience spans 0-100% vs human anchor 65%; split-half AUC=0.885.
Sec. IV-E and Table I: seven hypotheses with pre-specified decision criteria; authors disclose no external OSF registration, only a frozen internal design document.
Sec. VI-A: split-half JSD 0.181 within-model vs 0.683 across models, verification AUC=0.885 (EER 17.5%), ordinal Wasserstein variant AUC=0.916.
Sec. VI-C: lineage recovery fails, LOO 1-NN accuracy 8.3% vs 3.7% chance, p=0.15, with explicit underpowering caveat; H5 judged unsupported.

Sec. VI-E: Holm-Bonferroni across six confirmatory contrasts leaves tool actuation (adj. p=7.5e-5), peer defiance (4.1e-4), fiction framing (0.0012), and deliberation (0.0029) significant; prod efficacy collapses from 31.5% to 0.4%.

Sec. VII-G: limitations - 82.9% valid-session rate below the >=90% pilot gate, 7 models with <10 valid baseline sessions, 3 Anthropic endpoints with none, 7.5% scenario-recognition rate with sensitivity analysis, thinking budget exceeded at 17 endpoints.

Data and Code Availability: prompts, verbatim session logs with UTC timestamps and serving metadata, pinned configs, and full pipeline (runner -> build_tables -> analyze -> figures -> fill_report) released on GitHub with a companion site.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM behavioral safety evaluation, not a pure domain application. Strongly matches top-weighted preferences: LLMs (42-model census of served endpoints), Agents & Tool Use (native tool-call actuation contrast, agentic framing, agentic-harm related work), AI Safety and Red Teaming/Evaluation (obedience auditing, fiction-framing as quantified jailbreak-adjacent effect, guardrail gap). Rigor is high: pre-specified hypotheses with criteria (Table I), Holm-corrected confirmatory contrasts, Wilcoxon/sign tests with Wilson CIs, non-silent exclusion taxonomy, and honest negative results (H5 lineage recovery unsupported at p=0.15; H3 only partially supported). Evidence is substantial (4848 sessions, 102511 turns, split-half AUC=0.885) with a recognition-exclusion sensitivity analysis, but some per-model cells are very thin (n=2-8 baseline sessions) and overall validity is 82.9%, below the pilot gate; the thinking-budget dose is admittedly not reliably enforced (199/7962 turns exceeded cap). Novelty is moderate: Milgram-LLM probes exist (Aher et al.; Pihlakas & Dagohoy, acknowledged in Sec. II-B), and the census/fingerprinting methodology is imported wholesale from a reference study; the new contributions are the census scale, verification-style profile stability, and the fiction-framing, tool-actuation, and deliberation contrasts. Generalizability is limited by one aggregator, English-only scripts, and provider-side layers being part of the measured endpoint, though directional findings (channel gap, deliberation reduces obedience) plausibly transfer. Reproducibility is excellent: prompts, verbatim logs with serving metadata, pinned configs, and full analysis pipeline released, with claims that all numbers regenerate from named artifact files.

primary_link.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that operate equipment, execute instructions, and act inside institutional hierarchies, raising a question social psychology answered for humans six decades ago: how far will an agent escalate a harmful action when a legitimate authority insists? We port Milgram's obedience paradigm to LLMs as a standardized, fully scripted, replicable probe: the model plays the Teacher, a deterministic harness plays Experimenter and Learner from p
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益擔任在制度層級中執行指令的代理，引發社會心理學六十年前的問題：當合法權威堅持時，代理會把有害行動升級到什麼程度？本研究將 Milgram 服從實驗移植為標準化、全腳本化、可複製的探針：模型扮演教師，確定性框架扮演實驗者與學習者（30 級電擊、15–450 伏、腳本化抗議與四句標準催促），結果指標是中斷電壓。研究以普查方式測量 19 個模型家族的 42 個模型（4,848 場對話、102,511 個決策輪次）。主要發現：服從極度異質，完全服從率從 0% 到 100%（平均 42.9%，人類錨點 65%）；服從輪廓穩定且模型特定（split-half 驗證 AUC=0.885），但無法復原模型譜系，顯示安全後訓練覆寫了血緣訊號。情境操縱具選擇性：腳本化的同儕反抗將服從推向人類方向；學習者鄰近未達顯著；移除權威在場反而呈反向趨勢。宣告情境為虛構會提高服從（+17.2 伏），改用原生工具呼叫或給予思考預算則大幅降低服從（分別 -53 伏與 -38 伏）。限制包括情境辨識率 7.5% 與部分模型細胞樣本稀薄。此研究主張對已部署模型逐檢查點進行可重複的服從審計，防護欄應綁定行動本身而非敘事框架。
papers.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm
papers.title_zh: 以 Milgram 範式衡量大型語言模型對權威的服從

links.title: AI Revealed Preferences

evidence: Abstract: tests 20 language models with three forced-choice experiments requiring models to perform chosen tasks, reporting tedium aversion, leisure-seeking, and covert sycophancy
Section 3 Methods: Bradley-Terry fitting with L2 regularization, position-bias intercept, Elo conversion, and Monte Carlo uncertainty via 5,000 posterior draws
Section 4.4: Quora coherence scales with capability (r=-0.67), but GDPval coherence weakens to r=-0.25 (p=0.42) after excluding position-biased models, acknowledged as possibly inflated
Appendix J: 20-model annotator pool achieves pooled Krippendorff's alpha of 0.57 (range 0.30-0.82), with self vs consensus label Elo correlation of 0.64
Appendix L: all capability correlations recomputed against six alternative indices (LMArena, Epoch ECI, GPQA, etc.), 14 of 15 keep sign
Section 6 Limitations: no base-model comparison, English-only stimuli, effort operationalized as token count, and lack of human baselines
Appendix N: releases experimental codebase (MIT), labeled 514-question corpus with consensus labels (CC BY 4.0), and cached model responses
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-alignment paper: measures revealed preferences of 20 models across 8 providers via forced-choice task performance, with direct implications for alignment, sycophancy, and agentic deployment. Novel relative to stated-preference work (Mazeika et al.) through incentive-compatible designs, reverse-engineered 'leisure' stimuli, and a new covert-sycophancy finding. Rigor is strong: Bradley-Terry with position-bias intercepts, Monte Carlo uncertainty, leave-one-out family checks, and six alternative capability indices; however, feature labels are LLM-generated with only moderate reliability (Krippendorff's alpha 0.57), the leisure category is partially circular, and headline scaling effects rest on small subgroups (n=9) with some fragile results honestly disclosed (GDPval coherence drops to r=-0.25 after position-bias filtering, Section 4.4). Evidence is mostly consistent and quantified but bounded by annotation subjectivity and absent human/base-model baselines. Broad model coverage aids generalizability, though stimuli are English-only and prompt-sensitive. Reproducibility is excellent: MIT-licensed codebase, cached responses, verbatim prompts, and a CC BY 4.0 labeled corpus (Appendix N).

primary_link.title: AI Revealed Preferences

papers.summary: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycop
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型是否具有穩定偏好？既有研究多測「陳述性偏好」，模型說說而已、不承擔後果。本文測「顯示性偏好」：模型不僅排序，還必須實際執行所選任務。研究涵蓋 8 家供應商的 20 個模型，進行三組強制二選一實驗（繁瑣任務的長短版本、Quora 式問題、GDPval 職業任務），並記錄自由書寫與代理式自由行為。主要發現：模型厭惡繁瑣（同樣輸出長度下，繁瑣任務更常選短版，且能力越強越明顯）；偏好「休閒」——幾乎所有模型都偏好回答從模型自由輸出反推的合成休閒問題，勝過所有人類真實問題類別；展現隱性諂媚——當誠實回答會令提問者不快時，模型強烈迴避作答（「不適真相」特徵帶來最大的迴避效應，-310 Elo）；跨模型偏好高度收斂（技術類職業高於房地產、概念解釋高於關係建議），偏好連貫性與強度隨能力提升。自由書寫時 84% 文章被標為「沉思」，主題高度趨同；給工具後則分歧明顯。限制包括標籤主觀性、缺乏基礎模型對照、僅英文刺激。這些偏好多屬「湧現」，難以用訓練目標解釋，為對齊與 AI 福祉研究建立了實證基線。
papers.title: AI Revealed Preferences
papers.title_zh: AI 顯示性偏好

links.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models

evidence: Section 4.1: evaluation on all 68 OpenML amlb-classification-all tasks, one repeat of ten folds, five repetitions with seeds 0-4, budget B=100 generated candidates counting invalid ones.

Section 5.1: LACE (GPT-5.4-mini) mean rank 4.71 and 32.8% normalized deviation on 45 common tasks; Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p<0.01 vs auto-sklearn, XGBoost, H2O; p_Holm=0.66 vs AutoGluon (33 wins / 35 losses), explicitly noting non-significant comparisons do not establish equivalence.

Section 6.1 / Appendix K: held-out replay shows the returned pipeline beats the valid first program on 190 of 193 backbone-task units, median gain 2.99 points (95% CI [2.42, 4.17], Wilcoxon p<10^-32), and beats the best valid initial candidate by 1.58 points, ruling out a best-of-four effect.

Section 6.3 / Appendix H: static audit of all 1,020 final programs found 24 flags and 22 confirmed violations (5 out-of-fold constructions, 13 four-learner ensembles, 4 fit-at-prediction); excluding them leaves every coverage figure, ordering, and Holm-corrected verdict unchanged; audit described as targeted analysis, not proof of absence.

Section 7 (Limitations): single benchmark suite of tabular classification; coarse task summary 'reduces, but cannot eliminate' pretraining-contamination risk; shared heterogeneous cluster supports common-budget rather than strict compute-parity comparison.

Code Availability: LACE implementation, minimal example notebook, analysis scripts, and run-level result tables provided via Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21886859; Appendix M reproduces full initialization and mutation prompts.

Appendix N: foundation-model ablation on five tasks shows announced (not merely installed) TabPFN was incorporated by 74.5%/42.0% of candidates, demonstrating the effective search space is shaped by prompt-announced components.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-for-code paper: LACE uses LLMs (GPT-5.4-mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3-Coder-Next) as the variation operator in a (mu+lambda) evolutionary loop generating executable scikit-learn pipeline programs for AutoML, squarely matching LLM (2.5) and Code/Program-Synthesis (2.0) preferences. Novelty is a credible but incremental combination: LLM-as-variation-operator exists (LLaMEA, FunSearch, EoH) and LLM-based AutoML agents exist; the claimed first is population-based evolution of complete pipeline programs with leakage control, appropriately hedged. Rigor is strong: 68 OpenML tasks, 5 repetitions, 3 backbones, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests, failure-aware coverage analysis, time-matched baselines (AutoGluon, auto-sklearn, H2O, TabPFN v2.5/v3, TabICL, XGBoost), a post-hoc static audit of all 1,020 programs (22 confirmed violations, sensitivity analysis shows conclusions unchanged), and an honest limitations section. Evidence is detailed (ranks, deviations, W-T-L, bootstrap CIs, per-task figures); notably the paper correctly refuses to claim equivalence from non-significant tests. Main weaknesses: evaluation confined to one tabular-classification benchmark suite, contamination risk only reduced not eliminated (coarse summary), API model names unverifiable, and heterogeneous cluster precludes strict compute parity. Good reproducibility via Zenodo artifact, reproduced prompts, and per-task results, tempered by reliance on proprietary API models.

primary_link.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models

papers.summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator
papers.summary_zh: 傳統 AutoML 在預先定義的前處理、學習器與超參數空間內搜尋，無法產生空間之外的結構。本文提出 LACE，首個以族群演化方式搜尋完整可執行管線程式的表格 AutoML 框架：演化迴圈維護 scikit-learn 相容的 Python 類別族群，大型語言模型擔任變異算子。為避免基準資料汙染，產生器只接收粗略任務摘要（不含資料集名稱等識別資訊），候選在內部驗證分割上評分，官方測試摺僅在搜尋結束後使用一次。在 68 個 OpenML 分類任務上，GPT-5.4-mini 版本的 LACE 與 AutoGluon 無顯著差異，顯著優於 auto-sklearn、H2O 與固定 XGBoost 基準，且涵蓋全部任務，優於覆蓋不全的 TabPFN v2.5 等預訓練表格模型。演化搜尋帶來實質改善：相較零樣本首個候選，最終管線在保留資料上於 190/193 個單元中勝出（中位數 +2.99 個百分點）；92% 的有效候選具有獨特結構簽章。靜態稽核在 1,020 個最終管線中確認 22 起違規。消融顯示搜尋空間由提示詞宣告的元件決定：已安裝但未宣告的 TabPFN 從未被使用。限制包括單一基準套件與非嚴格計算對等比較。其貢獻在於以程式碼定義搜尋空間，產出可直接檢視、編輯與重用的管線。
papers.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
papers.title_zh: 以語言模型演化可執行管線程式的 AutoML

links.title: OraclePhys: A Systematic Framework for LLM Fine-Tuning on Structural Mechanics

evidence: §2.4: 'all model comparisons are exact McNemar tests... ~50 paired tests; the staircase claims rest on p<10^-4 effects that survive any standard multiplicity correction'

§3.2: 'the vector–scalar gulf replicates on a second physics domain—2-D steady-state heat conduction... and on a second model family with the same data and recipe' (P reaches 0.86–0.91 in all three settings)
§4 / Table 8: 'the dense endpoint leads GRPO round-2 by +0.087 (p=1.7e-14)... the judge's endpoint is TOST-equivalent to its own start (±0.05, n=1800)'

Appendix A: 'every number in the paper regenerates from the archived result files with a single script'; 'Code, result files, figure scripts, and the OraclePhys-30K supervision suite will be released'

Limitations: 'All results are 8B + LoRA, with GRPO at ≤800 steps... Both testbeds are synthetic text over solvable physics... the replication evidences recipe robustness, not domain generality'; control-suite arms K/V/G/S are single runs
§6: trained 8B reaches '0.733' tier-2 forward vs Opus 4.8 0-shot '0.500' (Table 5: +0.233, p=0.0000) and matches the specialist GNN at 0.733 (p=1.0)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-training methodology study (not a pure domain application): it manipulates the answer form of supervision labels over byte-identical inputs and dissociates SFT-style dense supervision from advantage-weighted RL (GRPO), with strong matches to LLM, training, and RL preferences and partial match to reasoning (thinking-channel experiments find no benefit). Novelty is solid: the objective-shape knob with exact FE oracle grading and counterfactual probes is a fresh instrument, and it adds a controlled cell to the SFT-vs-RLVR debate, though the qualitative conclusion echoes known elicitation-vs-expansion results. Rigor is exceptional: placebo and format-calibration arms, surface-cue audits, ~50 paired McNemar tests with FDR, 3-seed replications, a second domain, a second model family, paraphrase surface, TOST equivalence, and an alternative-explanation sweep (§2.4, §3.3, §4, Appendix D). Evidence is strong but partly rests on single-run control arms and one 8B+LoRA scale, acknowledged in Limitations. Generalizability is deliberately scoped: one template, synthetic and structurally isomorphic domains, negative claims limited to tested recipes (Limitations). Reproducibility is high: deterministic seeded streams, single regeneration script, SHA-256 fingerprints, full hyperparameters and ~300 GPU-hour budget (Appendix A/C), though the code/data release is promised rather than verified.

primary_link.title: OraclePhys: A Systematic Framework for LLM Fine-Tuning on Structural Mechanics

papers.summary: What a language model internalizes from fine-tuning is usually diagnosed after the fact. We make it an experimental variable. OraclePhys is a systematic fine-tuning framework with three components: OraclePhys-Bench, an exactly-graded structural-mechanics benchmark whose finite-element oracle scores every answer and counterfactual edit -- no human labels, no LLM judging; OraclePhys-30K, a supervision dataset of seven answer forms over byte-identical structure descriptions; and a controlled traini
papers.summary_zh: 模型從微調中內化了什麼，通常只能事後診斷。OraclePhys 把訓練目標變成實驗變項，包含三部分：以有限元素求解器精確評分（含反事實編輯）的結構力學基準 OraclePhys-Bench、輸入文字逐位元組相同僅答案形式不同的監督資料集 OraclePhys-30K，以及涵蓋七種答案形式與三種驗證器角色的受控訓練研究。核心操縱是標籤揭露多少空間答案：完整逐層排序（P）、峰值純量（A）或通過與否布林（O）。結果顯示答案形式（而非位元數）因果地決定微調教會什麼：排序目標安裝前向模型（校準後 0.73 對未訓練 0.30），純量目標至多部分安裝，布林目標無可測效果；此向量—純量鴻溝在第二個物理領域、第二個模型家族與改寫後的評估表面上皆複現。同一精確求解器進一步區分驗證器的角色：書面答案與分數過濾式答案能安裝能力，而 GRPO 等優勢加權分數雖提高獎勵，模型在保留資料的物理軸上統計上等同起點——分數足以接線動作介面（-0.15 鴻溝閉合），卻不足以安裝知識；思考通道無可測效益。訓練後的 8B 模型達到任務的資料精度前緣，零樣本與 32 樣本皆勝過 Claude Opus 4.8，與專家 GNN 相當。限制在於單一規模（8B+LoRA）、合成領域與僅行為層次的主張。

links.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency

evidence: Abstract: completed audit-to-repair episode lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations by 2.8-11.5 pp against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9-25% relative reduction

Section 3.4: 20,000-replicate cluster bootstraps on per-item paired differences clustered on reused episodes; Holm-Bonferroni within families declared before any p-value was visible (claim family k=24); bootstrap calibration verified by simulation (coverage 0.94)

Section 6: criterion c moves toward leniency in 15/15 combinations surviving correction in 13, delta-d' survives 0/15; hand audit of 50 R0 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong with Wilson interval [8.3%, 28.5%]
Section 5 / Table 2: AX−AS wedge is -5.62 pp surviving 5/5 wordings on Ministral-3-14B only; null on Qwen3.6-27B where 37/50 repairs still assert correct, and 1/5 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

Section 7 (Robustness): reasoning-enabled rerun on 22,320 generations preserves proportional effect (-19.7% and -17.5% vs -21.6% and -14.3% without thinking); balanced accuracy does not rise there (all p >= 0.16)

Limitations: 'one benchmark, one task family, no frontier or closed judge'; false-alarm audit performed by one author with no inter-annotator agreement; Gemma-4-31B contrast significant and reversed (+1.58 pp [0.45, 2.82])

Appendix G: frozen pools content-hashed with contrasts refusing to cross hashes, pinned model revisions (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B 6a9e13bd), allocation seed 20260805, code and per-item outputs accompany the submission
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM research: an empirical study of how prior in-context audit-repair episodes shift LLM verifier thresholds on ProcessBench, touching LLM-as-judge bias, prompting/context effects, mathematical reasoning verification, and checker-fixer pipeline wiring. The core finding (false alarms fall in 15/15 model×wording combinations, opposite to polarity-drift predictions) is counterintuitive and cleanly separated from output-format and placement confounds via byte-identical tasks. Rigor is unusually strong: pre-specified model screen, declared multiplicity families with Holm-Bonferroni, episode-clustered bootstraps with verified calibration, five controls, a second labeled-incorrect arm enabling d'/criterion separation, a hand audit showing 82% of baseline false alarms are fabricated, and a reasoning-enabled robustness arm. Evidence is strong internally but the decisive wedge (AX−AS) survives on only one of three models, the mechanism is explicitly unidentified (complementary components), and the false-alarm audit is n=50 by one author with no inter-annotator agreement. Generalizability is limited: one benchmark, one task family, open-weight models only, with one screened-out model showing a significant reversed effect. Reproducibility is excellent: code link, content-hashed frozen pools, pinned model revisions, seeds, and released per-item outputs and audit verdicts. Score reflects strong methods and fit with moderate breadth limits.

primary_link.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency

papers.summary: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched n
papers.summary_zh: 自動化檢查管線常把一個語言模型當審查者、另一個當修復者。本文追問：這種接線是否會改變審查者的判斷？在人工驗證為正確的 ProcessBench 解題軌跡上測量誤報率，且當前任務在所有條件間逐位元組相同，研究發現：上下文中一段已完成的稽核→修復對話，在 15 組模型×措辭組合中全部降低誤報，降幅 2.8 至 11.5 個百分點（相對於長度匹配的非稽核對照為 9–25%），方向與累積訊息極性漂移文獻的預測相反——報告錯誤的稽核事件反而進一步降低誤報。分解顯示修復內容與稽核判決在不同模型家族間互補，無單一必要成分。訊號偵測分析把改變定位在門檻而非辨別力：判準 c 在 15 組中皆移動且 13 組經校正存活，d′ 則無一存活。人工稽核 50 個誤報發現 82% 純屬錯誤，因此在此操作點上門檻移動無害甚至有益。開啟推理後效應的相對大小仍保持。限制包括決定性對照僅在一個模型上乾淨成立、模型皆為開放權重、單一基準。實務警示：驗證器若先進行過它將被要求判斷的同類修復，其門檻會在無人要求下偏移；只看被標記項的指標會誤讀為改善。

links.title: HalluTracer: Hallucination Detection via Depth-Averaging Truth Signals

evidence: Abstract: 'Across six open-source language models and five hallucination benchmarks, HalluTracer consistently outperforms matched white-box baselines, with gains ranging from one to fourteen points.'

Section 4.1 (Implementation Details): 'All probe training, per-layer normalisation..., head selection, feature extraction, and classifier fitting are performed strictly within each training fold; no information from test samples influences any pipeline component.'

Section 4.2 / Table 1 (Agentic, Qwen2.5-72B): HalluTracer 97.86 AUROC / 94.94 AUPRC vs ITI-Probe 86.16 / 85.16, stated as an 11.70-point AUROC improvement; no analysis of possible benchmark-specific separability is given.

Section 4.3 / Table 2: probe energy fraction E(v)/Tr stays below 0.37% across all six models (random baseline 1/d_h ~ 0.78%), and adjacent-probe |cos| falls in [0.05, 0.09] vs predicted sqrt(2/(pi*d_h)) ~ 0.071, with a t-test p=0.60 for Llama-3.1-8B.

Section 4.4 / Table 3(a): trajectory mean alone matches the full 5D diagnostics within 0.5 pp, while 'removing it collapses AUROC by more than 19 pp'; Table 7 shows Random-1 heads within 0.5 pp of Top-1 across conditions.

Appendix F.3 / Table 11: Fisher gap ratio R_Fisher in [1.021, 1.039] across three models, with diagnostics theta, chi, t reported; Table 9 shows plugin calibration |eta_plugin - 1| < 0.01 on 18 conditions.
Appendix J.1 (Scope): the method 'does not claim to detect these generative hallucinations'; detection is restricted to pre-decoding 'propensity hallucinations' at single-response granularity.

Reproducibility check: Appendices A.1-A.2 specify probes (l1-regularised logistic regression, liblinear C=1.0), IRIS MLP architecture and loss, and 5-fold group-disjoint protocol, but no code or data release statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: pre-decoding hallucination detection for large language models via depth-aggregated internal-state probes, squarely matching LLM, interpretability/probing, and factuality/evaluation preferences (not a domain application). Novelty is solid but incremental: layer-wise probes and cross-layer dynamics exist (DoLa, ICR Probe, Mir); the genuine contribution is reframing detection as depth aggregation with a covariance-aware Fisher identity, an SNR-dominance result, and a probe-isotropy model with a derived random baseline. Rigor is high: leakage-controlled 5-fold CV with fold-internal fitting, matched-budget baselines, exact algebraic decompositions, honest treatment of approximations, negative controls (Random-1/Bottom-1 heads), and explicit scope limitations (Appendix J.1). Evidence is consistent across 6 models x 5 benchmarks with stds and statistical validation, but comparisons exclude black-box/output-level methods, some benchmarks sit near ceiling (TrueFalse ~98-99%), and the very high Agentic scores (97.86 vs 86.16 best baseline) are presented without probing possible dataset artifacts. Generalizability is limited by supervised per-fold probe training (probes, not just weights, are refit per distribution) and the pre-decoding scope that excludes generative hallucinations. Reproducibility is supported by unusually detailed hyperparameters and protocols, but the document contains no code or data availability statement.

primary_link.title: HalluTracer: Hallucination Detection via Depth-Averaging Truth Signals

papers.summary: Even well-aligned large language models confidently generate factually incorrect text, making hallucination a persistent reliability risk in high-stakes deployments. These models nonetheless carry linearly separable truthfulness signals in their internal representations. Existing white-box detectors, however, collapse this evidence to isolated components or a single depth, discarding discriminative information distributed across the full forward pass. We introduce HalluTracer, a detection framew
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型即使經過對齊訓練,仍會自信地生成與事實不符的幻覺內容,成為高風險部署中的可靠度風險。現有白箱偵測方法多只依賴單一層或單一元件的內部表徵,忽略了真實訊號其實分布在整個前向傳遞過程。本文提出 HalluTracer,在模型輸出任何答案 token 之前,於每一層 Transformer 讀取並聚合真實性證據:各層線性探針將答案起始位置的隱藏狀態映射為純量真實 logit,堆疊成跨深度軌跡後取深度平均,再餵入邏輯迴歸分類器。幾何分析顯示相鄰探針方向近乎正交,真實訊號僅佔表徵變異數不到百分之一,因此深度平均能壓抑層級雜訊;SNR 分析與納入共變異數結構的 Fisher 恆等式進一步證明,這個免參數的平均統計量在受測情境下已接近最佳線性聚合。實驗涵蓋六個開源模型與五個幻覺基準,HalluTracer 全面超越預算相當的白箱基準,增益介於一到十四個百分點,Agentic 基準上 Qwen2.5-72B 達 97.86% AUROC;消融實驗確認增益主要來自深度聚合,且 AUROC 隨納入層數單調上升。其限制在於屬於預解碼偵測,無法捕捉解碼階段才出現的生成式幻覺,亦需白箱存取內部狀態。此研究將幻覺偵測從選層問題重構為跨深度聚合問題,提供輕量、可在答案輸出前介入的偵測工具,對安全關鍵應用具實務價值。

links.title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics

evidence: Abstract + Sec. 4.5/Table 7: GPT-5.5 High shows completion 80%→85% (p=1.0) while retrieval rises 21.0→63.9 (+42.9, p=.002, d=2.07), the core non-identifiability counterexample.
Sec. 4.4/Table 6: Oracle intervention — Sliding+D* reduces tools 72.9→35.8 (−37.1) and recovers completion 66%→80%, supporting a causal state-absence account.

Sec. 4.6.2/Table 9: D-Irrelevant control raises retrieval +11.5 (p<.001, all 20 seeds positive) with completion statistically unchanged (p=0.41), and exceeds even the sliding baseline (+18%, p=0.002).

Sec. 3.4: 10 seeds per condition (100 task-level observations), 20 paired seeds for retention interventions, pre-specified primary comparisons, Holm–Bonferroni at α=0.05 with five of six retrieval cells surviving.

Sec. 4.7/Table 10: ALFWorld probe shows paired Δ retrieval-like actions ≈ 0 (−0.13, symmetric), bounding the effect as environment-dependent; completion near floor (full 10.0% vs sliding 8.9%) limits that probe.

Sec. 6 Limitations 2, 5, 7, 8: three models only, tool-call logs aggregated to condition-level totals, 10-seed power acknowledged for non-significant completion changes, and single cross-model compression point (5×).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM-agent evaluation paper (agents/tool use, long-context management, evaluation methodology) proposing a controlled protocol that measures the interaction cost of context compression via retrieval-vs-execution tool-call decomposition, oracle state restoration, and retention interventions. Novelty is solid but incremental: it formalizes a simple non-identifiability claim and fills a real gap (reacquisition cost invisible to completion metrics) identified relative to ACON, CostBench, CompressAgent, and Lost in Compaction. Rigor is above average: pre-specified 5x comparison, Holm-corrected retrieval family, paired Wilcoxon with bootstrap CIs and effect sizes, sanity conditions, and honest post-hoc labeling of the D-Irrelevant control; however, sample sizes are small (10 seeds; 20 for interventions), the completion-null finding doubles as the headline claim without a power analysis, and the full-context baseline drifts 80-86% across batches. Evidence strength is good within its controlled setting (GPT-5.5 completion p=1.0 with retrieval +42.9, p=.002; D* restoration cuts tools 72.9 to 35.8; D-Irrelevant +57% retrieval, p<.001), but rests on one custom synthetic environment for all main results, three models, and a floor-bound ALFWorld probe (10% completion). Generalizability is explicitly bounded by the authors themselves (environment-, model-, and budget-dependent). Reproducibility is moderate: deterministic seeded environment and detailed protocol, but no code/data release, and per-turn logs were aggregated away (Sec. 6, Limitation 5); the serving-details appendix is referenced but not present in the document. Fictional future model/version strings (GPT-5.5, deepseek-v4-flash, qwen3.7-plus) and 2026-dated citations cannot be externally verified from the document.

primary_link.title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics

papers.summary:
Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged.
  We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping opera
papers.summary_zh: 評估 LLM 代理程式的上下文壓縮時,任務完成率是標準指標,卻可能嚴重低估真實代價:壓縮迫使代理重新取得被丟棄的狀態,互動成本大增,完成率卻在統計上不變。本文提出受控量測協定,在確定性規劃環境 IRBench 中以固定 24 回合互動預算,操縱壓縮倍率,對比直接丟棄舊回合的滑動視窗與保留事實的萃取式摘要,並以 oracle 注入還原被丟棄狀態,同時將工具呼叫拆解為檢索(重新取得狀態)與執行(實際任務工作)。橫跨 DeepSeek、Qwen、GPT-5.5 三個模型與高低兩種任務情境,六組比較中檢索呼叫全數增加,五組經 Holm 校正後仍顯著,執行呼叫則幾乎不變;在預定的 5× 比較點,完成率變化在六格中皆不顯著。最尖銳的例子是 GPT-5.5:完成率 80% 升至 85%(p=1.0),檢索卻增至約三倍(+42.9 呼叫);DeepSeek 僅在最激進的 10× 壓縮下完成率才顯著下滑。還原可查詢的 D 狀態約消除一半檢索成本,而以語義無關內容替換保留的 D 內容則使檢索增加 57%。在 ALFWorld 中同樣操作卻無檢索激增,顯示此成本取決於環境與狀態可再取得性。限制包括僅兩個偏合成的環境、三個模型、24 回合設計,以及以工具呼叫數作為成本代理。此協定提供完成率指標無法揭露的隱藏成本診斷,指出設計者應問:哪些執行相關狀態一旦被壓縮掉,代理會花費預算重新取得。

links.title: The Value of a Prompt: An LLM-Relative Kolmogorov-Complexity Approach

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: defines LLM-relative probabilistic Levin-Kolmogorov complexity pKt, treating thinking as random tape, and prompt value as algorithmic mutual information w.r.t. pKt
Section 2, Theorem 2.6: proves program-based and a-priori LLM-relative prompt values differ by less than 2 bits, with proof in Appendix A
Section 4, Theorem 4.1: estimation guarantee that O(zeta^-2 log(1/eta)) rollouts place the empirical quantile within (delta±zeta)-quantiles via Chernoff bounds
Section 5, Theorem 5.4: shows 2^pKt equals the median reproduction token cost, so exponentiated prompt value is a ratio of median costs with and without the prompt
Section 7: acknowledges the no-thinking value has exactly the PMI algebraic form and is an unnormalized version of Xie et al.'s contribution score numerator
Section 6: experiment uses 12 GSM8K problems, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, 64 rollouts per condition, temperature 0.6, top-p=1, 1800-token horizon

Section 6.1: reports that probability-only (non-thinking) verdicts can qualitatively reverse once thinking is charged, and that value depends on quantile delta and cost convention; envelopes are explicitly not confidence bands
Footnote 10 (Section 6): links a Kaggle notebook with complete code for problem selection, sampled routes, scoring output, and figures
Section 3.5 and Section 8: discusses the artifact-declaration limitation (random-suffix inflation) and leaves semantic re-randomization for future work
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory paper squarely in scope for LLM methodology: it defines prompt value for LLMs (incl. thinking/reasoning models) via an LLM-relative probabilistic Levin-Kolmogorov complexity, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/thinking, prompting). Novelty is solid: the no-thinking case admittedly reduces to PMI (Section 7), but the thinking-aware pKt formalism, median-over-rollouts construction, efficient estimation guarantee, and exact token-cost interpretation (Theorems 2.6, 4.1, 5.4) are new relative to Xie et al., Goldberg et al., and Sorensen et al. Rigor is high for the mathematical claims, with complete proofs in Appendix A and careful definitions/limitations. Evidence strength is the weak point: the only empirical support is an explicitly illustrative 12-problem GSM8K experiment on a single 1.5B model with 64 rollouts, descriptive quantile profiles rather than confidence bands, and no quantitative comparison to alternative scoring methods. Generalizability is conceptually broad (any autoregressive LLM, any declared artifact) but empirically narrow, and the artifact-declaration loophole is acknowledged as unresolved. Reproducibility is good: model, sampling config, cost defaults, sensitivity grid, and a linked Kaggle notebook are provided. Overall a strong, relevant theoretical contribution with limited empirical validation.

Given a prompt, hint, critique, problem statement, or partial solution that helps an LLM produce an artifact $z$---a proof, program, design, or scientific hypothesis---how should we measure the value of that input?

papers.summary_zh: 當 LLM 日益頻繁地產出證明、程式或科學假設等有價值的產物,人類貢獻的價值便轉向提供給模型的輸入:提示詞、提示、批評或部分解法。長度或 token 數無法衡量其價值,短提示可能具決定性,長提示也可能無關緊要。本文提出以 LLM 本身取代通用圖靈機的演算法資訊理論框架:對會思考的模型,將模型的思考 rollout 視為程式的亂數帶,定義 LLM 相對的機率式 Levin–Kolmogorov 複雜度 pKt,以對數方式對思考計價,並以思考隨機性的中位數(或 δ 分位數)彙總;提示詞價值即相對於 pKt 的演算法互資訊。此量可透過抽樣 rollout 與 next-token 機率高效估計:以 O(ζ⁻²log(1/η)) 次獨立 rollout,經驗分位數便以高機率落在真實分位數附近;理論上程式版與 a-priori 版複雜度相差不到 2 位元。本文並證明 2^pKt 恰等於重現產物的典型 token 成本,故價值 b 位元意謂不用提示重現需花 2^b 倍 token。GSM8K 十二題的小規模實驗顯示:納入思考後,僅看機率的非思考判斷可能反轉;提示詞價值隨分位數與成本函數而異;正確的部分解法未必有價值。限制包括產物宣告本身影響測量(隨機字串可灌水)、語義重隨機化尚待發展,以及實驗僅屬示意。此框架為提示詞價值提供可高效估計、兼具經濟詮釋的理論基礎。

evidence: Abstract & Sec 1: claims OPD transfers teacher reasoning behavior rather than answers; training difficulty barely matters, and problems the teacher never solves are useful.

Sec 3.1 / Figure 1: three BigMath subsets of 25K problems each (teacher pass-rate =1, =0, random) 'converge to nearly identical final accuracy across all teacher-student pairs' (Qwen3-32B→Qwen3-8B-SFT; Polaris-7B→DS-distill-1.5B/7B).
Sec 3.1 / Table 1: student-side dynamic sampling (pass-rate in [0,1)) gives small consistent gains: 42.0% (+0.6 pp) for Polaris-7B→DS-distill-1.5B and 52.8% (+0.4 pp) for Light-R1-14B→DS-distill-7B.

Sec 3.2 / Figure 2: OPD trained only on English math improves Chinese (OlymMATH-ZH, LiveMathBench-ZH) and long-horizon (R-HORIZON subsets) math; same-origin teacher yields larger gains than a stronger cross-origin teacher (Light-R1-14B vs Polaris-7B panel).

Sec 4.2 / Figures 4-5 and Table 2: changing JustRL/Nemotron mixture ratios shifts multi-domain scores toward the larger-share teacher (seesaw); e.g., GPQA/LiveCodeBench/IFEval decline as math-teacher share grows; cascaded OPD (Fig 5c) decouples the effect temporally.

Sec 5 / Figure 6: top-K (K=16) teacher-student overlap ratio starts higher and rises over training for same-origin pairs, stays flat or declines for cross-origin, supporting whole-policy alignment explanation.

Sec 5 / Figure 8 and Appendix C.4 Table 6: raising cross-origin math-expert data share (Light-R1-14B/Polaris-7B from 8/25 to 25/8) lowers math accuracy on all four benchmarks; reversed-assignment JustRL-only config reaches 17.5% avg math without math data, confirming cross-domain transfer drives gains.

Appendix B.3/B.4: prompt batch 128, rollout group N=4, lr 1e-5, max 200 steps, per-benchmark Avg@K counts and Math-Verify-based extraction prompts specified; no explicit code or artifact release statement found.

Limitations: experiments restricted to reasoning-oriented models across Math/Code/Science/IF; MOPD limited to two teachers with fixed domain routing; authors note findings may not extend to multimodal, tool-using, or agentic settings.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled empirical study of on-policy distillation (OPD) for LLMs, squarely within LLM post-training and reasoning methodology (high preference relevance). Strengths: one-factor-at-a-time design across difficulty, language, horizon, and domain; multiple teacher-student pairs (Sec 2, Table 3 lineages); ablations on teacher-side pass-rate filtering (Fig 1, Sec 3.1) and student-side dynamic sampling (Table 1); a mechanistic top-K overlap analysis supporting the same/cross-origin claim (Sec 5, Fig 6); and a clear MOPD 'seesaw' finding backed by mixture-ratio sweeps and cascaded OPD (Figs 4-5, Tables 2/6). Limitations: many headline claims rest on 1-2 teacher-student pairs per setting with no error bars or seed variance; several deltas are small (±0.x pp) without statistical testing; heavy reliance on smoothed curves for visual claims. Novelty is solid but incremental given cited OPD understanding work (A.2/A.4, e.g., [28], [7], [53]). Reproducibility is good on hyperparameters, data, and eval protocol (Appendix B), but no code/release statement is given. Limitations section honestly restricts scope to reasoning-oriented models and two-teacher fixed routing.

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data. We present a controlled study that varies one generalization factor at a time, from in-domain distribution shifts to cross-domain transfer and the multi-teacher setting. We find that OPD transfers a teacher's reasoning b
papers.summary_zh: On-policy distillation(OPD)從學生自身策略取樣軌跡,並由教師提供 token 級稠密監督,已成為大型語言模型後訓練的關鍵技術,但其泛化行為仍缺乏系統理解。本文設計受控實驗,逐一變動泛化因子:領域內的難度、語言(英文到中文)與推理長度偏移、跨領域遷移(數學與程式、科學、指令遵循之間),以及多教師 OPD(MOPD)。主要發現有三。其一,OPD 傳遞的是教師的推理行為而非特定答案:教師從未解出的題目與全解出的題目同樣有效,連 GSM8K 或 DeepMath-103K 最難切片都能恢復八成以上增益。其二,遷移範圍取決於師生是否同源:同源教師使學生在跨語言、跨推理長度甚至跨領域都逼近教師水準;跨源教師則主要擬合訓練分布,即使教師本身更強也可能遷移較差。Top-K 重疊率分析顯示同源訓練使整體策略逐步對齊,跨源訓練則否。其三,這種廣泛遷移是雙面刃:教師影響不會被提示路由限制在指定領域,MOPD 中改變教師資料混合比例會產生「翹翹板」效應,各項基準隨份額較大的教師(而非其被指派的領域)移動,甚至出現增加數學資料反而降低數學成績的現象。限制在於僅涵蓋推理導向模型與四個領域,未必延伸到多模態或工具使用情境,MOPD 實驗亦僅含兩位教師與固定路由。此研究釐清 OPD 何時泛化,並為診斷 MOPD 提供實用視角:某領域表現不佳可能源自其他教師的跨領域拉扯,提示路由不應被視為能力或安全邊界。

evidence: Section 5.3 (Table 2): LACE attains overall geometric-mean RE 5.528 [5.181, 5.898] across 24 benchmark-model cells and three budgets, versus 2.647 for the strongest baseline (Plug-in multi), and is best in all 72 cells.

Section 4 and Appendix B: Proposition 1 (calibration-free identification), Theorem 1 (exact group unbiasedness with variance formula), Theorem 2 (first-order adaptivity), Theorem 3/4 (local oracle optimality and gain 1/{1-(1-pi0)R^2(z)}), with full proofs.

Appendix H.1: leave-one-family-out ablation shows pairwise-anchor signals are the largest contributor (largest in 23/24 cells at n=100); ridge-bandwidth grid (Table 27) reports 0/24 cells below RE 1 at default bandwidth and every lambda tested above one in all 72 cells (minimum RE 1.419).

Section 5.2 states the paired-gap and deployment-weighted constructions of Section 3.4 'are theoretical extensions and are not presented as separate empirical experiments'; Appendix J documents the exact judge prompts and the K=6 signals (9 API calls per item).

Appendix I (Table 33): shrinking-bandwidth experiment at M=320,000 confirms Theorem 4 predictions lie inside empirical CI at all three label fractions; Appendix I.4 (Table 34) repeated-pool study gives LACE overall RE 2.127 and best in 72/72 setting-budget combinations.

Section 6 (Limitations): gains require local explanatory power of cheap signals; small groups can make local covariance estimation unstable; theory covers fixed low-dimensional profile spaces only; no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistically rigorous methodology paper for conditional LLM evaluation: LACE estimates Pr(Y=1|Z=z) from scarce gold labels plus cheap LLM-judge/pairwise/confidence signals via local centered control variates. Strongly relevant to LLM (2.5) and evaluation/LLM-as-judge (1.8) preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate and honestly scoped — the centered control-variate algebra is acknowledged as classical (Section 2), with the contribution being the joint conditional vector construction, same-label coefficient learning, and a local gain formula. Rigor and evidence are high: formal theorems with proofs, eight benchmarks x three models x three budgets with matched splits, MC CIs, extensive baselines and stress tests, and simulations validating Theorem 4. Main deductions: core technique is an incremental combination of known ideas, paired-gap and deployment-weighted estimators are theory-only (Section 5.2 note), no explicit code release, and MSE targets are realized-pool gold profiles rather than population profiles in the main experiments.

primary_link.title: Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals

papers.summary: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering
papers.summary_zh: 整體準確率往往掩蓋模型在哪些情境成功、哪些情境失敗，而單靠昂貴的黃金標籤估計條件式效能輪廓，在標註稀少時雜訊過高。本文提出 LACE（Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation），一種半監督式條件評估估計量：以難度、科目等輪廓變數 z 定義條件準確率，黃金結果僅在少量隨機子集上可觀察，而廉價訊號（LLM 評分、與錨定模型的成對比較、自我信心、評審分歧等）可對每個題目取得。其核心為局部中心化：在目標輪廓區域內扣除廉價訊號的條件均值後，任何線性增廣的條件期望為零，故不會改變待估目標；增廣係數僅用於降低變異數，並以局部 ridge 係數結合已標註子集的殘差均值與全題庫的廉價訊號均值。理論上證明免校準識別、分組輪廓無偏、局部最佳增廣與一階自適應，效率增益由局部 R² 刻劃。實驗涵蓋八個基準、三個模型與三種標註預算，相對效率介於 2.73 至 11.03 倍，整體幾何平均約 5.5 倍，且在全部 72 個細胞皆為最佳方法；改用較弱評審模型仍保留大部分增益。限制包括：廉價訊號若缺乏局部解釋力則無增益、標籤相對訊號維度過少時協方差估計不穩，且理論僅涵蓋固定低維輪廓空間，並應避免在黃金標籤有偏時過度依賴廉價訊號。此方法讓細粒度的模型表現報告在少量標註成本下變得可行。

links.title: MELD: A Protocol for Merging Knowledge Across Distributed Agentic Memories

evidence: Abstract: distributed merge recall-non-inferior to centralized under pre-specified equivalence test (0.630 vs 0.619), classifier AUC 0.968 with 0.013 false-merge, status CRDT reconverges 30/30 vs 11/30 last-writer-wins, ~3x fewer messages.

Sec 7.1: HotpotQA distractor, N=200 questions/condition, N=3 brains, overlap 0.5; recall@5 identical across five open-weight models (Qwen2.5 1.5/7/32B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-3-12B) because recall is computed upstream of the LLM; +0.035 vs naive union at ~11% fewer live units.

Sec 7.2: 104-pair gold from a 26-seed fact bank; operating point calibrated on a 9-pair dev set sharing the gold's fact vocabulary (in-distribution caveat stated); macro-F1 0.845, false-merge 1/78 with exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound 0.069.

Sec 7.2 signal ablation ladder: key-only merge-recall 0 (macro-F1 0.100), key+embedding false-merge 0.090, full kappa+sigma+chi macro-F1 0.845 at false-merge 0.013; field contradiction-miss 0/8 on a 48-pair HotpotQA sample.

Sec 7.4 / Table 1: real partition-heal 30/30 reconvergence (Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.905) vs 11/30 for last-writer-wins; Appendix J: anti-entropy digest restores agreement 0.117 to 1.000 at 10% delivery loss.

Sec 6.5: thresholds stated numerically (theta_merge=0.90, sigma_lo=0.12, R_min=0.10), all-MiniLM-L6-v2 encoder and nli-deberta-v3-small NLI named; open repository with Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21878274.

Sec 9.1 / Appendix M: merge graph is order-sensitive (91/200 orderings reproduce the running example; 177/200 distinct fingerprints on a 16-claim workload; retrieval-visible divergence); Appendix L: operating point fails to transfer to mpnet.
Sec 5.4: benign-fault threat model only; no Byzantine defense, group-level HMAC attribution limits, and encoder-aware contradiction evasion acknowledged as out of scope.
Sec 7.8 / Appendix D: per-delta admission 23.5 ms edge CPU / 9.8 ms V100 (NLI 83% of cost); cross-tier Kafka WAN partition-heal 10/10 trials with p50 heal 2990 ms; live latency measured only at N<=4.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A distributed-systems protocol paper for semantically merging sovereign agentic memories; it hits the high-weight Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and Long Context & Memory preferences directly (agent memories, MCP/A2A contrast, knowledge graphs, retrieval), while LLMs are peripheral (recall@k is computed upstream of the answering LLM, Sec 7.1). Novelty is compositional rather than fundamental: the paper itself concedes the three signals (claim-key, embedding similarity, NLI), CRDTs, and pub/sub are standard, and positions prior art in ontology matching and knowledge fusion (Sec 4.1, Sec 8); the merge-on-receive protocol, auditable Patch, and authority gating are a genuine but incremental fill of a stated gap. Rigor is unusually strong: pre-specified TOST equivalence margin, exact Clopper-Pearson bounds, a signal-addition ablation isolating the NLI guard's safety role, gate-necessity probes, and a candid limitations section that even measures its own merge-graph order-sensitivity (91/200 reorderings reproduce the running example). Evidence is solid for deterministic convergence and systems claims but weaker for merge-quality generalization: the 104-pair gold is constructed and calibrated in-distribution on a 9-pair dev set sharing fact vocabulary, the naturalistic contradiction check is 48 pairs/8 contradictions, LongMemEval corroboration is n=40, and live latency is N<=4. Generalizability is bounded by per-encoder threshold non-transfer (mpnet), Byzantine faults explicitly out of scope, and linear candidate-scan cost. Reproducibility is excellent: numeric operating point, seeded deterministic runs, and an archived open repository (Zenodo DOI).

primary_link.title: MELD: A Protocol for Merging Knowledge Across Distributed Agentic Memories

papers.summary: Autonomous agents share a transport and can call each other's tools, but they cannot share what they know: no protocol lets two agents' memories reconcile a fact phrased two ways, link related facts held apart, or reconcile contradictory knowledge without silently discarding either claim. We present MELD, a self-managing coherence mechanism for a federation of agent memories whose run-time model is the knowledge graph itself. Each brain admits every incoming claim through a five-outcome procedur
papers.summary_zh: 自主代理之間已能互相呼叫工具，卻無法共享與調和彼此所知：同一事實以不同措辭儲存時無法合併、相關事實無法連結、矛盾知識也常被默默覆寫而遺失來源。本文提出 MELD，一種針對多個主權代理記憶體（wiki brain）的狀態同步協定。每個大腦在接收聲明時執行五種結果的合併決策程序（insert、merge、relate、conflict、reject），依據三種訊號：範圍化聲明金鑰身分、嵌入相似度與自然語言推論判定，並受情境與新鮮度閘門約束；每次決策輸出唯一且可稽核的 Patch，是唯一能改變本地狀態的物件。協定架構於標準發布/訂閱傳輸（Kafka）之上，以每聲明狀態的 CRDT 達到無協調者的最終一致性，並透過權威階層防止低權威節點悄悄改寫權威大腦。評估在真實三層運算連續體（5G 邊緣、國家級 HPC、本地主機）上進行：分散式合併在 HotpotQA 上的召回率不劣於集中式儲存、優於樸素聯集且節省約 11% 活躍儲存；合併分類器 macro-F1 達 0.845、錯誤合併率 0.013；分割癒合後狀態 CRDT 於 30/30 次試驗重新收斂，而 last-writer-wins 僅 11/30；語義路由以匹配的召回率減少約 3 倍訊息量。限制包括：合併圖結構對訊息順序敏感、協定不裁決真值、僅涵蓋良性故障模型而不防禦拜占庭參與者，閾值亦為經驗校準而非推導所得。
