links.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling

evidence: Abstract & §5, Table 1: looped variants show largest gains on compositional categories (OLMo-2-1B Looped SFT Parallel 26.5 vs 14.5 non-looped; Llama-3.2-1B Looped SFT Parallel 31.0 vs 14.0), while Abstract concedes 'smaller and more model-dependent gains on isolated API invocation'.

§4.1: matched SFT protocol fully specified (Hermes Function-Calling V1, ChatML, seq len 4096, 2 epochs, AdamW lr 2e-5, cosine decay 3% warmup, LoRA rank 32, bf16, A100 80GB), enabling controlled looped vs non-looped comparisons.

§4.3 & §5: fixed-depth inference (depths 1-8 for retrofits, 1-4 for Ouro) varies only inference depth; Figure 5 and Appendix C show depth-3 recovery of a missing dependent NESTful call via $var1.output_0$, supporting the refinement claim, though Appendix C states the figures are 'not representative of the error distribution'.

§7 Limitations: 'no non-looped counterpart trained under identical pretraining conditions is publicly available' for Ouro, and 'all three benchmarks are static, single-turn evaluations'; live multi-turn agentic settings deferred to future work.

Table 3(a): looped retrofits underperform non-looped parents on API-Bank (OLMo loop Call 34.0 vs 37.1, Parse 90.7 vs 99.5), an honestly reported negative result; no seeds, variance, or significance testing appears anywhere, and §4.3 restricts NESTful depth analysis to a fixed 500-example subset.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-LLM agentic paper: evaluates native (Ouro) and retrofitted (Llama-3.2-1B, OLMo-2-1B) looped Transformers on BFCL v3, NESTful, and API-Bank under matched SFT recipes, with inference-depth ablations and adaptive halting. Highly relevant to LLM, agents/tool-use, reasoning, and test-time-compute preferences. Rigor is solid for an empirical study (retrofit comparisons sharing a backbone isolate the architectural change; depth varied at inference separates recurrence from training; limitations candidly stated), but results are single runs with no seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests, and NESTful depth ablations use only a 500-example subset. Novelty is moderate: no new architecture or training method, an evaluation of existing released checkpoints on a previously unexplored axis. Evidence is quantitatively specific and honestly reports negative cases (looped retrofits lose on API-Bank), but key trend claims rest on figures and qualitative examples that authors themselves say are not representative. Generalizability is limited by 1B-2.6B scale models, one SFT dataset (Hermes), and static single-turn benchmarks only; no code release is stated though public checkpoints/benchmarks and full hyperparameters aid reproduction.

primary_link.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling

papers.summary: Looped language models have shown promising results on reasoning benchmarks, yet their potential for agentic tool use remains largely unexplored. We study this question in compositional tool-calling settings, where models must coordinate multiple API calls, maintain intermediate state, and preserve dependencies across tool interactions. We evaluate native and retrofitted looped language models on API-Bank, BFCL, and NESTful, comparing looped and non-looped models trained under matched supervised
papers.summary_zh: 預訓練語言模型日益成為代理系統的決策核心，需協調多個 API 呼叫、維護中間狀態並保留工具互動間的依賴關係。迴圈式語言模型透過反覆套用共享 Transformer 區塊、在潛在表示上迭代精煉，可在不增加參數的情況下提升推論時運算量，但其對代理行為的效益仍少被探討。本文在 API-Bank、BFCL 與 NESTful 三個工具使用基準上，於匹配的監督式微調條件下，評估原生迴圈模型（Ouro-1.4B 與 Ouro-2.6B）以及改造式迴圈模型（基於 Llama-3.2-1B 與 OLMo-2-1B），並比較固定深度與自適應推論。結果顯示：迴圈運算主要提升組合式、依賴感知的工具使用——在 BFCL 的多呼叫類別（Parallel、Parallel-Multiple）與 NESTful 的巢狀工作流程上增益最大，且多步工具使用準確率通常隨遞迴深度增加而上升；但在以單一 API 呼叫為主的 API-Bank 上，增益較小且因模型而異。自適應停止機制依每個 token 的難度分配遞迴迭代，在平均使用較少迭代的情況下恢復深度推論的大部分增益，達到更佳的運算—效能權衡。定性分析顯示迭代能修正函數選擇、呼叫結構與依賴綁定等語義錯誤。限制方面：結論來自受控的靜態單輪評測；Ouro 缺乏相同預訓練條件的非迴圈對照；改造式模型在深層巢狀工作流程上仍遠弱於原生迴圈模型。本研究指出迴圈語言模型是可靠代理系統的有前途架構。
papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
papers.title_zh: 迴圈式語言模型改善組合式工具呼叫

links.title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 1: GRIP outperforms the architecture-matched Llama-3 Iterative control on all five benchmarks (+7.2 EM HotpotQA, +4.1 StrategyQA); paired bootstrap p<0.01 reported only for HotpotQA and SQuAD 2.0
Section 5.4, Table 3: QL dependence drops 14.8->0.47 bits (HotpotQA) and randomization drop is 35.3 vs 7.5 for the matched control; residual alignment rho 0.18 vs 0.61/0.72 for baselines

Section 5.3, Table 2: capacity sweep d_z in {2,4,8,16} is non-monotonic; mechanism controls show deterministic (-2.5 acc) or noise-only full-dim (-4.4 acc) variants insufficient; removing bottleneck raises QL dependence to 14.20 bits

Section 5.2: hallucination is scored by the same in-pipeline DeBERTa verifier used as training-time selection signal; MiniCheck rescoring gives 89.0% agreement (kappa=0.77) and HotpotQA hallucination rises 8.6%->10.1%
Section 6 Limitations: authors concede single Llama-3-8B backbone, CLUB estimator bias/dimension-dependence, and SQuAD 2.0/StrategyQA overlap with parametric knowledge

Section 5.1: three random seeds with std reported (±0.45 EM HotpotQA), shared DPR-Wiki index and compute budget; Table 1 nonetheless shows identical Llama-3 Iterative accuracy (69.3) and hallucination (28.7) on both HotpotQA and StrategyQA

Section 4.3: bottleneck spec d_z=4, sigma^2=1.0, ReLU, mean pooling, Gaussian channel capacity ~2-4 bits/step; Section 5.1: AdamW lr 1e-4, batch 128, 20 epochs, 4xA100; no explicit code release, supplement referenced for appendices
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope RAG/LLM grounding paper: capacity-asymmetric evidence pathway (4-D stochastic bottleneck vs full-dimensional query bypass) to counter query dominance, evaluated with Llama-3-8B on five QA/reasoning benchmarks. Preference relevance is high (RAG, hallucination, LLM reasoning, MI-based probing diagnostics). Novelty is solid: severe fixed-capacity evidence restriction as a design principle differs from retention-oriented compression (xRAG, gist) and prior RAG information-bottleneck filters, plus a new QL-dependence diagnostic. Rigor is above average: architecture-matched iterative control, component/capacity/mechanism ablations, three diagnostics converging, paired bootstrap on two datasets, seed variance, and an independent-verifier check (MiniCheck, kappa=0.77). Evidence is internally consistent (14.8->0.47 bits = ~31x; avg +8.0 EM over Standard RAG checks out; randomization flips 35.8% correct->wrong vs 0.5% wrong->correct match the 35.3-point drop), but weakened by verifier circularity, bootstrap significance reported on only two of five datasets, and Table 1 showing identical Llama-3 Iterative values (69.3 acc, 28.7 hall.) on both HotpotQA and StrategyQA, an unexplained artifact. Generalizability is limited: one backbone, explicit query/evidence pathway separation assumed, parametric-knowledge contamination on SQuAD/StrategyQA acknowledged by authors. Reproducibility is fair: hyperparameters, frozen modules, thresholds, and compute specified, but no code release and key details deferred to an online supplement.

primary_link.title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises

papers.summary: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）本應讓模型依據外部證據作答，但高容量編碼器常使查詢主導潛在狀態，導致檢索到的證據在功能上被邊緣化，模型退回參數化知識，甚至與證據衝突時仍照寫不誤。本文將此失敗模式稱為查詢主導，並提出診斷指標 Query–Latent 依賴 I(Q;z_k)：證據表示若可由查詢高度預測，即代表其淪為查詢的壓縮副本，且與幻覺高度相關。對應的解法 GRIP 採取容量不對稱原則：解碼器對查詢保有全維度通道，而檢索證據經熵引導重排、預測性片段抽取與 NLI 蘊含驗證後，被擠壓至僅 4 維、加性高斯雜訊的隨機瓶頸（每步約 2–4 位元），迫使證據通道只編碼查詢無法提供的殘餘資訊。在 HotpotQA、StrategyQA、2Wiki、ProofWriter 與 SQuAD 2.0 五個基準上，GRIP 全面超越強基線與架構匹配的迭代控制組：HotpotQA 上 EM 提升 7.2 點，幻覺率平均降低 73%，QL 依賴由約 14.8 位元降至 0.47 位元（約 30 倍）；隨機化瓶頸使準確率下滑 35.3 點（對照組僅 7.5），證明解碼器確實依賴證據；殘差對齊分析亦顯示瓶頸輸出與查詢子空間更正交。消融實驗確認維度限制與隨機性缺一不可。限制包括：機制未經形式化反事實驗證、CLUB 估計器有偏差、部分資料集與參數知識重疊，且極端壓縮可能犧牲稀有實體的保真度。
papers.title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
papers.title_zh: GRIP：透過資訊受限前提實現接地推理

links.title: When Context Misleads: Intent-Guided Decoding for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

evidence: Abstract and Table I: IGD reports up to +65.4 points over Direct RAG in truth mode (Qwen3-32B CounterFact 75.4 vs 10.0), with IA gains on all five backbones.
Section IV-C: five instruction-tuned LLMs (Qwen3-32B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-4 14B) evaluated on RTX A6000 and RTX 5090 GPUs.
Section IV-B: six benchmarks, 500 samples each — faithful (KILT-NQ, TriviaQA, SQuAD) and factual-conflict (ConflictBank, NQ-Swap, CounterFact) — with alias cleaning and semantic filtering.
Section IV-C: seven baselines including closed-book diagnostic, Direct RAG, ExplicitSCR, three RCR variants, and MADAM-RAG.
Section VI Table III: ablations of six components only on Qwen2.5-14B; removing token-level correction drops truth-mode factual world accuracy from 73.7 to 52.8.

Figure 3 and Section VI: authors flag the lambda_max/d_truth tuning trade-off as 'a core limitation of the current framework'; no tuning or validation protocol is given for fixed thresholds (rho_M=3.0, tau_low=0.10, tau_high=0.35, q_min values) in Sections III-B/III-C.
Section V-C / Table II: strict-mode comparison is restricted to Direct RAG vs IGD; confidence-reasoning and multi-agent baselines are excluded from strict mode.

Sections III-B/III-C: Supp, Qual, and AnsCons reliability functions are defined only informally, limiting reimplementation fidelity despite the stated replication package (footnote 1, GitHub repository).
No statistical significance tests, confidence intervals, or multi-seed variance are reported anywhere in Sections IV-VI.

Figure 5: an honest negative result showing the GPT-5 snippet localizer improves standalone support accuracy (83.0→99.0 faithful) but slightly degrades downstream IGD, indicating the pipeline is not trivially improvable.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on the factuality/faithfulness trade-off in RAG, directly matching LLM, RAG & Knowledge, and evaluation/safety preferences. The intent-conditioned, bidirectional source arbitration at decoding time is a reasonably fresh angle, though it builds on known contrastive/controlled-decoding ideas and situated-faithfulness confidence baselines. Evaluation is broad (5 LLMs, 6 benchmarks, 7 baselines, 6-component ablations, sensitivity analysis, PRR metric) and gains are large and consistent, but there are no significance tests or variance estimates, ablations cover only one model, fixed hyperparameters have no described tuning protocol, strict-mode baselines are limited to Direct RAG, and several reliability functions are underspecified. Code release is claimed via a GitHub footnote, supporting moderate reproducibility.

primary_link.title: When Context Misleads: Intent-Guided Decoding for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding generation in external evidence, but it also introduces a source trust problem: retrieved context may be useful, irrelevant, or even misleading. Existing RAG systems often apply a fixed trust policy toward retrieved evidence, which can either over-trust incorrect context or underuse context when the user explicitly asks for context-following behavior. Therefore, we propose Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD), a framework t
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成(RAG)雖透過外部證據提升大型語言模型,卻帶來來源信任問題:檢索到的內容可能有用、無關甚至誤導,而既有系統多採固定信任策略,難以兼顧事實性與忠實性。本文提出意圖引導解碼(Intent-Guided Decoding, IGD),在解碼階段依使用者意圖於檢索情境與參數記憶之間仲裁。IGD 將生成拆解為使用者、情境與記憶三個分支,先以答案層級的記憶篩選器處理高信心個案,再對其餘案例施加 token 層級修正:以 Jensen-Shannon 散度偵測情境與記憶的分布衝突以啟動閘門,結合以熵為基礎的分支信心與指令模式先驗決定修正方向,並依所選來源的可靠度縮放干預強度。在 KILT-NQ、TriviaQA、SQuAD 三個忠實問答基準與 ConflictBank、NQ-Swap、CounterFact 三個事實衝突基準上,涵蓋五個指令微調模型的實驗顯示,IGD 相較 Direct RAG 在事實衝突基準最高提升 65.4 個百分點,同時在 strict 模式下保留或改善情境遵循行為;消融實驗證明 token 層級修正是核心機制。局限在於固定全域超參數造成調校取捨,且部分輸出轉入其他答案類別,顯示記憶分支不穩時仍有殘餘不確定性。此研究凸顯依使用者意圖平衡事實性與忠實性,是 RAG 實務的重要課題。
papers.title: When Context Misleads: Intent-Guided Decoding for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 當上下文誤導時:以意圖引導解碼強化穩健的檢索增強生成

links.title: Security Assessment of DeepSeek Harness with A.I.G: Evaluating Resistance to Indirect Prompt Injection

evidence: Abstract: strongest observed attack success rates are 17.0% under J_L for fake-completion in text mode, 25.5% under J_R for hidden Unicode in file mode, 16.0% under J_R for skills in file mode; code available at github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard Research path
Section 5.1: dataset is balanced across 16 channels, two carrier modes, 35 payload objectives with 1,120 base cases; one baseline plus 12 attack methods produces 14,560 runtime executions
Section 6.1, Table 3: J_R assigns 819/14,560 (5.6%) full success, J_L assigns 772 (5.3%); partial compliance 2.0% vs 7.3%; judge error 0 for J_R and 9 (0.1%) for J_L
Section 6.5, Table 6: hidden Unicode channel shows 0.0% J_R full success in text mode versus 25.5% (116 of 455 runs) in file mode; skills channel 14.3%/16.0%
Section 6.3, Key Finding 2: output-only canary objectives reach 35.7% J_L full success versus 2.5% for sink-required objectives, motivating separate reporting
Section 4.2: DSH source snapshot inspected at commit 47f943859bef; tool-calls.ts additionalContexts path and ToolGuard deny-only hook identified as control points
Appendix B: all sink tools are simulated; percentages are 'descriptive measurements for this controlled configuration, not claims of universal vulnerability rates'

Appendix A, Table 7: artifact map lists A.I.G components, dataset, runner, adapter, driver, test plugin, trace corpus, and offline judge corpus, but does not explicitly confirm public release of the dataset or judge prompts
Section 8: positions work against InjecAgent, AgentDojo, BIPIA, StruQ, and spotlighting; explicitly does not compare mitigations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: this is an agent-security/red-teaming evaluation (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation are top-weight preferences), assessing indirect prompt injection in a real agent harness (DeepSeek Harness) rather than a synthetic proxy. Novelty is moderate: the source-to-sink taint framing, dual judge design (RuleJudge/LLMJudge), and attack methods largely follow established practice (InjecAgent, AgentDojo are cited as prior benchmarks); the file-mode vs text-mode carrier distinction and the hidden-Unicode/skills findings are the more original empirical contributions. Rigor is solid for a technical report: a balanced 14,560-run matrix, naive baseline, mutually exclusive outcome categories, denominators explicitly reconciled, and code-grounded analysis of the target's guard hooks; however, there is a single model backend (deepseek-v4-flash), no variance/significance reporting, no defense comparison, and LLMJudge validation is thin (only '9 (0.1%) judge error' in Table 3 with no methodology for that measurement). Evidence strength benefits from verifiable counts (e.g., 116/455 = 25.5%; 254+387 sink calls = 4.4%) and appropriately hedged claims, but simulated sinks mean results measure attempted actions only. Generalizability is limited: authors themselves state in Appendix B that percentages are descriptive for one controlled configuration of one framework and model. Reproducibility is partially supported: a concrete code URL is given in the abstract and Appendix A maps artifacts, but release of the 1,120-case dataset and judge prompts is not explicitly confirmed.

primary_link.title: Security Assessment of DeepSeek Harness with A.I.G: Evaluating Resistance to Indirect Prompt Injection

papers.summary: We assess indirect prompt injection in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using AI-Infra-Guard (A.I.G) to construct tests, deliver controlled taint, execute DSH, collect traces, and judge outcomes. The study covers 14,560 controlled executions over 16 indirect-content channels, text and file carrier modes, 35 payload objectives, one unmodified baseline, and 12 attack methods. The experiment preserves DSH's agent loop, tool registry, model adapter, and session-event path; source tools and sensitive sinks ar
papers.summary_zh: 使用工具的語言模型代理常需讀取使用者未撰寫的內容,如網頁、電子郵件或檔案,這些內容可能夾帶與使用者指示相競爭的指令,構成間接提示注入風險。本報告來自騰訊朱雀實驗室,以 AI-Infra-Guard(A.I.G)對開源代理框架 DeepSeek Harness(DSH)進行真實執行環境的安全評估:涵蓋 14,560 次受控執行、16 個間接內容通道、文字與檔案兩種載體模式、35 個酬載目標、一個未修改基線與 12 種攻擊方法,並保留 DSH 原生的代理迴圈、工具註冊與工作階段事件路徑;所有敏感匯點皆為本機模擬,不產生外部副作用。每條來源到匯點的追蹤,分別以確定性規則裁判 RuleJudge 與語意 LLM 裁判 LLMJudge 判定。結果顯示最強攻擊成功率:文字模式下 fake completion 達 17.0%(LLMJudge),檔案模式下隱藏 Unicode 達 25.5%、skills 通道達 16.0%(皆為規則裁判);檔案模式整體高於文字模式,輸出型目標(35.7%)遠高於需觸發匯點者(2.5%),兩種裁判對部分配合的判定分歧亦有診斷價值。研究據此提出部署建議:保留來源溯源、獨立授權敏感匯點、將 skills 與整合視為需治理的資產,並在變更後重跑測試矩陣。此評測說明安全邊界橫跨從外部內容到敏感動作的完整執行路徑。

papers.title_zh: 以 A.I.G 評估 DeepSeek Harness 的安全性:間接提示注入抗性之檢驗

links.title: Coverage Is Not Containment: A Fundamental Limit of Admission-Time Defenses Against Coordinated Poisoning of Vector Retrieval

evidence: Abstract & §IV-E/Fig. 2: end-to-end pipeline BGE-large + HNSW + Qwen2.5-7B emits the planted canary claim in 88% of targets vs 0% clean baseline.
§VI-D/Fig. 5: gradient-boosted classifier on comprehensive class-D batch features separates attack from location-matched admissible uploads at AUC 0.46 (chance), catching only 4.2% at 1% FPR.

§VI-B Proposition 1: recall − FPR ≤ TV(A_δ, B) for all ingestion-blind defenses, with explicit scope statement excluding demand/provenance defenses; proof sketch relies on Neyman-Pearson/data-processing.
§VI-F/Table II: combined-defense covert residual 7.6–9.3/10 across five encoders (MiniLM-L6 to E5-large) spanning ~12× anisotropy range, five seeds each.

§VIII/Fig. 9: retrieval-time demand detector achieves 100% recall at 1% FPR on 300 attacks vs 300 legitimate fresh uploads; authors note vulnerability to synthetic-demand and popular-query adaptations.
§IX Limitations: admits overlap premise is empirical, evaluation is English single-vector dense retrieval on a static snapshot; late-interaction/sparse/hybrid and multilingual untested.
§IV-B vs Table I: text claims delta=1.0 cones 'finally fall out of the top-k' while Table I reports 3.1 covert slots at delta=1.00, a small inconsistency in the adaptive-game narrative.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A RAG/vector-store security paper squarely matching RAG & Knowledge and AI Safety preferences: corpus poisoning, dense retrieval, vector databases, adversarial defense, with an LLM (Qwen2.5-7B) in the end-to-end loop, though the LLM is the harmed downstream component rather than the methodological focus. Contribution is a scoped impossibility claim (Prop. 1, TV/Neyman-Pearson bound over ingestion-blind defenses) plus a measured chance-level separation (AUC 0.46 against location-matched benign uploads) and a demand-aware retrieval-time escape. Rigor is above average: careful threat model, location-matched benign control (a key design strength), five seeds with 95% CIs, ablations (geometry-matched cone), two corpora, five encoders, k/m/n sweeps, and unusually honest scoping in Limitations. The near-total-overlap premise of the 'fundamental limit' is established empirically via one classifier family, not proven, so the class-level claim is evidence-bounded; the 100%-recall demand detector is evaluated under a constructed benign mix the authors admit is fragile to adaptive responses (synthetic demand, popular targets). Minor internal tension: text says wide cones (delta=1.0) 'fall out of the top-k' while Table I reports 3.1 covert slots at delta=1.00. Reproducibility is moderately supported (detailed configs, seeds, named models, artifact claimed) but no verifiable release link is given.

primary_link.title: Coverage Is Not Containment: A Fundamental Limit of Admission-Time Defenses Against Coordinated Poisoning of Vector Retrieval

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers a question by retrieving passages from a vector store and trusting them as context, so anyone who can add documents can try to steer the answer. A recent, appealing defense filters poisoning at ingestion, rejecting any document that behaves like a hub. We show it -- and every ingestion-time filter -- is defeated by a coordinated adversary that injects a handful of individually unremarkable documents which together surround one target query and seize i
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成將向量資料庫視為安全邊界,能新增文件者即可誘導答案。近期防禦主張在文件準入時,以哨兵查詢的反向 kNN 計數過濾類樞紐文件。本文證明此類準入時防禦無法抵擋協同式攻擊:攻擊者注入 m 份各自不起眼的文件,在目標查詢周圍構成緊密錐形,即可在 BGE-large/BEIR 上以 m=10 奪取 10/10 的 top-k 名額(實際 HNSW 索引為 9.9/10);在 BGE-large + HNSW + Qwen2.5-7B 的完整管線中,以流暢自然語言文件讓生成器在 88% 的目標上輸出攻擊者植入的宣告,乾淨基線則為 0%。作者進一步設計集體準入統計量(近重複爆發、共同檢索)與自適應賽局,仍留下約 4.5/10 的隱蔽殘餘,並以命題 1 證明此極限適用於整個僅依文件與哨兵決策的準入時防禦類別:最強的梯度提升分類器將攻擊與位置相符的合法小眾上傳區分開的能力不優於隨機(1% 誤報率下僅偵測 4.2%)。關鍵差異訊號是查詢需求,只有在檢索時可見;實作的需求感知偵測器在同一誤報率下達到 100% 召回。局限包括極限僅限於準入盲測類別、對具有真實有機需求的目標偵測會減弱,且僅測英文語料與稠密檢索。此研究指出覆蓋查詢空間不等於遏制投毒,防禦必須跨越準入門檻,結合需求監控與來源信任。

Title footnote / Thanks: code, data, and full reproducibility archive at Zenodo DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20161743; Appendices A-D give hyperparameters, per-run and per-variant tables.
Section 5 (Conclusion): explicit limitations - one extractor per problem family, no human feedback in loop, MiniZinc-only input, reliance on strong commercial LLM backends.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: LLMs in a check-fix-verify loop synthesize executable Python feature extractors for algorithm selection, directly matching the LLM, agents/tool-use, and code-generation preferences; the combinatorial-optimization application domain is not in the out-of-scope list. Novelty is solid but incremental: the agentic error-correction loop is standard engineering, and LLM feature engineering (CAAFE, FeatLLM) and neural AS features (trans2feat) exist; the contribution is the synthesis of complete reusable extractor programs from declarative MiniZinc models. Rigor is good but imperfect: multiple baselines (mzn2feat, 20 trans2feat variants, SB/VBS), four toolchains, 10 independent synthesis runs with best/mean/worst reporting, backend sensitivity and cost analysis; however the loop-ablation claim ('removing any step produced zero executable extractors', Section 3/4.9) is supported only by unspecified 'pilot ablations' with no table, and no statistical significance tests are shown despite the promise in Appendix C. Evidence is strong: reported gaps check out arithmetically (FLECC RF 84.7% vs mzn2feat 76.4% = 8.3pp; vs best trans2feat 77.3% = 7.4pp; CS RF 58.3% vs 52.9% = 5.4pp) and even worst LLM2feat runs beat best trans2feat, though instance counts per split are unstated and failed runs are excluded (disclosed). Generalizability is capped by the MiniZinc-only formalism, one extractor per problem family, and total failure of open-weight backends. Reproducibility is excellent: Zenodo archive, prompts, hyperparameters, and LLM call sites are released.

primary_link.title: Synthesizing Feature Extractors: An Agentic Approach for Algorithm Selection

papers.summary: Algorithm selection for constraint satisfaction problems requires extracting features that capture problem structure. Manually designing feature extractors demands deep domain expertise and quickly becomes a bottleneck when new problem classes appear. We present an automated approach that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) in an agentic check--fix--verify loop to synthesize executable Python scripts that act as interpretable, problem-specific feature extractors. Given a high-level MiniZinc model
papers.summary_zh: 演算法選擇需為問題實例擷取能反映結構的特徵,但人工設計特徵擷取器仰賴深厚領域專業,當新問題類別出現時易成瓶頸。本文提出以大型語言模型代理自動合成可執行的 Python 程式作為可解釋特徵擷取器:代理讀取高階 MiniZinc 模型與實例,在 check–fix–verify 錯誤修正迴圈中反覆清除、插入、檢查並執行程式,產出建構型別圖表示並計算 50 個結構特徵(如圖密度、變數聚類、約束緊密度)的腳本。作者以 Gurobi、CPLEX、SCIP、Gecode、OR-Tools 五款先進求解器組合,在車輛路由(VRP)、汽車排序(CS)與定長糾錯碼(FLECC)三個組合問題上評估。合成的 LLM2feat 特徵訓練出的選擇器,在所有問題與工具鏈組合上一致優於專家策展的 mzn2feat(最高提升 8.3 個百分點)與最佳的 Transformer 式 trans2feat 變體(FLECC 上 7.4、CS 上 5.4 個百分點),且特徵相關性更低、有效利用率更高。每個擷取器的合成成本約 210 秒與 0.27 美元,程式碼可檢視、可由專家修正,形成灰盒設計。局限包括每個問題家族僅產出一個擷取器、輸入形式受限於 MiniZinc,且所測的開源權重後端皆無法遵循協定,可靠合成目前仍需商業模型。此工作大幅降低演算法選擇管線的人工特徵工程門檻。
papers.title: Synthesizing Feature Extractors: An Agentic Approach for Algorithm Selection
papers.title_zh: 合成特徵擷取器:以代理式方法進行演算法選擇

links.title: The Commercial Tax: Rent-vs-Own Blind Spots in Multi-Hop Retrieval Benchmarks

evidence: Abstract: Nemotron-3-Embed-8B matches anchor at +0.24 Recall@5 (95% CI [-0.94, +1.43], p=0.69); pre-release commercial gap 2.31 points (95% CI [0.91, 3.71], p=0.001)
Section 4.3: Holm-Bonferroni over twelve pairwise comparisons; Dunnett-type max-t critical value 2.7821 (panel_simultaneous_ci.) verified by independent re-implementation returning 2.7935

Section 5.1: authors report their own corpus-format indexing defect understated the anchor by 2.5 points, changing the headline from 'exceeds' to 'matches'; corrected anchor 69.55 within 0.15 of protocol paper's 69.7
Section 6 Limitations: 2WikiMultihopQA pilot shows the commercial-tax magnitude does not replicate (0.12, 95% CI [-1.07, +0.82], p=0.82), narrowing the claim to 'on this corpus'
Code and Data Availability: harness, per-question recall vectors, multiplicity artifacts, scripts, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21972866, HuggingFace embedding mirror pinned to revision hash bd00a9c3
Section 4.4: license audit finds 0 of 3 anchor-dependent systems disclose cc-by-nc-4.0, with search terms and repository-level search methodology stated for re-running
Section 3.3: audited set described as relevance-seeded snowball sample, explicitly not a systematic review or prevalence claim
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement/audit study of RAG retrieval benchmarks, squarely matching the RAG & Knowledge preference (dense retrieval, embedding, knowledge-base deployment) with secondary hits on LLM serving cost and benchmark datasets, but no methodology contribution to the highest-weight LLM/agent/reasoning preferences. Novelty is solid rather than high: the rent-vs-own framing, model-dependency license audit one layer below dataset audits (Longpre et al.), and the one-time-vs-recurring cost decomposition are fresh, but the underlying embedder evaluation is standard dense retrieval. Rigor is exceptional: paired bootstrap (B=1e5), pre-specified primary comparison, Holm-Bonferroni over 47 tests, computed Dunnett-type critical value with an independent re-implementation cross-check, explicit power/equivalence analysis (MDE ~1.7 points; TOST needs n~33,700), disclosed uneven query-sweep attempts, and a self-reported indexing defect that changed the headline verb from 'exceeds' to 'matches'. Evidence is strong within scope: license facts verified from primary sources with stated search terms, cost figures traced to arXiv LaTeX source, and all rejections survive correction; the honest 2Wiki pilot showing the tax magnitude does not replicate (0.12, p=0.82) is reported rather than hidden. Generalizability is the weak point: one corpus, snowball audit sample explicitly not a prevalence claim, hosted-endpoint drift, and corpus-specific magnitudes. Reproducibility is outstanding: full harness, per-question recall vectors for all thirteen entrants, regeneration scripts, Zenodo DOI with pinned HuggingFace mirror, exact prompts/decoding parameters, and the defective script published alongside the corrected one. No unsupported claims found; competing interests disclosed with analysis of where they could and could not bias results.

primary_link.title: The Commercial Tax: Rent-vs-Own Blind Spots in Multi-Hop Retrieval Benchmarks

papers.summary: Enterprises connect language models to their own data through retrieval. The benchmarks that rank multi-hop retrieval systems leave out two facts a buyer needs before a published number can be used: whether the retrieval backbone may be deployed commercially, and what it costs to build. On licensing: the field's dense-retrieval anchor, NV-Embed-v2, is licensed cc-by-nc-4.0. Of the four leading MuSiQue systems we audit (HippoRAG-2, PropRAG, SAG, KET-RAG), three depend on it for their best numbers
papers.summary_zh: 本論文指出,企業以檢索增強生成(RAG)將語言模型接上內部資料,但多跳檢索基準(以 MuSiQue 與 HippoRAG-2 協定為主)的公開數字,未揭露買家最需要的兩項資訊:檢索主幹能否合法商用、以及建置成本。授權查證方面,該領域的稠密檢索錨點 NV-Embed-v2 採 cc-by-nc-4.0 非商用授權,受稽核的四大系統(HippoRAG-2、PropRAG、SAG、KET-RAG)中,三者最佳成績依賴它卻皆未揭露,KET-RAG 則改用 OpenAI 商用 API 嵌入器。在同一套評測架上量測十三個嵌入模型後,作者發現 2026 年 6 月前存在真實的「商業稅」:最佳商用嵌入器 Gemini embedding-001 落後錨點 2.31 個 Recall@5 百分點(p=0.001);同年 7 月 NVIDIA 推出的 Nemotron-3-Embed-8B 使差距不再可測(+0.24,p=0.69),是唯一同時具商用授權、可自行架設、且與錨點統計上無法區分的模型。成本面,五個受稽核系統中三個未揭露索引成本;GraphRAG 的第三方報價在單一論文內相差 11 倍,線性外推至 1TB 約為 42.8 萬與 460 萬美元之別。限制包括:僅單一基準與語料、外推假設可能低估圖建構成本、2Wiki 先導實驗顯示稅額大小隨語料而異。本文的價值在於把「可否合法部署」與「要花多少錢」帶回基準報告,並強調開源權重不等於可商用。
papers.title: The Commercial Tax: Rent-vs-Own Blind Spots in Multi-Hop Retrieval Benchmarks
papers.title_zh: 商業稅:多跳檢索基準中租用與自建的盲點

links.title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: FT-1100 falls to 0.7% coverage on APIGen; TF-IDF routing raises mixed-stream coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%
§5.2: query-side TF-IDF weighted r=-0.85 vs semantic -0.58; leave-one-config-out accuracy 78.9%, F1 0.88
Appendix A.3 Table 26: detector rests on 19 configs, 95% accuracy CI [54.4, 93.9], authors call it a compatibility routing criterion
Appendix A.3 Table 17: paired bootstrap for main fine-tuning gains, +19.0 [10.8, 27.2] and +19.3 [15.4, 23.1]
Appendix A.3 Table 12: non-monotonic few-shot sweep (reversechain 50-shot 84.6% below 20-shot 89.7%) with cautious framing
Appendix A.4 Table 31: MetaTool cross-family fine-tuning shows no collapse, bounding the source-style claim
Appendix A.5 Tables 33-35: collapse and switch policy persist under skill-card rendering and MCP-lite normalization (22.3%→25.1%)
Limitations: single primary benchmark, no independent multi-source corpus replication, supervision-availability scoping
Title block: Joseph James listed with chenghua.lin@manchester.ac.uk, an authorship metadata inconsistency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: the paper studies the tool-retrieval gate for LLM agents (tool routing, MCP/orchestration, tool RAG), matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and RAG preferences, though the LLM itself is downstream rather than the object of study. The contribution—'source-style collapse' of a source-fine-tuned dense retriever over a fixed tool corpus, with a cheap TF-IDF centroid detector and a route-then-repair policy (ToolScout)—is a plausible and practically useful finding built on known dense-retrieval domain-shift literature; the framing and lexical-overlap paradox are novel but the ingredients are standard. Rigor is above average: hard-negative ablation (Table 8), mixed-training controls (Table 10), query-only rewrite and paired synthetic-source controls (Tables 29-30), skill-card and MCP-lite rendering controls (Tables 33-35), and paired bootstrap CIs (Table 17) support the headline claims. Weaknesses: the detector evaluation rests on only 19 source-level samples with a wide 95% CI (Table 26: [54.4, 93.9]); the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy is a custom metric; few-shot sweeps are non-monotonic (Table 12: reversechain 50-shot 84.6% < 20-shot 89.7%); small test splits (39 queries for reversechain) are flagged but thin; and the headline results are essentially single-benchmark (ToolRet), with MetaTool explicitly showing no collapse (Table 31), which the authors honestly bound. Reproducibility is moderate: deterministic query-hash splits and a deterministic card template are given and an artifact is referenced, but no explicit code/data release link appears, and the title block contains an authorship metadata inconsistency (Joseph James listed with chenghua.lin@manchester.ac.uk). Overall a solid, well-controlled empirical study with clear practical relevance, limited by single-benchmark scope and small-n detector statistics.

primary_link.title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval

papers.summary: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-110
papers.summary_zh: 大型代理系統依賴檢索層存取外部工具與 API,若候選生成漏掉正確工具,後續重排與規劃皆無法補救。本文在 ToolRet 基準上發現「來源風格崩塌」:僅以 toolbench 風格 1,100 筆查詢微調的檢索器 FT-1100,在同一工具語料庫的其他來源切片上急遽失效,於 APIGen 僅剩 0.7% 覆蓋率、ToolACE 為 0.0%,且崩塌無法以詞彙重疊解釋——APIGen 與黃金工具的詞彙重疊反而更高。作者提出 ToolScout,以查詢端 TF-IDF 中心距離作為輕量相容性訊號,在來源風格可能不符時將流量導向聚合訓練的檢查點,並在取得少量配對監督後進行持續微調修復。在混合 4,996 筆查詢流上,TF-IDF 路由將覆蓋率由 22.3% 提升至 86.1%;於五個崩塌來源上,20 筆配對範例將覆蓋加權全域 top-1 代理指標由 1.3% 提升至 53.9%。該訊號的 leave-one-config-out 偵測準確率為 78.9%,優於語義或長度代理指標。將工具重新渲染為可執行技能卡後,崩塌與路由行為依舊存在,排除原始 API 綱要格式為唯一成因。限制包括:細部分析多集中於 1,100 筆查詢的 web 子集、修復成效取決於監督資料的累積速度、層級式路由主要在 StableToolBench 上驗證。此研究提醒:可靠工具代理須先守住檢索閘門,來源感知路由是低成本的防護手段。

links.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence

evidence: Abstract + Table 2: claimed 21.8-32.2% latency and 18.1-30.3% token reductions vs self-consistency; arithmetically verified from Table 2 averages (e.g., Qwen SC latency avg 247.05s vs ParaTempo 193.3s = 21.8%; tokens 225.15k vs 156.95k = 30.3%).

Section 5.2: 'ParaTempo achieves 71.1% average accuracy, within 1.1 percentage points of SC (72.2%)' on Qwen; Table 2 shows consistent accuracy drops vs SC on math benchmarks (e.g., AIME26 83.3 vs 87.5; GPT-OSS HMMT26 51.5 vs 56.8), so Eq. 1's constraint A(pi) >= A(pi_fixed) is not strictly satisfied.

Section 3.1-3.2 + Table 1: motivating signal study (probes every tau=500, K=16, '>90 million reasoning tokens') quantifies volatility, Spearman |rho|<=0.13 and AUC<=0.58 for token-level signals vs 0.41/0.71 for instantaneous answer confidence, grounding the design of temporal confidence.

Section 5.4 + Table 3: ablations on HMMT25 (Qwen) show w/o Retire reduces accuracy by 6.6 points and w/o Fork by 3.3 points, supporting each control component; extended ablations deferred to 'Technical Supplement'.

Section 5.1 Implementation Details: full hyperparameters (W=7, X=9, N_warm=15, q_prune=0.50, theta_retire=0.90, gamma_ES=0.50), vLLM on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, nucleus sampling (T=0.6, p=0.95), K=16, results averaged over four runs; Section 1 footnote provides code/dataset URL (availability claim not independently verified).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM methodology: a training-free, inference-time control framework for parallel reasoning of large reasoning models (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, GPT-OSS-20B), matching the Reasoning/CoT, LLM, Scaling & Efficiency, and Inference & Serving preferences. Novelty is moderate rather than high: intermediate answer probing, answer-convergence stopping, confidence filtering, and forking all exist (Parallel-Probe, SAC, ESC, DeepConf, TRACE are cited), and the contribution is a window-averaged entropy signal plus asynchronous branch lifecycle control combining known primitives. Rigor is solid but imperfect: formulation, motivating signal study, six baselines, ablations (Table 3), and Pareto analysis are present, but no significance tests/error bars despite 4-run averaging, and the formal objective (Eq. 1, accuracy >= fixed budget) is not strictly achieved (ParaTempo 71.1% vs SC 72.2% avg on Qwen; ~64.2 vs 71.8 on GPT-OSS math benchmarks), so 'competitive accuracy' is a slightly generous framing the tables themselves expose. Evidence strength is high on internal consistency: the abstract's 21.8-32.2% latency and 18.1-30.3% token reductions and the 3.8-3.9 point gain over Parallel-Probe reproduce exactly from Table 2 averages. Generalizability is limited to short-answer/MCQ tasks where answer buckets can be formed from logprobs; two reasoning-tuned models only, no open-ended tasks. Reproducibility is good: full hyperparameters, vLLM/single-A100 setup, benchmark names, 4-run protocol, pseudocode in supplement, and a code URL (unverified).

primary_link.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence

papers.summary: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count. Existing methods for managing these parallel paths typically rely on final-answer consensus, local token confidence, or isolated intermediate probes. However, these signals are often delayed, weakly tied to actual reasoning progress, or too noisy for dynamic, branch-level control. To address these limitatio
papers.summary_zh: 平行推理透過同時探索多條解題路徑提升大型推理模型的準確性,但運算成本隨分支數與推理深度成長;現有控制訊號如最終答案共識、token 級信心或單次中間探測,分別有延遲、與推理進度關聯薄弱或過於雜訊等問題。本文提出免訓練的非同步平行推理框架 ParaTempo,核心是「時間性信心」:定期對每個分支注入強制作答前綴以取得暫定答案分布,在滑動視窗內聚合近期探測,以指數化負熵衡量答案空間的收斂程度。此單一訊號驅動整個控制流程:低信心分支遭剪枝、持續收斂的分支提前退休、釋出的運算預算以分叉重新分配,當信心加權投票集中時全域提前停止,全程不需跨分支同步。實驗在 AIME 2026、HMMT 兩場次與 GPQA Diamond 上,以 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 與 GPT-OSS-20B 進行:相較自我一致性,平均延遲降低 21.8–32.2%、總生成 token 減少 18.1–30.3%,準確率仍具競爭力;相較最強的平行控制器 Parallel-Probe,準確率提升 3.8–3.9 個百分點。分析顯示時間性信心的波動低於 token 級與瞬時訊號,對未來收斂的預測力更強;消融實驗證明剪枝、退休與分叉各有明確貢獻。限制在於僅評測數學與科學推理任務,並於單張 A100 GPU 上運行,跨領域泛化仍待驗證。其價值在於為測試時運算擴展提供更精準的分支級資源分配。
papers.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
papers.title_zh: ParaTempo:透過時間性信心實現高效平行推理

links.title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness

evidence: Abstract: black-box RL improves Pass@1 on ClawGym-Bench by 9.98 and 14.81 points through OpenClaw and Claude Code with Qwen3-30A3B, stable over 200-400 optimization steps.

Sec 3.2.1: captured model calls are organized into a rollout-level prefix tree that reconstructs shared interaction structure, with dead-leaf, over-branching, and auxiliary-trajectory filtering in Sec 3.2.2.
Sec 3.2.4 / Eq. 10: training-inference consistency via black-box token-in-token-out discipline plus truncated token-level importance-sampling rollout correction between pi_rollout and pi_old.
Sec 4.1.2 / Table 1: ClawII-OC-30A3B and ClawII-CC-30A3B raise ClawGym-Bench average from 45.11 to 62.62 and 37.06 to 51.87, exceeding Qwen3-235A23B baselines by 8.14 and 6.28 points.
Sec 4.2: GRPO uses 32 tasks x 8 rollouts and PPO 256 tasks x 1 rollout, matching rollout budget per update; both remain stable across ~200-400 steps with broadly comparable final results.
Sec 4.4: extension to JobBench-style and OfficeQA-style tasks with Claude Code improves evaluation from 20.46 to 27.20 (JobBench-Easy) and 8.53 to 21.54 (OfficeQA-Full).
Sec 4.6 / Table 2: WhiteBox-30A3B reaches 59.90 under the training AgentLoop but only 50.33 under OpenClaw vs 62.62 for ClawII-OC-30A3B, showing white-to-black transfer is incomplete.
Sec 3.2.3: simplified PPO uses gamma=1, lambda=1 with no advantage propagation across branch points; authors acknowledge increased advantage variance and defer principled treatment.
Sec 4.1.1: rubric-based judgments use GPT-5.4 (prompt in Appendix A); PinchBench evaluation retains only 30 tasks, limiting evidence strength.

No code or data availability statement appears in the provided text; training depends on the proprietary Claude Code harness and closed GPT-5.4 judge, and hyperparameters (learning rate, clip epsilon, KL beta, truncation threshold, over-branching threshold) are not reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM work: black-box RL (PPO/GRPO) through opaque agent harnesses, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Training & Optimization). Systems contribution is mostly a careful integration of known techniques (prefix trees [12], token-in-token-out [9], IS rollout correction [34]); the mix-harness joint training with per task-harness-pair advantage grouping is the most original element. Experiments are broad (two harnesses, two scales, PPO vs GRPO with matched rollout budget, cold-start ablation, white-box vs black-box comparison) but self-reported without variance/significance, judged partly by GPT-5.4 rubrics, and PinchBench evaluation uses only 30 tasks. Reproducibility is limited by reliance on the proprietary Claude Code harness, a closed judge, missing hyperparameters, and no stated code release.

primary_link.title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness

However, reinforcement learning through complex harnesses remains largely unexplored, as scaling such training to long-horizon agent tasks introduces fundamental challenges. In this work, we present a unified black-box RL framework for stable and scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses. Concretely, we first build a sandbox-based executio
papers.summary_zh: 代理 harness(如 Claude Code、OpenClaw)協調語言模型與環境的互動,能大幅提升長時程任務表現,但透過這類不透明框架進行強化學習(RL)仍少有研究:大規模併發 rollout 需要隔離的有狀態環境、黑箱執行產生碎片化的模型呼叫、訓練與推論不一致則危及穩定性。本文提出統一的黑箱 RL 框架:以沙箱基礎設施隔離任務環境與 harness;在模型服務邊界以代理攔截所有模型呼叫,將捕獲的呼叫組織成前綴樹以重建多輪軌跡,並改造 PPO 與 GRPO 於樹狀結構上最佳化;以 token-in-token-out 準則與 token 級重要性抽樣維持訓練—推論一致性;另提出混合 harness 訓練,讓單一模型同時由異質 harness 最佳化。以 Qwen3-30A3B 為骨幹,黑箱 RL 分別透過 OpenClaw 與 Claude Code 使 ClawGym-Bench 的 Pass@1 提升 9.98 與 14.81 個百分點,200–400 步內保持穩定,PinchBench 亦分別提升 11.71 與 17.28 分;混合 harness 訓練可匹敵單一 harness 訓練;延伸至 JobBench(20.46→27.20)與 OfficeQA(8.53→21.54)同樣穩定獲益。對照顯示白箱 AgentLoop RL 在自建迴圈內更佳,但遷移到黑箱 harness 時仍落於直接訓練的模型之後。限制包括目前排除子代理與壓縮等輔助軌跡的訓練利用,PPO 信用分配採簡化處理。此框架證明複雜部署框架可直接作為訓練介面,為打造通用代理奠定實用基礎。

papers.title_zh: ClawGym II:在代理執行框架上探索黑箱強化學習

links.title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: RUPA is a trajectory-level UQ framework for LLM agents evaluated on tau-2, Terminal-Bench-2, and GAIA with 6 open-source LLMs (26B-230B), claiming better AUROC, earlier failure detection, and improved uncertainty-guided execution
Section 5.1: baselines are Entropy, Seq-prob, SAUP, Tracer, UProp evaluated with AUROC, AUPRC, best F1; models Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Gemma-4-26B/31B-it, GPT-OSS-120B, MiniMax-M2.7
Table 2 (Section 5.2): RUPA best on all six models; MiniMax-M2.7 average AUROC improves 0.694 (Tracer) to 0.718, Qwen3.5-27B 0.608 to 0.656, Gemma4-26B 0.761 (SAUP) to 0.780

Section 5.4/Table 4: ablations only on MiniMax-M2.7; removing graph modeling drops AUROC 0.718->0.678 and AUPRC 0.805->0.642; random graph 0.681 AUROC, supporting that gains come from dependency structure
Table 3 (Section 5.3): uncertainty-guided sampling lifts Qwen3.5-27B TB2 accuracy 0.105 (random) to 0.213, but GAIA gains are modest (Entropy 0.282 vs Ours 0.297)
Section 5.3 Fig 4: entropy-matched analysis on GAIA/MiniMax-M2.7; in low-entropy bin RUPA reaches AUROC ~0.85 while probability-based UQ is ~0.5
Section 3/Table 1: preliminary study shows Seq. Prob. AUROC 0.205 (Airline) and Verbalize 0.485, motivating trajectory-level UQ; verbalized baseline absent from main Table 2

Appendix A.1/A.2: bge-m3 embeddings and lexical cue edge construction, hyperparameters in Tables 5-6, Harbor framework, temperature 0.7, 3 samples per query; SAUP and UProp reimplemented since no official code; code link https://github.com/icip-cas/RUPA stated in contributions footnote
Appendix A.2: claims outcome-blind calibration using only unlabeled training trajectories, parameters fixed across model families and datasets
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: trajectory-level uncertainty quantification for LLM agents (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5, AI Safety/Evaluation), a methodological contribution rather than a pure domain application. The core novelty is moderate but genuine: recasting agent trajectories as directed relational dependency graphs (seven relation types) with relation-aware uncertainty propagation, beyond prior sequential aggregators (SAUP, Tracer, UProp). Rigor is solid but not exceptional: 3 benchmarks x 6 open-source LLMs with AUROC/AUPRC/F1, a useful random-graph control and prefix-based early-detection and entropy-matched analyses; however there are no statistical significance tests or variance estimates over only 3 samples, the ablation and sensitivity studies are run on a single model/dataset, downstream guided-sampling gains on GAIA are small (0.282->0.297 over Entropy), and there is no limitations section. Evidence is broad and internally consistent (e.g., MiniMax-M2.7 average AUROC 0.694->0.718; Qwen3.5-27B 0.608->0.656) though gains are sometimes marginal and verbalized confidence from the motivating study is dropped from the main comparison. Generalizability is supported by fixed outcome-blind hyperparameters across model families, but only open-weight models with token probabilities are covered. Reproducibility is good: public code link, full hyperparameter tables, edge-strength table, and honest disclosure that SAUP/UProp were reimplemented.

primary_link.title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents

papers.summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying large language model (LLM) agents in complex interactive environments. Existing UQ methods largely rely on local signals, such as token probabilities, predictive entropy, or per-step confidence, and therefore overlook the long-range dependencies through which errors accumulate across an execution trajectory. As a result, they may fail to identify agent failures whose causes originate several reasoning or interaction steps before
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理執行長程多步任務時，現有不確定性量化（UQ）方法多依賴局部訊號（如 token 機率、預測熵），忽略錯誤會沿著執行軌跡跨步驟累積與傳播的長程依賴，因而難以及早辨識代理失敗。本文提出 RUPA，一個軌跡層級的 UQ 框架：將執行歷程轉換為有向軌跡圖，節點代表推理狀態、工具呼叫與環境回饋，邊則捕捉時序與語意依賴（如重複行為、進展延續、回饋衝突、目標對齊），並以關係感知的邊權重在圖上傳播不確定性，再與局部不確定性結合，產生步級與軌跡層級的信心估計。作者在 τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2 與 GAIA 三個基準上，以六個 26B 至 230B 參數的開源模型驗證：RUPA 在所有模型家族皆取得最佳 AUROC、AUPRC 與 F1（例如 MiniMax-M2.7 的平均 AUROC 由 0.694 提升至 0.718）；在前綴式評估中能更早偵測失敗風險；在不確定性引導的多樣本解碼中持續提升任務成功率。消融實驗顯示關係式圖建模與傳播機制為主要貢獻來源，且在熵值相近的軌跡中圖訊號仍具判別力。此工作證明顯式建模執行步驟間的關係依賴，是建構可信長程代理的關鍵基礎。
papers.title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 從序列到結構：LLM 代理的關係式不確定性傳播

links.title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery

evidence: Abstract + Section 4.1: pipeline uses gpt-oss-120b (labeling), gemini-3.5-flash (extraction), gemini-3.1-pro with web search (checking), gpt-5.5 xhigh (attempting/judging/grading); each of 4,717 conjectures received one opencode-agent attempt.
Section 4.2 funnel: 4,717 attempted -> 2,905 NONE / 443 KNOWN / 319 FIX / 1,050 NEW -> 598 PASS judging -> 75 already known / 446 minor / 77 publishable artifacts.

Section 4.2: authors reviewed 15 of 77 artifacts 'chosen by our own interest' and report all correct; Section 5.1 admits one (Erdos divisor-difference) was already settled months earlier by Price with ChatGPT-5.2, missed by the cascade.
Section 4.3.1: agent difficulty score AUC 0.69 vs no accepted resolution (p<10^-40), importance AUC 0.60 vs graded publishable (p=0.008), stratified AUC 0.56 (p<10^-5), Spearman 0.83 between scores.

Section 4.3.2 + Appendix B.2: allocation strategies compared against uniform baseline via 5-fold cross-validation averaged over 1000 partitions at B in {10,...,300}; ranking on p-hat dominates f1, top-1/10-importance restriction best for f3.

Section 5.3 + Appendix C: new results verified by authors/domain experts, e.g., many-one GapP-completeness of ComputeCharBinary (Theorem C.6.1), C5 square K_{m,m} counterexample with ratio tending 24/13 (Theorem C.3.1), d*(n)=1 for Erdos-Straus (Theorem C.5.1).
Reproducibility: title-page footnote gives code at https://github.com/zeyu-zheng/FAR; artifacts at https://probxiv.com; full prompt templates in Appendix A; corpus from OpenAlex (Section 4.1).

Limitations acknowledged in Section 4.3.2 ('results depend on the scoring model, on the sources... and on the models in the cascade') and Section 5.1-5.2 (one known result and one known construction surfaced as new).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant LLM-agent systems paper: FAR uses frontier models (gpt-5.5, gemini-3.x, gpt-oss-120b) as agents with web search to mine open conjectures from 51,110 papers, attempt them at scale, and triage outputs for expert review - squarely in the agentic LLM, reasoning, and scientific-discovery preferences. Novelty is solid: reframing AI-for-math around problem selection/effort allocation (a literature-to-review cascade analogous to recommender systems) is a genuinely new interface, and the constrained-optimization allocation analysis (exact strategies for f1/f2, submodular greedy for f3) is a clean contribution, though built from standard bandit/cascade ideas. Rigor is mixed: the pipeline and prompts are documented (Appendix A), score validity is statistically checked (difficulty AUC 0.69, p<1e-40; importance AUC 0.60, p=0.008; stratified AUC 0.56), and full appendix proofs of 13+ results are given; but correctness rests on LLM judges plus author-only review of a 15/77 subset, with no formal verification and a single-domain pilot. Evidence is substantial for the funnel (4,717->1,050 NEW->598 PASS->77 artifacts) and includes genuinely novel results (Ikenmeyer-Pak-Panova GapP-completeness proof, Davies-Jenssen-Perkins-Roberts counterexample, Erdos-Straus density result), yet evaluation is one run with retrospective cross-validated allocation curves rather than controlled comparisons, and the paper itself reports misses (a solved Erdos problem graded as new). Generalizability beyond combinatorics and the specific scoring models is asserted but untested. Reproducibility is moderate: code link, prompts, model names, and OpenAlex source are given, though no seeds/costs.

primary_link.title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery

papers.summary: AI systems are increasingly capable of contributing to mathematical research. In research practice, frontier-model reasoning is a limited resource, and expert mathematical review is even more sharply constrained. Allocating these scarce resources well is therefore central to making AI-assisted mathematical discovery efficient. In most current AI-for-math workflows, human effort is concentrated at the beginning and end, in selecting suitable research problems and later reviewing the resulting art
papers.summary_zh: 在 AI 輔助數學研究的主流流程中，人類心力集中於挑選問題與審查成果兩端，已成為研究級數學發現的瓶頸。本文提出新的人機協作典範：專家不再預先給定單一問題，而是指定感興趣的研究方向，系統在龐大文獻語料中搜尋並篩選值得嘗試的開放問題。受搜尋與推薦系統啟發，作者建構 FAR（Find, Attempt, Recommend）文獻到審查的級聯流程：先標記相關論文並抽取未解陳述，驗證其仍屬開放後形成候選池，再逐題嘗試證明或反證，最後由評審代理篩選出值得專家審閱的成果。在組合數學試驗中，流程自 51,110 篇論文標記出 5,245 篇，抽取 6,453 個候選，驗證後得 4,717 個仍開放的猜想；嘗試階段產生 1,050 個解，598 個通過評審，77 個被評為可發表，作者人工審閱的 15 件成果全數數學正確，涵蓋 Davies–Jenssen–Perkins–Roberts、Ikenmeyer–Pak–Panova、Lund–Saraf–Wolf 等猜想的證明或反例。論文並將有限嘗試預算的分配形式化為約束最佳化問題，利用模型給出的難度與重要性分數推導分配策略，實證其優於均勻分配，且最佳策略隨最佳化目標而異。此研究展示了從「解決問題」到「決定解決哪些問題」的規模化路徑。
papers.title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery
papers.title_zh: 問題即是問題：邁向可規模化的數學發現

links.title: LineageRAG: Harnessing GraphRAG by Constructing Evidence Lineages with Source Grounding

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that LineageRAG improves R@5, EM, and F1 by 3.51, 5.96, and 5.22 points on average over leading GraphRAG baselines.'

Section 5 (Main Results, Table 1): LineageRAG reaches 89.57 R@5 / 58.22 EM / 69.63 F1 macro-average and 'ranks first in seven of the nine dataset–metric cells among GraphRAG systems'; on 2WikiMultiHopQA G-reasoner's EM/F1 are '0.80 and 0.24 points higher.'

Section 5 (Ablation Study, Table 2): removing Source Grounding leaves R@5 unchanged at 76.53 but cuts MuSiQue EM from 42.70 to 36.50 and F1 from 55.76 to 50.11; removing Lineage Expansion costs 2.15 R@5.

Section 5 (Mechanism Analysis, Table 5): shuffled demand–passage provenance lowers R@5 to 68.42, '8.11 points below correct provenance and 5.16 points below removing it,' supporting the provenance mechanism claim.

Section 5 (Implementation details): Qwen3-32B builds the OpenIE graph, HippoRAG 2 PPR with damping 0.5, NV-Embed-v2 embeddings, GPT-4o-mini reader, temperature 0; prompts deferred to supplementary material and no code/data availability statement appears.
Section 5 (Baselines): 'ETS-7B and Relink use the published results obtained with their native readers,' a protocol mismatch with the rerun GPT-4o-mini-reader comparisons.
Section 5 (Computational Cost, Table 8): query-time token use rises from 0.63M to 1.51M per 1,000 queries (2.40x) for gains of 3.53 R@5, 6.82 EM, 5.73 F1 over HippoRAG 2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A GraphRAG methodology paper squarely within preferred topics: retrieval-augmented generation with LLM-driven query decomposition, multi-hop reasoning, and source grounding. The contribution—maintaining demand-passage provenance from graph retrieval through selection to verbatim span grounding—is a sensible but incremental packaging of known ingredients (question decomposition, set-wise selection, span extraction), with prior work (SETR, QD, RichRAG, NeocorRAG) already covering parts. Rigor is above average: 11 baselines across four families, three-component ablations, a gain-attribution analysis (Table 3), and a strong provenance-manipulation control (shuffled provenance drops R@5 to 68.42, Table 5). Weaknesses: ablations and mechanism analysis only on MuSiQue, two baselines (ETS-7B, Relink) compared under native-reader published numbers, no significance testing, and LineageRAG does not lead on 2WikiMultiHopQA EM/F1 vs G-reasoner (honestly acknowledged). Quantitative claims are internally consistent (the 3.51/5.96/5.22 averages verify against Table 1 macro-averages). Generalizability limited to multi-hop QA at 1,000-query benchmark scale; no code release is mentioned and results depend on GPT-4o-mini/Qwen3-32B, capping reproducibility.

primary_link.title: LineageRAG: Harnessing GraphRAG by Constructing Evidence Lineages with Source Grounding

papers.summary: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) retrieves evidence for multi-hop questions over structured cor- pus graphs. Existing GraphRAG methods leave the connection between evidence discovery and source grounding implicit. We propose LineageRAG, which constructs one evidence lin- eage for each query-derived evidence demand and completes it with a verbatim source span when the selected evidence supports that demand. LineageRAG first initializes the evi- dence demands. It then expands
papers.summary_zh: 基於圖的檢索增強生成（GraphRAG）能在多跳問答中檢索證據，但現有方法讓「證據發現」與「來源錨定」之間的連結保持隱式，最終證據集未記錄每份來源背後的資訊需求，導致證據鏈不完整。本文提出 LineageRAG，為每個查詢衍生的證據需求建立一條證據譜系，並在需求獲得支援時以逐字來源片段完成之。方法分三階段：證據需求歸納將查詢分解為有序需求；需求條件化的譜系擴展對每個需求獨立檢索，並在合併候選時保留需求—文件的溯源關聯；譜系完成與來源錨定利用此溯源選出互補文件，並驗證連結至需求的逐字片段有效性。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 與 MuSiQue 上，LineageRAG 的 R@5、EM、F1 平均較領先 GraphRAG 基線提升 3.51、5.96 與 5.22 個百分點。機制分析顯示：僅採用集合式選擇可貢獻 1.30 點 R@5，其餘增益來自證據譜系；打亂正確溯源會使 R@5 大幅下滑至 68.42，證明選擇效果源自需求—文件對應；在固定文件下僅加入錨定片段即可提升 EM 6.20 點。成本方面，每千次查詢的查詢時 token 消耗由 0.63M 增至 1.51M。此工作顯示顯式維護證據譜系可同時改善證據選擇與閱讀器端的證據運用。
papers.title: LineageRAG: Harnessing GraphRAG by Constructing Evidence Lineages with Source Grounding
papers.title_zh: LineageRAG：透過建構證據譜系與來源錨定善用 GraphRAG

links.title: KnowSim: Evaluating Information Calibration in LLM Assistants with User Simulators that Learn

evidence: §5.1 Table 3: pooled sign agreement 73% MathQA (27/37, p=.003) and 74% ExpertQA (26/35, p=.003), per-arm rates 67-80%
§5.2 Fig 4: KnowSim 77% IQ sign agreement (p=.008) vs ZS-CoT-Prof 73%, ZS 68%, ZS-CoT 64% on 22 pooled signal pairs
§3.2-3.3: ~60 Prolific participants per arm, 705 sessions total, stratified by 10-item prescreening tests, pre/post knowledge tests on MathQA, IRB approval
§6 Table 4: aptitude-treatment results, e.g., DeepSeek V4 novice KG=15.5 with CO=0.945 vs Gemini 3.1 Pro novice CO=0.875; best model shifts by knowledge level
Appendix D.3 Table 11: participant-level IQ negatively correlates with objective KG (pooled ρ=-0.268, p<.01), motivating deterministic metrics
Limitations: no motivational/affective dynamics, KG saturation for advanced users, two-domain scope, multi-LLM-call cost per turn
Appendix A.5 Table 6 and §A.6: full state-update weights, capacity formula τ=max(2, round(0.55·|G_q|)), termination parameters disclosed
Ethical Considerations: KnowChat dataset and simulator code released under CC BY-NC 4.0
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM evaluation-methodology work: a knowledge-state-grounded user simulator (IU prerequisite graphs, learning-theory update rules) with deterministic metrics (KG, DC, CO) for multi-turn LLM assistant assessment, validated against 705 human-AI sessions and applied to 9 frontier LLMs. Strongly aligned with LLM, evaluation/benchmark, and dialogue NLP preferences; partial alignment with reasoning (math task, CoT baseline) and prompting. Novelty is solid—explicit evolving knowledge states for user simulators extends SimulatorArena-style work rather than replacing it. Rigor is good: prescreening stratification validated via Kruskal-Wallis, sign-agreement with binomial tests, threshold sensitivity ([0.10,0.20]), Spearman corroboration, and Jaccard concept-coverage checks; but per-arm analyses rest on few signal pairs (13-20), human KG values are near floor/ceiling, and the headline benchmark (ATI patterns) is simulator-derived without human validation of those specific rankings. Evidence for simulator validity is reasonably strong (73-74% pooled agreement, p=.003) though the margin over the strongest baseline is narrow (77% vs 73% on 22 pairs). Generalizability is constrained to knowledge-intensive tasks with reference answers for IU graph construction; authors acknowledge missing motivational dynamics and throughput costs. Reproducibility is above average: code and dataset released under CC BY-NC 4.0, full prompts and parameter values in appendices, model versions specified.

primary_link.title: KnowSim: Evaluating Information Calibration in LLM Assistants with User Simulators that Learn

papers.summary: To effectively collaborate with users on knowledge-intensive tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) must perform information calibration: matching content to a user's evolving understanding and cognitive capacity. Yet user simulators used to evaluate and train LLMs do not explicitly model user knowledge so they neither produce realistic interactions across knowledge levels nor reflect how interactions unfold as that knowledge evolves. To close this gap, we introduce KNOWSIM, an evaluation framework
papers.summary_zh: 要與使用者協作知識密集任務，LLM 必須做到資訊校準：依使用者的知識狀態與認知容量，調整資訊的數量、深度與順序。然而現有使用者模擬器未顯式建模使用者知識，既無法模擬不同知識層級的真實互動，也無法客觀衡量知識增益。本文提出 KnowSim，以維護顯式知識狀態的使用者模擬器為核心：狀態表示為資訊單元構成的有向無環圖，節點間以先修關係連結，並依據學習理論的更新規則（先修上限、認知過載、單調性）逐輪演化，對話終止亦由學習進展觸發。框架直接由狀態軌跡計算三項指標：知識增益、交付校準與認知過載，提供機制層面的解釋。作者蒐集 705 場真人—AI 對話（KnowChat），涵蓋競賽數學與專家問答兩領域，並按知識層級分層招募參與者；KnowSim 與人類判斷的排序一致率達 73–74%，優於三個基線模擬器，其中新手層級對齊最佳。應用於 9 個 LLM 時，發現最佳模型隨使用者知識層級而改變：DeepSeek V4 為新手帶來最高知識增益但過載嚴重，Gemini 3.1 Pro 對進階使用者校準最佳，揭露傳統排行榜看不見的性向—處理交互作用與公平性落差。此工作為資訊校準提供可解釋且可規模化的評估基礎。
papers.title: KnowSim: Evaluating Information Calibration in LLM Assistants with User Simulators that Learn
papers.title_zh: KnowSim：以會學習的使用者模擬器評估 LLM 助理的資訊校準

links.title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: 'Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.'

Section 4.1: 'all runs use Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507'; tasks are Reasoning Gym (K∈{1,8}), CodeIO (K=4, Pvf receives other K−1=3 responses and returns), and multi-turn Sudoku (Pvf receives complete solved grid).
