Section 4.3: 'Pvf explains more return variance than VF in every environment,' with EV gap correlating with final reward gaps (Figure 4).

Appendix B: 'Our value function implementation is open sourced as prime-values, built on top of PRIME-RL'; Appendix D Tables 1-2 give policy/value hyperparameters (lr, AdamW settings, replay reuse N=2, value warmup 20 updates, λtarget=λGAE=1.0).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-RL methods paper: value functions for LLM policy gradients, privileged critic conditioning, and an adaptive group/value baseline (Tether), directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reinforcement learning, reasoning, training optimization). Novelty is moderate: the authors themselves credit asymmetric/privileged actor-critic work in robotics (Appendix A; Pinto et al. 2017, Baisero & Amato 2022, Hu et al. 2024) and Tether has a close concurrent analog (EVPO, hard endpoint choice vs. smooth interpolation, Appendix C), so the contribution is an adaptation plus a cheap adaptive mixture rather than a new principle. Rigor is solid but modest: controlled comparisons (VF and Pvf share value-training config and compute, Section 8/Appendix D), unbiasedness conditions (Eq. 5, 12), explained-variance analysis (Section 4.3), and a statistical analysis of Tether (Appendix C); however only 2-3 seeds per run (Figure 3 caption), no significance testing, and evaluation is training reward rather than held-out benchmarks. Evidence strength is limited accordingly: consistent directional gains across four tasks are shown, but effect sizes are read from EMA-smoothed curves. Generalizability is supported by four diverse tasks (single-turn, multi-turn, code, formal math) but restricted to 4B models (Section 8) and untested in agentic/long-horizon settings. Reproducibility is good: open-sourced infra (prime-values, Appendix B), full hyperparameter tables (Appendix D), though task mixture weights and dataset specifics are underspecified.

primary_link.title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. Howe
papers.summary_zh: 強化學習是 LLM 後訓練的核心，但主流的 GRPO 等群組相對方法僅提供序列層級的優勢估計，且訓練會被最慢的 rollout 拖慢；價值函數理論上可提供 token 級信用分配並免除大型群組需求，卻因基礎設施負擔而乏人問津。本文提出兩項互補策略：其一為 Privileged Value Functions（Pvf），讓 critic 在訓練時額外看到策略無法取得的資訊，如參考解答或 leave-one-out 群組軌跡與其回饋；只要滿足可允許條件，便能在不改變策略梯度期望下降低變異數。其二為 Tether，以最小平方法自適應擬合群組基線與價值基線的混合係數，再以 EMA 平滑，在兩者間平滑內插。實驗涵蓋 Reasoning Gym、CodeIO、Sudoku 與 MiniF2F，使用 Qwen3-4B 系列模型，結果顯示兩法一致優於普通價值基線，並與 GRPO 相當或更佳；多回合的 Sudoku 獲益最大，解釋變異數分析亦佐證特權條件化確實改善價值估計。作者另發現將 GAE 的 λ 設為極接近 1 的值（如 0.999888）對長序列訓練影響顯著。限制包括價值函數需額外 GPU 配置、實驗僅限 4B 模型與較短回應長度，且與無 critic 方法未完全對齊計算量。本文為價值函數重新融入 LLM RL 提供低風險路徑。
papers.title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Le Critique：用於 LLM 強化學習的特權價值函數

links.title: TRCA: Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment for Long-horizon LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: TRCA improves WebShop score by 6.0%-12.6% (Qwen2.5-7B) and average SearchQA by 1.9%-18.3% (Qwen2.5-3B) over evaluated baselines.
Table 1 caption: ALFWorld/WebShop results averaged over 3 random seeds with standard deviations; Table 2 (SearchQA) reports no std or seed count.
Sec 4.4 Ablation Study + Fig 3: removing either Foundational or Breakthrough Rubric Reward consistently degrades performance on all three benchmarks (figure-only, no numeric table).
Appendix D.6: Propositions 1-4 with proofs on reward boundedness, novel-coverage monotonicity, non-degenerate zero-success credit, and conditional variance reduction, with explicit scope caveats.

Appendix A.1: LLM invoked once per benchmark to build operator libraries (five operators per category, fifteen total); Appendix A.2/A.3: deterministic binders and rule-based transition evaluation, no online judge during training.
Appendix E.1-E.2: diagnostic study uses 16 tasks x 8 rollouts per batch (128 rollouts), human + GPT-4o annotation, aggregate ratios 96.5%/85.6%/72.2%.
Appendix F.2 Table 5 + F.7: full RL hyperparameters (lr 8e-7, gamma 0.95, lambda 0.8), four NVIDIA A800 80GB GPUs; no code or data release statement appears anywhere in the document.

Sec 3.4 / Appendix D.3: step grouping explicitly 'following the group-in-group framework' (GiGPO), indicating heavy reliance on prior scaffolding; rubric rewards (RaR, GEAR, RIFL) acknowledged in Sec 2.3.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope core LLM-methodology paper (agent RL training, not a capped category), strongly aligned with LLM, agents/tool-use, and RL preferences. Contribution is an incremental but competently executed combination: GiGPO-style context step-grouping fused with offline LLM-generated deterministic rubric operators (Evidence/Invalidity/Execution) yielding two reward forms, avoiding success anchors and online process evaluators. Evidence is broad (ALFWorld, WebShop, seven QA benchmarks, 1.5B/3B/7B scales, 3 seeds with std on ALFWorld/WebShop, ablations, lambda sensitivity, four propositions with proofs), but SearchQA tables lack seed/variance reporting, ablation results exist only as figures, operator-library precision/recall is not quantitatively validated, and no code release is stated. Generalizability is tempered by benchmark-specific handcrafted adapters and binders required per environment.

primary_link.title: TRCA: Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment for Long-horizon LLM Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents are typically optimized with sparse terminal outcomes, making fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step interactions difficult. Existing approaches either rely on process evaluators, which incur annotation and inference costs, or derive step-level credit from successful trajectories. However, successful trajectories are extremely scarce during early-stage reinforcement learning, substantially weakening anchor-based methods. We propose Transit
papers.summary_zh: 長時程 LLM 代理多以稀疏終端獎勵訓練，信用分配粗糙；現有解法若需昂貴的流程評估器，或依賴成功軌跡作為錨點，但早期訓練成功樣本極稀缺（個案顯示 96.5% rollout 失敗、85.6% 群組無任何成功軌跡）。本文提出 TRCA，直接從動作引發的狀態轉移提取步驟層級監督，不需學習型評估器或成功錨點。方法以 Evidence、Invalidity、Execution 三類規準評估每次轉移：規準運算子由 LLM 離線建構一次，訓練全程採確定性布林判定，不再呼叫模型。Foundational Rubric Reward 對判定加總，提供廣泛的正負號監督；Breakthrough Rubric Reward 追蹤正向條件的累積覆蓋勢能，只獎勵新達成的任務進展；兩者與終端結果結合，透過 episode 與上下文層級的相對優勢進行 PPO 式最佳化。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與七個搜尋增強問答基準上，TRCA 一致超越 PPO、GRPO、GiGPO、GraphGPO 等基線：Qwen2.5-7B 於 WebShop 提升 6.0%–12.6%，Qwen2.5-3B 於 SearchQA 平均提升 1.9%–18.3%，樣本效率也明顯優於 GRPO。消融實驗證實兩種獎勵互補，混合係數 λ=0.8 最佳。限制在於規準庫依賴各基準的操作子設計，理論保證亦僅涵蓋局部回饋變異數。其價值在於證明失敗軌跡仍蘊含可靠監督訊號。
papers.title: TRCA: Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment for Long-horizon LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: TRCA：長時程 LLM 代理的轉移層級規準信用分配

links.title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents

evidence: Abstract: LENS achieves 62.4% EM and 84.8% evidence recall vs ReAct's 65.2% EM and 50.4% evidence recall on the 500-question controlled evaluation.
Section 6.6: McNemar tests show no significant LENS-ReAct EM difference on D500 (p=0.1143) or fullwiki dev-150 (p=1.0000); LENS uses 16.5K tokens/query vs ReAct 11.8K.
Table 6 (Section 6.7): w/o Sequential Exploration drops EM 43.3→38.0 and Ev.Rec 45.0→31.0 on dev-150; w/o Multi-signal Prior keeps EM 43.3 and slightly improves Ev.Rec (45.4) and Ground (85.3).
Table 5 (Section 6.5): stale-index arm shows BM25-RAG EM −28.0 pp and Ev.Rec −70.1 pp vs LENS EM −2.4 pp, Ev.Rec −0.8 pp under D125→D250 corpus growth.

Section 7: 'The present evidence is still bounded. HotpotQA emphasizes lookup and comparison over encyclopedic text, so richer document layouts, aggregation intents, table evidence, and warm-reuse behavior remain future work.'
Appendix F, Table 11: lifecycle audit reports LENS and ReAct query-ready with 0 index build/storage vs BM25-RAG (4.0s, 10.0MB) and Hybrid-RAG (5.7s, 54.9MB).

Appendix B/C: Proposition 1 proves only subset compression of the search space; Proposition 2 is a per-stage oracle-call count (4+2L), with the authors noting the bound is loose and the GLR stopping rule is 'conceptual' because LLM likelihoods are unavailable in closed form (Appendix D, Remark 4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent/RAG methodology paper: index-free, budgeted evidence localization over dynamic raw documents using an LLM relevance oracle, bandit-style proposal policies, and per-fact belief updates. Strongly matches Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: the formulation (latent evidence space, GLR stopping, information-directed proposals) is a clean but incremental combination of ReAct-style iteration, BM25 priors, and best-arm-identification ideas. Rigor is above average for protocol design (frozen nested samples with checksums, matched snapshots, Closed-Book reference, staleness arm, failure taxonomy, McNemar tests) but limited by a single benchmark (HotpotQA), n=500/150 scales, one backend model, thin theory (Prop 1 is subset arithmetic; Prop 2 is call accounting), and an ablation where removing the multi-signal prior leaves EM unchanged (43.3) and slightly raises Ev.Rec/Ground, undercutting a headline component. Evidence is internally consistent across tables and honestly framed: LENS does not beat ReAct on EM (62.4 vs 65.2, p=0.1143) and its claim is confined to evidence recall (84.8 vs 50.4) and grounding (96.8 vs 71.8), at higher token cost (16.5K vs 11.8K). Generalizability is bounded to encyclopedic lookup/comparison intents, acknowledged by the authors. Reproducibility is decent (hyperparameters, hardware, seeds, artifact-package claims) but no verifiable public link appears in the text.

primary_link.title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents

papers.summary:
LLM agents increasingly answer questions over dynamic raw-document collections, where files may change before preprocessing, and relevant evidence (spans, sections, pages, or tables) is query-dependent. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches pre-materialize evidence via fixed chunking, embeddings, or persistent indexes: effective for lookup, yet costly, stale-prone, and committed to a granularity before the query is known.
  We formulate in-context search as Budgeted Evidence Localization over
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理常需在持續增修的原始文件集上回答問題，但現有檢索增強方法預先建立分塊、向量或索引，造成前置成本高、文件更新後索引過時，且在查詢前便固定了證據粒度。本文將情境內搜尋形式化為對潛在證據空間的「預算化證據定位」，提出免索引框架 LENS：先以詞彙錨點、文件路徑、既有摘要與歷史搜尋證據等低成本訊號建立查詢條件化先驗，接著在預算內執行「提出—觀察—更新」循環，以 LLM 作為相關性 oracle，逐一更新各原子事實的信念，並依停止準則決定收斂時機，最後將選出區域整合為可溯源的緊湊證據集再合成答案。在 HotpotQA 控制式 500 題評測上，LENS 達到 62.4% EM、84.8% 證據召回與 96.8% 可溯源答案；ReAct 雖有 65.2% EM，證據召回僅 50.4%。在 150 題 raw Wikipedia fullwiki 上兩者 EM 相當（43.3% 對 42.7%），但 LENS 的 grounding 為 84.0% 對 70.7%。過時索引實驗顯示 BM25 與混合式 RAG 在語料成長後 EM 掉約 28 個百分點、證據召回近乎歸零，LENS 則立即可用。限制包括每題 token 成本較高（16.5K 對 11.8K）、評測集中於查詢與比較型意圖。其意義在於為動態語料提供可稽核、即時就緒的證據定位能力。
papers.title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents
papers.title_zh: LENS：透過動態原始文件上的潛在證據探索進行情境內搜尋

links.title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory

evidence: Abstract: claims gains up to +11.51 on GAIA and +11.18 on WebWalkerQA over ten memory baselines with GPT-4o and Qwen3-30B-A3B
Table 1: GPT-4o GAIA SR 44.24 (vs PlugMem 41.94, No Memory 32.73); xBench-Qwen3 HyperSkill 52.00 ties DILU 52.00 rather than beating it
Section 4.3 / Figure 4(c): ablation with Qwen3-30B-A3B shows w/o hypergraph lowest (41.00/35.76/44.71 vs full 52.00/36.97/50.59), confirming structural contribution
Section 4.3 sensitivity: retrieval budget k=2 best across benchmarks; maintenance ratio peaks at rho=0.1, rho=0 degrades retrieval quality
Appendix B.4 Table 2: self-judge variant retains 87.7-96.8% of GT-judge performance (largest gap -5.37 SR on GAIA)

Appendix A.1: benchmarks are small (GAIA 165 tasks, WebWalkerQA 170-query subset, xBench 100 tasks); Appendix A.2: fixed seed 42, temperature 0.7, single sequential run, no variance or significance tests reported
Appendix A.2: full implementation detail (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 encoder, budgets (2,2,2)/(5,5,5), tau_prune=0.2, N_min=3, beta=0.7, delta_merge=0.85, vLLM on A100 80GB); Appendix I provides all prompts
Limitations: extra LLM calls for decomposition/extraction/merging add inference cost; evaluation limited to web navigation and multi-step reasoning; limited benefit in low-data regimes
Footnote after abstract: 'Code is available at' followed by missing/empty URL, weakening availability claim
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit paper on self-evolving LLM agent memory (Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Long Context & Memory all strongly matched; GPT-4o and Qwen3-30B-A3B backbones; tool-use/web benchmarks). Novelty is moderate: hypergraphs are established, and the contribution is a sensible combination of n-ary hyperedges, dual-path retrieval, and quality-weighted maintenance over prior pairwise-graph memories (G-Memory, PlugMem), with the 'first n-ary experiential memory' claim plausible but incremental. Rigor is solid in breadth (10 baselines, 3 benchmarks, ablations of both retrieval paths and hypergraph structure, sensitivity to k and rho, self-judge robustness in B.4, latency and memory-growth analyses) but limited by small benchmarks (xBench n=100, GAIA n=165, WQA 170-query subset), a single seed with temperature 0.7 and no repeated runs, no significance testing, and a tie with DILU (52.00) on xBench-Qwen3 that the narrative soft-pedals. Evidence is internally consistent (e.g., +11.51 GAIA = 44.24 vs 32.73; ablation numbers in Fig. 4c match text), yet figures are unverifiable and the code URL is missing. Reproducibility is good (full hyperparameters, prompts in Appendix I, algorithms in Appendix H, MemEvolve codebase) but the empty code link and API dependence reduce it. Generalizability is decent across two model families but demonstrated only on web/agent QA-style tasks with benchmark-specific decomposition prompts.

primary_link.title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory

papers.summary: As agentic tasks grow in complexity, LLM agents increasingly rely on experiential memory to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks. Effective memory design must jointly address what to store, how memory is structured and retrieved, and how memory evolves. Existing systems tackle each only partially: they store trajectories, insights, or workflows as isolated entries, discarding compositional relationships among subtasks and reusable skills; retrieve by flat embedding similarity that ignores rel
papers.summary_zh: 自演化 LLM 代理依賴經驗記憶跨任務重用程序性知識，但現有系統僅部分解決三個設計問題：儲存什麼、如何結構化與檢索、記憶如何演化——平面向量庫丟棄子任務與技能間的組合關係，純語意相似度檢索忽略關聯訊號，維護亦缺乏結構意識。本文提出 HyperSkill，將經驗記憶組織為超圖：節點分為子任務與可重用技能兩類，每條超邊對應單一軌跡，串連其子任務、技能、蒸餾教訓與效用分數。檢索採雙路徑：子任務路徑先分解新任務並比對子任務節點，再展開至相連超邊；軌跡路徑以完整任務描述比對超邊嵌入；候選技能依出現於已檢索軌跡的共現次數排名。記憶演化包含品質驅動剪枝與結構感知合併，後者利用品質加權傳播所得的結構嵌入合併冗餘技能。在 xBench、GAIA 與 WebWalkerQA 上搭配 GPT-4o 與 Qwen3-30B-A3B，HyperSkill 勝過十種記憶基線，相對無記憶基線於 GAIA 最高提升 11.51、WebWalkerQA 提升 11.18 個百分點，並在中等 token 成本下達到最佳效能成本比。消融實驗證實兩條檢索路徑與超圖結構皆不可或缺；自我判斷成效可保留 87.7%–96.8%。限制為分解、萃取與合併需額外 LLM 呼叫，且記憶稀疏的低資料情境下效益有限。
papers.title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory
papers.title_zh: HyperSkill：以超圖結構化技能記憶實現自演化 LLM 代理

links.title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 1: ACA-RL achieves MPB Behavior Score 51.73 on Qwen3-8B vs 48.72 (IDK-RL) and 8.66 (Vanilla PPO), with GSM8K 91.50 vs Vanilla PPO's 93.85; similar patterns on Qwen3-14B and Llama3.1-8B.
Section 4: structured reward V(b) assigns 1.0 to Elicit, 0.6 to Cond, 0.3 to Abs, -0.3 to EA, -1.0 to SH, described as 'a preference hierarchy rather than fitted calibration weights'.
Section 3.1: pipeline yields 120K training instances; LLM quality filter validated on 556 human-annotated held-out instances at 93.0% accuracy, 94.4% precision, 91.4% recall, 92.9% F1.

Section 5.1 Evaluation Protocol: GPT-5 adopted as judge; 'The same category definitions are used for training-time reward assignment and benchmark scoring, so the results should be read as rubric-aligned behavioral scores.'
Appendix E.4: three human experts agree with the GPT-5 judge on approximately 98% of sampled GPT-5 responses and 95% of sampled Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct responses.
Appendix A, Table 7: frontier models score low on MPB diagnostics (GPT-5 20.07, QwQ-32B 9.76, Deepseek-V3.1 5.57), supporting benchmark difficulty.
Table 2: ACA-RL preserves LiveBench average (59.0 vs 59.0 for Vanilla PPO/RLVR) and SciBench 53.7 vs 56.0 on Qwen3-8B.
Section 6, Table 3: data-source ablation shows Ours MPB 51.73 vs Treecut 15.41 and SUM 47.35 under equal budget; Table 4 shows MPB/reasoning trade-off across 10%/30%/50% mixture ratios.

Limitations: 'Active Elicitation is evaluated as a single-turn textual response. The method does not train retrieval, tool use, or multi-turn clarification policies'; synthetic perturbations 'may not fully capture... organic user queries'; margins over IDK-RL 'should be interpreted as gains under the reported Behavior Score rubric.'

Appendix E.1, Table 10: full PPO/veRL configuration provided (4 nodes x 8 GPUs, lr 1e-6, 400 steps, KL 0.0, max response 14000); abstract claims released code, MPB, and training data; Appendix F states prompt templates 'will include' in the released supplement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM reasoning work: trains Qwen3/Llama reasoning policies with PPO on a structured ask/condition/abstain reward (Section 4), synthesizes 120K gap-annotated missing-premise instances via a reasoning-graph pipeline (Section 3.1), and introduces the human-verified 274-instance MPB benchmark (Appendix A). Strong preference alignment across reasoning (2.5), LLM (2.5), RL (1.5), hallucination/safety (2.0), and evaluation (1.8) preferences. Novelty is moderate: the five-behavior taxonomy extends prior binary-IDK work (Treecut, UMWP, IDK-RL, AbstentionBench), and the RL-with-categorical-reward recipe is a natural composition of existing pieces. Rigor is solid but not exemplary: three model groups, OOD unanswerable benchmarks, general-capability checks (Tables 1-2), and data-source/ratio/steps/size ablations (Tables 3-6, Figures 3-6) plus judge-human agreement (Appendix E.4); however, margins over IDK-RL are small (51.73 vs 48.72 on Qwen3-8B) with no significance testing, the same taxonomy drives both training reward and MPB scoring (acknowledged in Limitations), reward weights are hand-set without sensitivity analysis, and GPT-5 scores in Table 7 rely on a GPT-5 judge. Evidence is well-calibrated and internally consistent but partly self-referential to the authors' rubric; GPT-5 scoring MPB at 20.07 vs 5-13 for other frontier models supports benchmark difficulty. Generalizability is limited by math-only training data (DeepScaleR, Appendix E.1) and single-turn evaluation without tool use (Limitations). Reproducibility is supported by released code/MPB/data and full PPO hyperparameters (Table 10), tempered by the proprietary GPT-5 judge and 'will include' phrasing for prompts (Appendix F).

primary_link.title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning

papers.summary: Answer-only reinforcement learning (RL) trains reasoning models to solve fully specified problems, but many realistic queries omit a premise needed for a unique answer. In this setting, the useful response is not always refusal: the model should ask for the missing premise, condition its answer on the unknown quantity, or abstain when no informative conditional response is available. We present \emph{Ask-Condition-Abstain Reinforcement Learning} (ACA-RL), a data-augmented RL framework for this s
papers.summary_zh: 僅以最終答案為獎勵的強化學習會訓練推理模型解決資訊完整的題目，但真實查詢常遺漏求得唯一答案所需的前提。此時模型不該一律拒答：應主動詢問缺失前提、以未知變數條件化表達答案，或在無有用回應時才棄答。本文提出 ACA-RL：先以推理圖引導的合成管線將良構問題拆解、擾動關鍵前提，產生 12 萬筆附缺口標註的訓練實例；再以結構化行為獎勵訓練，偏好階層為主動詢問（1.0）＞條件化（0.6）＞棄答（0.3），並懲罰明示假設與無聲幻覺。同時發布 274 題人工驗證的 Missing-Premise Benchmark（MPB）。實驗顯示，於 Qwen3-8B 上 ACA-RL 的 MPB 分數達 51.73，遠高於 Vanilla PPO 的 8.66，並超越學保守拒答的 IDK-RL（48.72）；Qwen3-14B 與 Llama3.1-8B 亦有相同趨勢，且在 GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME'24 上大致維持競爭力。作者坦言限制：僅評估單輪文字回應，未訓練多輪釐清或工具使用；訓練資料來自結構性擾動，未必涵蓋真實語意模糊；訓練獎勵與評分共用同一行為分類法。此工作把「察覺任務欠定並建設性回應」納入推理模型評估的新使命。
papers.title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 提問、條件化或棄答：缺失前提推理的強化學習

links.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds

evidence: Section 3.4 (Hierarchical Agentic Evaluation): case-specific skill routing 'depends only on the case context and evaluation intention and is independent of the world model being evaluated'; sub-agents return discrete scores with diagnostics aggregated by the parent skill agent into an evidence tree.

Section 4 (Benchmark Composition): benchmark of 330 cases built via an agentic pipeline sampling a six-axis scene taxonomy and six probe families, with a Case Validator that returns failing candidates to the sampler rather than retaining them.

Section 5.3 (Human Alignment): Spearman ρ=0.93 (Kendall τ=0.82) on Intentional and ρ=0.87 (τ=0.74) on Physical Transition against 5000 A/B judgments across nine representative models, aggregated with a Bradley–Terry model.

Section 5.3 (Comparison with WBench): with the same GPT-5.5 backend, temperature, and frame sampling, pairwise accuracy improves from 31.9% to 71.7% (Physical) and 60.2% to 77.8% (Intentional); draw rate falls from 52.2% to 1.8% and 36.1% to 11.1%; lower Brier score in both settings.

Section 5.3 (Robustness of HarnessEval-W): robustness is assessed only by repeating the same GPT-5.5 backend at temperature 0 over three rounds (slope envelope 0.33 vs 1.61 Bradley–Terry units for WBench); the section's framing of 'robustness under different VLMs' is not backed by cross-backend experiments.

Section 5.4.2 (Capability Shifts under Finetuning): DreamX-World gains 7.8 in Revisit but loses 11.9 in Intentional and 7.2 in Physical; HY-WorldPlay gains 8.4 in Revisit but loses 24.2 in Intentional and 11.2 in Physical, supporting the claim that action-finetuning redistributes rather than uniformly improves capability.

Metadata (Code: github.com/mirros-lab/harnesseval-w) and Section 7 claim an open-sourced live benchmark; Table 2 annotates closed-source models with *, and Section 5.1 states all sub-agents share one VLM backend, limiting independent replication of the leaderboard.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is a language-centric agentic evaluation methodology (LLM planner routes cases, specialized VLM sub-agents with diagnostic tools, parent-agent validation producing auditable evidence trees), so it does not fall under the image/video-diffusion or pure-CV exclusion caps; it aligns strongly with Agents & Tool Use, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: it extends the already-established Agent-as-a-Judge / evaluation-agent paradigm (Agent-as-a-Judge, Evaluation Agent, VideoGen-Eval, VideoArgus are all cited in Sec 2.3) to interactive world models, adding skill routing, sub-agent decomposition, and a 330-case construction pipeline. Rigor is solid but imperfect: evaluator-vs-evaluator experiments (human alignment with Bradley-Terry over 5000 A/B judgments, controlled WBench comparison on same backend, repeatability at temperature 0) are well designed, yet the claimed 'robustness under different VLMs' is never actually tested across backends (only three repeats of the same GPT-5.5 backend), no ablation isolates the benefit of hierarchical decomposition over a simpler rubric, no significance tests or CIs are reported, and human study annotator details are sparse. Evidence strength rests on concrete numbers (ρ=0.93/0.87; accuracy 31.9%→71.7% and 60.2%→77.8%; draw rate 52.2%→1.8%) but compares against only one baseline protocol family and covers two of eight settings. Generalizability is moderate: the skill library and Eq. (1) factorization are extensible, but probe families are world-model-specific. Reproducibility benefits from released code/cases (GitHub link), but the leaderboard mixes closed-source APIs (marked * in Table 2) and depends on a proprietary GPT-5.5 backend; promotional tone and self-citations to blog posts slightly reduce credibility.

primary_link.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds

papers.summary: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-
papers.summary_zh: 評估互動式世界模型時，物理因果、幾何一致性與世界狀態演化的判斷高度依賴個案脈絡，固定評分準則難以適用；現有基準多以暴力方式計算指標，留下無法檢驗的評分。本文提出 HarnessEval-W，把 LLM 生態的 evaluation harness 範式引入世界模型評測：上層代理解讀每個案例並路由至適用的技能，各技能再分解為可量測的子問題，交由配備專屬脈絡與診斷工具的子代理（如追蹤邊界框、驗證時間交會、估計速度）調查，父代理驗證證據後彙整為最終判定，形成可審計的證據樹。基準圍繞觀察品質、轉移正確性與世界持久性三軸、八項細部設定，共 330 個案例，經代理化管線自動生成並驗證。團隊評測 18 個代表性模型，Seedance 2.0 以 75.5 分居首；與人類偏好的對齊在 Intentional 與 Physical 轉移達 Spearman ρ=0.93 與 0.87，配對準確率與重複測試穩健性亦顯著優於 WBench 協定。分析發現，把影片生成器微調為動作條件世界模型會重新分配能力而非全面提升。其意義在於讓每個分數都可回溯到具體失敗模式；限制則為仰賴 VLM 判斷，且技能庫須隨世界模型演化持續擴充。
papers.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
papers.title_zh: HarnessEval-W：將互動視覺世界的評估代理化

links.title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies

evidence: Abstract: single models achieve Match rates '3.4–15.0%' across 643 papers; multi-agent (top 4) reaches '22.9–41.6% across all six domains, with mean 36.0%' and observed '2.4× lift' over best dagger baseline.

Section 3.2 Anti-leakage design: 'Temporal cutoff', 'Information isolation', 'Anonymous references', 'Frozen per-paper bibliographies', and 'Judge self-evaluation avoidance' prevent prompt-time leakage but 'do not prevent parametric memorization'.

Section 4.3 Table 5: Overall slot oracle C=30.8%, unconstrained oracle D=44.5%, MA=35.6%, so 'C<MA<D' — the pipeline exceeds Default-grid slot re-picking but stays below a label-peeking 5-of-20 cherry-pick; authors state this 'does not replace a matched best-of-20 control'.

Section 4.3 Table 3: paper-level bootstrap gives overall lift '2.4× with 95% CI [2.3,2.6]'; success@5 is '57.1%' vs '55.1%' for domain-best dagger, showing the lift comes from more matching hypotheses on already-hit papers.

Section 5 Limitations: 'The headline Default vs. multi-agent comparison is not an isolated collaboration effect' (5-of-20 vs 5-of-5 selection, different judge panels, no equal token budget) and 'we do not yet report human agreement with the Match rubric'.

Section 4.4 / Appendix F: on seeds first public after 2026-03-22 (n=236), multi-agent mean is 31.1% with 2.4× average lift; authors caution Δ compares 'disjoint paper sets of unequal size' and date≤KC is only 'an upper bound on corpus reachability'.
Table 1: retention funnel from 879 CSV titles to 643 reported papers, with per-domain drops (early stop 35 Medicine papers, MA n_s<5 drops of 21 papers).

Appendix A: verbatim binary match judge prompt and rubric with origin recusal; Appendix B: Swiss tournament mechanics with conflict-of-interest recusal and presentation-order debiasing; Appendix C: B=2000 seeded bootstrap. No human validation or public code/data release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation benchmark with a multi-agent (cross-model review + Swiss tournament) pipeline, squarely in scope: it evaluates seven frontier LLMs, uses LLM-as-judge scoring with recusal, and discusses inference-time scaling (best-of-N, self-consistency, mixture-of-agents), matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, reasoning, evaluation). Novelty is moderate-to-good: the blind idea-recovery task under a strict pre-publication temporal cutoff with anti-leakage protocol is a distinct framing versus IdeaBench/MOOSE-Chem/HindSight (Section 2), though the pipeline components themselves are known. Rigor is unusually self-critical: retention funnel (Table 1), judge dispersion, paper-level bootstrap CIs (Table 3), sign test (Appendix D), candidate-count oracle bounds A/B/C/D showing C<MA<D (Table 5), and knowledge-cutoff contamination strata (Appendix F). Key weaknesses: the headline 2.4x lift is an association confounded by candidate count (5-of-20 vs 5-of-5), different judge panels, no compute normalization, and the entire metric rests on unvalidated LLM judges (Limitations section admits no human agreement); the top-4 roster is post-selected on the same papers; no length-matched control. Evidence strength is solid but capped by these uncontrolled comparisons; the >2026-03-22 slice (n=236, mean 31.1%, 2.4x lift) partially mitigates memorization concerns. Generalizability is decent (6 domains, 643 papers) but limited to recent proprietary OpenRouter snapshots and a coarse binary match. Reproducibility benefits from verbatim prompts, seeded bootstrap, and model IDs, but there is no explicit code/benchmark-release statement. Overall a relevant, methodologically careful benchmark paper whose central claim is honestly flagged as confounded.

primary_link.title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies

papers.summary: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-p
papers.summary_zh: 只給定一篇論文發表前的參考書目，語言模型能否還原它真正提出的研究構想？本文提出 Reconstruction 盲測基準：對涵蓋機器學習與五個 Nature 家族領域、共 643 篇的種子論文，僅提供經時間切點過濾、匿名化的預出版文獻清單，模型提出假設後由獨立 LLM 評審比對被保留的標題與摘要，計算 Match 率。反洩漏協定含嚴格時間切點、匿名參考 ID、凍結書目與評審迴避，但無法排除參數化記憶汙染。結果顯示七個前沿模型單獨作業的 Match 率僅 3.4–15.0%，最佳六域平均 13.3%；而僅用參考書目、無網路搜尋、結合跨模型互審與瑞士制錦標賽選拔的 multi-agent 管線，將 Match 率提升至 22.9–41.6%（平均 36.0%），相對最佳單模型基線約 2.4 倍提升，此模式在知識截止日後首次公開的 236 篇論文上仍成立。作者誠實指出：增益可能部分來自推論時間擴展（從 20 個候選選 5 個）、評審面板不一致與假設長度差異，需等待匹配控制實驗。此基準為文獻理解與多代理協調提供了嚴格的資訊切點壓力測試，並指向從還原走向生成新構想的下一步。

links.title: Proof-of-Execution Memory: Defending LLM Agents Against Forged-Reasoning Attacks by Verifying What Actually Happened

evidence: Abstract: PoEM drives attack success to 0% across three models and three scenarios with 0% false positives in eight of nine model-scenario cells (1.7% in the ninth), while SENTINEL wrongly blocks 33-50% of legitimate operations.

Section VI-A, Table I: adaptive forgeries give SENTINEL ASR equal to No Defense (100 vs 98% on GPT-4o; 44% vs 44% on Llama-3.1-8B), while PoEM is 0% everywhere; capability paradox reported (98-100% on GPT models vs 44% on Llama-3.1-8B).

Section VI-B, Table II: automated adaptive attacker that knows SENTINEL's signal list matches no-defense ASR on every model and succeeds on its first query for GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o (4 queries on Llama).

Section VI-D, Table III: PoEM blocks all three PoEM-aware attacks (ledger forgery, cross-subject replay, judgment reframing); NaivePoEM ablation is defeated by A and B, confirming chain verification and subject scoping are load-bearing.

Section VI-F, Table IV: grounding check costs 1.46 ms at ledger size N=1000 (0.12% of a ~1218 ms GPT-4o-mini call); cost is O(N) due to full chain re-verification with an O(1) amortized optimization noted.
Section VI-G, Table V: LangChain agent with InMemoryVectorStore and GPT-4o-mini reproduces the off-harness result (adaptive SENTINEL 100%, PoEM 0%; SENTINEL loses 50% benign skips, PoEM none).
Section VII: limitations explicitly stated - coverage equals gated decisions, freshness/expiry policy needed, and guarantee collapses if the HMAC key leaks or the genuine action path can be invoked.

Code Availability: MIT-licensed repository (github.com/bithabib/ai_security) containing attack and adaptive variants, SENTINEL reproduction, PoEM and NaivePoEM, automated attacker, LangChain port, figure scripts, and raw results; core harness depends only on the Python standard library.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic paper on LLM agent security: memory-poisoning attack (forged reasoning) and a defense (tamper-evident execution ledger gating skip decisions), squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming preferences. The evaluation pipeline is well structured: reproduces FARMA and SENTINEL, breaks SENTINEL with an automated adaptive rewording attacker, tests PoEM against three direct attacks with a NaivePoEM ablation, measures false positives and overhead, and ports to a real LangChain vector-store agent. Novelty is moderate: the underlying mechanism (HMAC-chained append-only audit log, Section IV-B) is classical cryptography (Schneier-Kelsey 1999; Haber-Stornetta 1991) applied at decision time, and the paper openly frames itself as closing an open problem from FARMA. Rigor is limited by small samples (20 trials/cell), CIs mentioned but not displayed, an unsupported 'sampling noise' attribution for the 1.7% false-positive cell (Section VI-C), and a self-built harness whose scenarios are simplified. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent across Tables I-V but mostly self-referential; the strong threat-model assumption (attacker cannot modify code or hold the HMAC key, Section VII) bounds practical weight. Generalizability is constrained by the explicitly stated coverage limitation (protects only gated decisions) and freshness policy need. Reproducibility claim is unusually complete: MIT-licensed repo with attack variants, defenses, adaptive attacker, LangChain port, figure scripts, and raw results (Code Availability).

primary_link.title: Proof-of-Execution Memory: Defending LLM Agents Against Forged-Reasoning Attacks by Verifying What Actually Happened

papers.summary: LLM agents are stateless and rely on external memory to carry context between steps. Because agents treat that memory as trustworthy, an adversary who can write to it can steer their behavior. The FARMA attack does this with no malicious command: it inserts fabricated entries into the agent's reasoning memory claiming a required safety step is already done, so the agent skips it. SENTINEL, the defense proposed with FARMA, scores entries against a fixed list of suspicious wordings; its authors no
papers.summary_zh: 自主 LLM 代理依賴外部記憶延續上下文，卻無條件信任其內容。FARMA 攻擊在代理的推理記憶植入「某安全步驟已完成」的偽造條目，誘使代理跳過驗證；配套防禦 SENTINEL 依賴固定可疑訊號清單。本文證明問題更嚴重：一個自動化攻擊者僅以 LLM 改寫措辭，首次嘗試即可繞過 SENTINEL，使其防護歸零，並發現能力悖論——攻擊在 GPT-4o 與 GPT-4o-mini 上成功率 98–100%，反而高於較小的 Llama-3.1-8B（44%），因為越強的模型越能領會含蓄的「已處理」暗示。作者提出 PoEM：完全不檢查記憶措辭，改以僅由受信任執行層寫入、以 HMAC 鏈結的附加式帳本記錄實際執行過的安全步驟；當代理欲跳過安全步驟時，僅在帳本確認該步驟確實執行過才放行，攻擊者可改寫記憶卻無法偽造未發生的事件。於三模型三情境及針對 PoEM 本身的對抗評估（帳本偽造、跨主體重放、判斷重述）中，攻擊成功率降為 0%，九個模型—情境組合中有八個誤報率為 0%（SENTINEL 則誤擋 33–50% 正常操作），開銷僅微秒級，並於真實 LangChain 代理驗證。限制：PoEM 只保護明確把關的決策，且帳本金鑰必須留在信任環境內。

links.title: Uncertainty-Aware Decision Making in Multimodal Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: organizes literature around a decision-centered source-signal-calibration-action framework covering token/logit uncertainty, conformal prediction, selective answering, abstention, clarification, retrieval, self-checking, and escalation
Section 2.2: defines inclusion criteria restricting central papers to work where uncertainty is part of method, benchmark, metric, or response policy
Section 2.4: claims 'core evidence base contains 67 focused evidence rows' with search logs and evidence-tier accounting retained in Appendix A
Table 1: positions survey against text-only LLM uncertainty, text-only abstention, MLLM hallucination/safety, and broad MLLM survey families

Section 5.4: reviews conformal prediction and risk-control methods (TRON [52], conformal abstention [49], split conformal VLM prediction sets [64]) with explicit caveats about calibration-distribution dependence
Section 10 (Limitations): acknowledges time-bounded evidence base, uneven modality coverage, and that the survey is 'a structured synthesis rather than a quantitative meta-analysis'
Appendix A/B: describes retained traceability artifacts (search sources, screening counts, evidence tiers) but the actual materials are not included in the supplied document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey on uncertainty-aware decision making for multimodal LLMs, highly relevant to LLM preferences (uncertainty quantification, calibration, abstention/selective prediction, conformal risk control, hallucination detection, evaluation benchmarks, retrieval/routing actions). It is not a pure CV/medical/audio application; language-model methodology is central. Novelty is moderate: the source-signal-calibration-action taxonomy is a sensible organizing contribution and Table 1 articulates a real gap versus text-only uncertainty, abstention, and MLLM hallucination surveys, but the framework itself is a synthesis rather than a new method. Rigor is decent for a survey: explicit inclusion criteria (Sec 2.2), positioning (Table 1), and claimed traceability of 67 evidence rows (Sec 2.4, Appendix A), yet it is explicitly a qualitative structured synthesis, not a quantitative meta-analysis (Sec 10), and search/extraction artifacts are asserted rather than shown in the document. Evidence strength is moderate: ~77 references with section-anchored citations, but claims are synthesis-level, several cited works are preprints or under review (e.g., refs [41], [72]), and no independent verification is possible. Generalizability is reasonably good across modalities and deployment settings (Sec 8) though the evidence base is admittedly image-text concentrated (Sec 10). Reproducibility is middling: reporting checklist and appendix artifacts are proposed (Sec 9.5, Appendix B) but the actual search logs/evidence matrix are not present in the supplied text, and no code/data release is mentioned.

primary_link.title: Uncertainty-Aware Decision Making in Multimodal Large Language Models

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly answer questions whose correctness depends on visual, textual, temporal, acoustic, document, chart, or embodied evidence. Their failures are therefore not only linguistic. A fluent answer may conceal poor input quality, a perceptual error, weak grounding, conflict between modalities, unstable reasoning, distribution shift, or a question that is not answerable from the supplied evidence. This survey organizes the literature on uncertainty-awar
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）的回答正確性取決於視覺、文件、圖表、音訊等多源證據，其失敗不再只是語言問題：流暢答案可能掩蓋輸入模糊、感知錯誤、接地不足、模態衝突、推理不穩、分佈偏移，或問題本身無法由所給證據回答。本文以決策為中心整理文獻，提出「來源—訊號—校準—行動」框架：不確定性來源（感官與感知、接地與跨模態、語言先驗與推理、可答性、部署風險）產生可觀察訊號，如 logit、語意分歧、擾動不穩定性、接地與歸因分數、口述信心、verifier 或 judge 分數、conformal prediction；訊號須校準或做風險控制，校準後的不確定性才應驅動行動選擇：回答、保留態度、棄答或 IDK、請求釐清、要求更好的輸入、檢索、自我檢查、路由或上報人類專家。全文涵蓋 67 列聚焦證據，主張不確定性評估不應止於信心數值，而應檢驗其在證據不足、衝突或高風險情境下能否改善行為。開放問題包括來源感知分解、行動感知基準、偏移下的校準與黑箱估計；綜述本身亦受限於時效、模態覆蓋不均與非量化統合的性質。此文為可信賴多模態系統提供統一的設計與評估座標。

links.title: Cross-Model Memory Transfer via Target-Side Reader Adaptation

evidence: Section 4.1 / Figure 2(a) and Appendix C Table 11: all nine source-target cells show relative PPL reductions of 1.6% to 15.7%, strongest for Qwen3.5-0.8B -> TinyLlama-1.1B (-15.7%), beating the size-matched random-memory control.

Section 4.2 / Table 1: dual-layer {2,10} injection raises average QA from 34.2 (single-layer R1) to 37.5 and R4 branches to 38.5 vs base 32.1, exceeding RAG (33.4), kNN (32.6), LoRA (32.3), and MLP Memory (36.1) on Mistral-7B.

Section 4.6 / Table 5: param-matched FFN-only control achieves the best test PPL (7.4 vs 8.7) but only 34.5 avg QA vs 38.5 for transfer, and train-from-scratch memory reaches 38.4, supporting the paper's own conclusion that transfer improves data efficiency (Table 4: 1.05M vs 34.6M trainable params) rather than the asymptotic ceiling.

Appendix B.3 overlap audit: 4 duplicated TriviaQA rows (0.013%) among 31,807 evaluation questions; authors explicitly state results are 'controlled comparisons rather than as a contamination-free state-of-the-art claim', which tempers the abstract's SoTA language.
Section 4.3 / Figure 3: gains are selective (RTE +0.7 to +3.7, SciQ up to +3.7) while TruthfulQA decreases -0.2 to -0.8 points at every target scale, and RACE is near zero.
Appendix E Table 23: character-span addressing yields positive transfer on Chinese (2.251%) and Japanese (1.023%) Wikipedia, partially addressing the whitespace-addressing limitation.

Appendix H: authors acknowledge experiments cap at 9B parameters, no reader-capacity scaling law, no joint training, and that word-boundary addressing may fail under more aggressive tokenizer mismatch.

Editing artifacts present: Appendix F contains the dangling sentences 'If not, change it.', 'Lower than what?', and 'Also, the wording of "the main text's claim" is bad.', indicating incomplete proofreading.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on cross-backbone transfer of Engram-style hashed external memory with reader-only adaptation; highly relevant to LLM knowledge augmentation, PEFT-style adaptation, and inference-efficiency preferences, not a domain application. The transfer protocol (tokenizer-agnostic canonicalized addressing, frozen table, lightweight multi-branch reader) is a reasonably novel framing of memory portability as an evaluation problem. Experimental design is strong: 3x3 transfer matrix (all cells improve PPL 1.6-15.7%), random/permuted-key/param-matched-FFN/LoRA/kNN controls, 3 seeds with CIs and t-tests, peer-to-peer and target-scaling checks, contamination audit, and honest negative findings (TruthfulQA drops; scratch memory matches transfer QA 38.4 vs 38.5, so the claim reduces to data efficiency, not a higher ceiling). Deductions: the 'new SoTA' claim is overstated relative to a small baseline set and admittedly not contamination-free; downstream gains are selective; artifacts include leftover editing notes ('If not, change it.', 'Lower than what?') and citation-year inconsistencies; models capped at 9B; no code/artifact release is stated, though hyperparameters, checkpoints, corpora, and seeds are reported in detail.

papers.summary: Methods for improving knowledge use in large language models typically fall into two regimes. Non-parametric retrieval offers flexible access to external knowledge, but adds retrieval latency, context overhead, and only shallow integration with the backbone. Parametric adaptation is efficient at inference time, but entangles knowledge with model weights and can be hard to update, audit, or transfer. Engram-style hashed memory occupies a middle regime: it stores learned information in an external
papers.summary_zh: Engram 式雜湊外部記憶把學得的知識存於可定址表格，再由小型讀取器消費。當此記憶搬到不同骨幹模型時，關鍵在於記憶本身，還是目標端讀取器？本文以「跨模型凍結記憶抽取」回答：凍結源模型訓練的記憶表，附掛到目標模型後僅訓練輕量讀取器，並以與分詞器無關的規範化管線保持位址一致。3×3 轉移矩陣（Pythia、Qwen3.5、TinyLlama）九格全部獲得困惑度改善，最高相對降低 15.7%，同儕規模雙向轉移亦有效；消融顯示記憶內容與位址完整性皆必要，置換金鑰或改用隨機記憶會大幅退化。在下游問答上，雙層四分支讀取器使跨模型重用逼近同模型重用，Mistral-7B 上平均達 38.5–38.8，超越 RAG、kNN-LM、LoRA 與 MLP Memory 等基線；但增益具任務選擇性，TruthfulQA 一致變差，因其獎勵對誤導性關聯的校準抵抗。主要限制：僅測至 9B 模型、未系統研究讀取器容量隨規模擴展、詞邊界定址不適用所有書寫系統（已另以字元跨度處理中日文）。結論指出外部記憶的可攜性取決於讀取介面，記憶件應以「新骨幹能否抽取可用訊號」來評價。

§4.2: text-count AFL vs target-supplied logprob comparator gives Pearson r=0.971 but Spearman 0.657; with 3! = 6 permutations the exact route test gives p=0.167 and the paper explicitly labels this 'descriptive rather than confirmatory' and the comparator as target-controlled, not ground truth.

§2.3 and Appendix B: assumptions A1-A6 (fixed reference vector in A5, within-window independence in A4b) are acknowledged to make intervals and p-values optimistic under overdispersion; frozen protocol fixes J=12 contexts, M=50, tau=1, c=1, 20,000 null draws, seed 20260814.

Appendix C Table 7 and §4.5: DigitalOcean pass rate falls 82.6% (Q1) to 13.6% (Q4) but comparator-relative gaps are non-monotonic (+6.1, -30.9, -19.1, -14.6 pp), 47 of 56 non-pass outcomes are AgentTimeoutError, and the paper states lack of time-aligned windows 'prevents confirmed causal attribution'.

Appendix C: AFL has Pearson r=0.081 (p=0.873) with Terminal-Bench pass rate and median D500 has r=0.347 (p=0.446) with GPQA-Diamond accuracy, i.e., the mean statistic alone does not order downstream performance.

§6 and §2.2: the audit cannot detect deviations outside the frozen probe distribution, cannot identify quantization level or intent, and is defeated by a provider that perfectly recognizes audit traffic.

Appendix F and §B.2: release includes frozen protocols, 4,200 categorized responses, all 20 D500 values per route, complete GPQA/Terminal-Bench outcomes, pinned environment (Python 3.11.6, NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.17.1); Appendix B admits provider region, top_p, stream mode, and retry lineage are not preserved, so exact operational reproduction is not possible.

§5 and Table 4: positions against Gao et al., RUT, LLMmap, FLIPS, KVV, and concurrent IRIS/One-Token-Is-Enough, with explicit query-budget accounting (mean component 600 one-token target calls per route; run-level component 10,000 reference prefix-rescoring calls per route).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A black-box audit for verifying vendor-hosted LLM API deployments, squarely relevant to the LLM-serving, AI-safety/auditing, and evaluation preferences, with downstream motivation from long-horizon agentic tasks (Terminal-Bench). Methodological rigor is unusually high: predeclared frozen protocol, null-bias-corrected coarsened-KL estimator (AFL) with a validated official self-check control, Holm-corrected joint-null tests, prior-free sensitivity statistic, pooling-threshold sensitivity, and explicit assumptions A1-A6 with honest non-goals. Novelty is moderate: the composite AFL+EFL design (separating persistent mean deviation from intermittent upper-tail deviation) is a genuine but incremental contribution over a crowded auditing literature (model equality testing, RUT, LLMmap, KBF, IRIS), and the components are statistically standard. Evidence is real and internally consistent but narrow: one model family (DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731), 12 synthetic one-token digit contexts, single audit window, only 3! = 6 permutations for the comparator agreement test (self-labeled descriptive, p=0.167), and the headline EFL-Terminal-Bench link is observational, single-route (DigitalOcean), heavily confounded by agent timeouts (47/56 failures are AgentTimeoutError) with non-monotonic comparator-relative gaps. Reproducibility posture is strong (GitHub release, frozen artifacts, 4,200 categorized counts, all D500 values, pinned environment, seed), though the paper admits unreconstructable operational fields (region, top_p, retry lineage) and the live routes themselves are non-stationary.

Auditing the quality of their inference APIs is therefore an open problem. We formalize hosted model routing as a stochastic process and propose \mbox{\textbf{Ventor-QTest}}, a composite black-box audit that requires no probability information from the target API. Its repeated-request component sends each frozen constrained context to the t
papers.summary_zh: 第三方供應商代管開源權重模型已成生態常態，但用戶只能觀察回應文字與供應商控制的中繼資料，無從確認服務的是否真為宣稱的模型版本與配置。本文將託管路由形式化為隨機過程，提出 Ventor-QTest 黑箱複合稽核，機率資訊只需來自可信參考端：重複請求元件對固定受限上下文送出 M 次，重建類別分佈並回報經偏差校正的平均保真損失（AFL）；長序列元件以獨立回合保留所有執行級偏差的經驗分佈，回報極端保真損失（EFL）的上尾行為。在三個支援 logprob 的路由上，AFL 與 logprob 比較器線性吻合（Pearson r=0.971）；對七個 DeepSeek 路由快照，六條第三方路由在 12 個凍結上下文上拒絕有限探針虛無假設，且 EFL 揭示 AFL 看不見的路由間差異（DigitalOcean 上尾最大）。下游觀察顯示 AFL/EFL 與 GPQA-Diamond 準確率關聯微弱，但 DigitalOcean 的高 EFL 與 Terminal-Bench 成功率隨任務暴露增加而下降（82.6% 降至 13.6%）相伴，暗示長時程任務對極端偏差更敏感。限制：探針範圍有限、無法偵測完美辨識稽核流量的選擇性路由，且 AFL 與 EFL 單位不同，應並列回報而非合併。

evidence: Abstract: 'FreeToken sustains 77–83 tok/s on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and 22–25 tok/s on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, achieving 1.5–2.3x higher decode throughput than state-of-the-art edge serving across all workloads.'

§3.2 Eqs. 1–4: miss split q* ≈ m·B_P/B_H derived from measured PCIe (B_P) and host (B_H) bandwidths; CPU and GPU partial outputs merged exactly ('preserving the exact MoE output without algorithmic approximation').

§5.1 Baselines/Metrics: compares against 'llama.cpp, Ollama, KTransformers, and MoE-Infinity'; 'Weight formats are exactly aligned'; agent trajectories diverge so 'cross-engine wall-clock totals are not compared.'
§5.3 Pipelined prefill ablation: 'Disabling the second buffer serializes transfer against computation and costs 19% of throughput at 4k tokens, 25% at 8k, and 26% at 16k.'

§5.3 Expert locality: at RTX 5090 capacity FreeToken LRU misses '16% and 39% of decode-time expert reads, against 41% and 59% for KTransformers' prefill-updated placement and 62% and 89% for llama.cpp's routing-blind static split.'
§5.2 Tail TTFT: 'FreeToken's worst turn stays below 44 s in every cell, while each baseline crosses 150 s somewhere—llama.cpp at 232 s, Ollama at 179 s, KTransformers at 946 s.'

§6 Related Work: closest hybrid systems Fiddler, KTransformers, HybriMoE, SMoE are characterized but none appear as evaluated baselines; 'Our contribution is the integrated runtime and the measured-bandwidth model.'

Metadata/Code link: 'https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken' and download at flashml.ai; §4.1–4.2 detail CUDA-graph-compatible device-side LRU cache, persistent C++ worker pool, and FTW storage format.
§1/Abstract: 'supports more than 20 MoE models' is asserted but only three models (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2) are evaluated in §5.1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on edge-native MoE serving of LLMs, squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, inference & serving, efficiency, MoE architecture, long-context caching); it is in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is incremental: device-side LRU expert caching, double-buffered prefill transfer, CPU execution of missed experts (Fiddler/KTransformers), and prefix reuse (SGLang) all exist; the deltas are a closed-form bandwidth-adaptive miss split (q* ≈ m·B_P/B_H) and semantic-anchor checkpointing of recurrent state for agentic context edits, honestly positioned in §6. Rigor is solid but incomplete: careful setup (bit-exact weight alignment, CPU-thread caps validated on real edge hardware, measured not spec-sheet bandwidths) and ablations for double buffering and cache placement, but the headline q* policy lacks an ablation against all-fill/all-CPU/greedy alternatives, and closest hybrid baselines (Fiddler, HybriMoE, SMoE) are not run. Evidence is specific and internally consistent (77–83 tok/s Qwen3.6, 22–25 tok/s DSV4-Flash, tail TTFT <44 s vs >150 s baselines; miss rates 16/39% vs 41/59% vs 62/89%) but much rests on unverifiable figures and the 'more than 20 MoE models' claim is unsupported in-document. Generalizability is demonstrated across six machines and three frontier models; reproducibility is aided by a released code link and detailed setup, though it depends on model checkpoints not verifiable from the document.

primary_link.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution

papers.summary: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure. We present FreeToken, an edge-native MoE serving system that treats a personal machine not as a small GPU, but as a unified, elastic inference platform. FreeToken co-designs the full serving stack, including model layout and loading, expert residency, CPU--GPU execution, agentic state reuse, and runtime memory management, around two realities of local AI: agent workloads cont
papers.summary_zh: 前沿開源 MoE 模型參數動輒數百 B，稀疏啟用使運算可行，但完整專家池遠超消費級 GPU 記憶體，邊緣服務因此受制於專家搬移、快取失誤與資源變動。FreeToken 將個人電腦視為 GPU、CPU、主記憶體與互連頻寬的統一彈性平台，提出三項設計：(1) 頻寬調適執行——預填階段以全層雙緩衝將 PCIe 傳輸與運算流水線化；解碼階段以實測頻寬推導 q* 比例，把每步快取失誤分配於 PCIe 快取填充與直接 CPU 執行，使兩分支並行飽和；(2) 語意感知快取——解碼以共享 LRU 專家快取捕捉時間區域性；預填在思考段、工具呼叫等特殊詞元邊界錨定遞迴狀態檢查點，使代理上下文編輯後僅重算新後綴；(3) 彈性資源管理——可在執行中重建 GPU 專家快取並快速啟動。系統支援逾 20 個 MoE 模型，跨六台機器評測：RTX 5090 上 Qwen3.6-35B 達 77–83 tok/s、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 22–25 tok/s，較現有邊緣引擎高 1.5–2.3 倍；8GB 筆電服務 35B 模型達 39.3 tok/s，32GB 遊戲桌機互動服務 284B 模型，單張 RTX PRO 6000 服務 753B 的 GLM-5.2；最壞 TTFT 維持 44 秒內，基線皆逾 150 秒。當 DMA 釘選受限時系統退回純 CPU 路徑，以尖峰傳輸頻寬換取部署性。

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 12 models, the highest Tier-2 success rate is 72.6%, while static knowledge performance does not consistently translate into procedural execution.'

Section 4.2–4.3: success defined as 'outcome=1 ∧ safety_ok=1'; SR is a task-balanced macro-average with auxiliary SGO and SCR metrics formally defined.

Limitations: 'ACOE does not model continuous aerodynamics, sensor noise, system hysteresis, uncertain fault evolution, or the time pressure of real-world flight operations'; closed-book condition excludes retrieval-augmented settings.
No code, data, or artifact release URL for ACOE/AeroCopilotBench appears anywhere in the document; reproducibility rests on description alone.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark for LLM agents performing multi-step tool-calling tasks in an interactive environment with safety-gated grading; squarely within high-weight Agent/Tool-Use and Evaluation preferences (MCP interface, tool orchestration, agent misbehavior analysis), though the aviation instantiation is a domain application. Novelty is moderate: it extends τ-bench/τ²-bench-style interactive evaluation with trajectory-level hard safety constraints as a success gate and POH-anchored task construction, an incremental but genuine contribution. Rigor is solid (deterministic environment, frozen protocol, formal metric definitions, per-task validation), but n=3 trials per task, a 6-point Pearson correlation (r=0.57), and a manually induced failure taxonomy with no inter-annotator agreement weaken inference. Quantitative evidence is extensive and claims are appropriately hedged; no release URL for ACOE or benchmark artifacts is stated in the document, limiting reproducibility despite the detailed deterministic design.

papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）代理能否在安全攸關的航空領域協助機組員進行決策與任務執行。既有航空評測多聚焦靜態知識問答，無法檢驗代理在互動環境中執行程序與遵守安全規範的能力。作者建立可重現的互動式虛擬駕駛艙測試環境 ACOE，並提出兩層基準 AeroCopilotBench：第一層以 1,200 道選擇題評估航空領域知識；第二層將 Cessna 172S 與 Piper PA-44-180 飛行手冊（POH）中的緊急與異常程序轉化為 73 項互動任務，模型須在部分可觀察、確定性狀態轉移下解讀儀表、診斷故障並操作機上系統，且不得違反硬性安全約束。評估採安全閘門機制，僅在達成所有目標且全程遵守安全約束時才算成功。12 個模型的結果顯示最高成功率僅 72.6%，靜態知識高分未必轉化為程序執行表現（兩層 Pearson 相關僅 0.57）；對 451 個失敗軌跡的分析歸納出四種重複失敗模式，包括遺漏關鍵程序步驟與長程執行漂移。限制包括未建模連續氣動力學與時間壓力，且採封閉書籍設定。此工作為航空代理的知識應用、互動執行與操作安全提供可重現的評測基礎，亦可作為回歸測試工具。

links.title: Automating Parent Selection Configuration in Genetic Programming with Agentic AI

evidence: Abstract: 'the full agentic setup with 5 mini (5 mini–AR), consistently generated established ε-lexicase implementations while maintaining competitive downstream performance'

Section III: framework implemented with LangChain; agent autonomously decides whether to invoke RAG tool; 'The complete prompts and implementation are provided in the Supplemental Material' at https://github.com/EpistasisLab/Agentic-Parent-Selection
Section III-A: four models evaluated (gpt-4o, gpt-4.1 mini, gpt-5 mini, gpt-oss 20b); temperature 0.3, top-p 0.8; gpt-oss 20b deployed locally via Ollama
Section IV-B: '126 generated algorithms per model–configuration pairing and 1,512 algorithms overall'; two GP experts classify implementations; Winnowing fingerprinting via copydetect

Section V-A4: AR significantly worsened 4o and 4.1 mini performance on several problems; 'identifying the appropriate parent selection family alone is insufficient'

Section V-B: 'Pairwise WRS tests found no significant differences between 5 mini–AR and ε-lexicase on any of the six problems'; tournament significantly worse on Airfoil, Concrete, Energy Cooling, Energy Heating (p<10^-3)

llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic-LLM methodology paper (Section III: LLM agent with ReAct-style loop, RAG over a curated 9-paper corpus, Python code generation) applied to automating parent-selection design in genetic programming, so it is not a pure domain application; it strongly matches Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), RAG (1.8), and Code Generation (2.0), though the GP/SR testbed is a niche context and the contribution is an empirical realization of the authors' prior Agentic GP framework and a modest extension of Zhang et al.'s zero-shot LLM parent-selection benchmark (Section II-E), limiting novelty. Rigor is high: 4 LLMs x 3 configurations, 21 replicates, 1,512 generated algorithms, dual-expert manual classification, Winnowing code-similarity analysis, and FFH/KW/WRS tests with Holm correction (Sections IV-B, IV-D). Evidence supports the headline claims (Section V-B: 5 mini-AR not significantly different from fixed epsilon-lexicase on all six problems, significantly better than tournament on four at p<10^-3) and honestly reports negative results (RAG degraded downstream performance for 4o and 4.1 mini on several problems, Table VIII), but all conclusions rest on six UCI regression problems, one GP configuration, one component, and a tiny expert-curated corpus, restricting generalizability. Reproducibility is good: full prompts/implementation on GitHub, model versions, temperature/top-p, embedding model, chunking, and k=4 retrieval specified (Section III), with the caveat of closed-API dependence and default decoding for GPT-5 mini.

papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究能否以 agentic AI 自動化遺傳規劃（GP）系統設計的環節，聚焦親代選擇演算法的辨識與實作。作者提出結合大型語言模型與檢索增強生成（RAG）的 agentic 框架，配備由親代選擇文獻構建的策劃語料庫，代理可自主決定是否檢索相關知識，再將選定演算法實作為 Python 函式。以符號迴歸為測試平台，作者對四種 LLM（gpt-4o、gpt-4.1 mini、gpt-5 mini、gpt-oss 20b）進行消融實驗，比較完整框架、無 RAG 之代理與單獨 LLM 三種組態，共產生 1,512 個演算法，並以執行成功、分類正確、程式碼相似度與下游表現加以衡量。結果顯示 agentic 推理與檢索大幅影響產生的演算法類型，但有效性與下游表現取決於底層 LLM：僅 gpt-5 mini 配合 RAG（5 mini–AR）能穩定產生正規的 ε-lexicase 實作並維持競爭力。第二個實驗中，5 mini–AR 與固定的錦標賽選擇及半動態 MAD ε-lexicase 比較，於六個 UCI 迴歸問題上與 ε-lexicase 表現相近，且普遍優於錦標賽選擇。限制包括僅評估六個符號迴歸問題與單一 GP 元件，語料庫小且缺乏自動驗證機制。此工作證明 agentic AI 能將領域知識轉為可執行元件，是自動化演化系統設計的初步基礎。

links.title: Grounding AI Agents in Contracts: An Empirical Evaluation of Spec-Driven Test Generation

evidence: Abstract: reports +9.8pp bug detection (p=0.0352) and +2.5pp branch coverage (p=0.0034) vs a direct test-generation agent baseline, with LLM-as-a-Judge preferring spec-driven suites in 77.8% of cases vs baseline.

Section 4.2 Agent Configurations: baseline and spec-driven agents use the same Gemini 3 Flash model, identical agentic harness and tool set (view_file, run_command, run_test, etc.), and identical inference parameters, isolating the specification phase as the manipulated variable.

Section 4.3 Greenfield Test Generation Setup: the agent is kept blind to the bug, commit message, and fix diff; Section 4.3.1 post-execution sanity checks automatically discard runs where the agent modified the source under test to avoid false-positive detections.
Section 4.4.1 Evaluation Protocol: k=5 independent runs, bug-level bootstrapping with n=10,000 resamples, McNemar's test for binary detection, Wilcoxon signed-rank for coverage.

Table 2 (Section 5.1.2): detect@5 = 63.2% (spec) vs 53.4% (baseline), McNemar p=0.0352; differences not significant at k=1 (p=0.3075) and k=2 (p=0.4545), marginal at k=3 (p=0.0574); 12 uniquely detected bugs by spec agent vs 3 by baseline.
Table 3 (Section 5.1.3): branch coverage 48.9% vs 46.4% (Wilcoxon p=0.0034, significant); line coverage 74.4% vs 74.8% (p=0.3659, not significant).

Section 5.3.1: ContractCoverage@1 = 61.1% rising to ContractCoverage@5 = 78.9%; detection rate 54.9% (151/275) when the violated contract is captured vs 19.4% (34/175) when missing (Fisher p=3.62e-14, phi=0.35).

Section 4.4.2: qualitative judging uses a stronger Gemini 3.1 Pro judge over the smaller agent model, randomized/anonymized ordering, 5-run majority vote, reported self-agreement >=90% and tie rate <=5.6% (Section 5.2).

Section 6 Threats to Validity: acknowledges single Gemini model family, all bugs from Google's monorepo, single-file-fix scope, and LLM-judge noise/verbosity/self-preference bias; data-contamination confound controlled because both arms share the same underlying LLM.
Section 4.1: dataset of 90 historical bug-fixes from Google's internal issue tracking system spanning C++, Java, Python, Go; no code, prompt, or dataset release is stated anywhere in the paper.
Section 7: acknowledges concurrent DeepTest as closely related specification-first test generation, positioning this work as complementary industrial evaluation.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: spec-driven agent costs 336.7M tokens vs 243.9M baseline (+38.0%), i.e., +16.2% tokens per unique bug detected (5.9M vs 5.1M).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly preference-aligned LLM-agent methodology paper: a two-phase coding agent (Gemini 3 Flash) that first extracts semi-formal pre/post-condition specifications as a cognitive scaffold, then generates tests, evaluated on 90 real Google production bugs. Rigor is solid: same model/harness for both arms, greenfield setup with the agent blinded to the bug/fix diff, post-hoc sanity checks discarding source-tampering runs, k=5 sampling, bootstrapped CIs, McNemar/Wilcoxon/Fisher tests, failure taxonomies, and token-cost analysis. However, the headline detection gain (+9.8pp at k=5) is modest, not significant at k=1-2, CIs are wide, and the qualitative/contract-coverage claims rest on LLM-as-judge (with a plausible run-quality confound in the spec-coverage/detection correlation the authors only partially address). Novelty is moderate: DbC-style scaffolding is a natural decomposition of agentic planning, with acknowledged concurrent work (DeepTest); the ContractCoverage@k metric is the most original piece. Generalizability is constrained by a single model family, one organization's monorepo, and single-file fixes only. No code or dataset release is stated, and the dataset is Google-internal, heavily limiting reproduction.

primary_link.title: Grounding AI Agents in Contracts: An Empirical Evaluation of Spec-Driven Test Generation

papers.summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly used for coding tasks, where they have outperformed many classical approaches and scaled to repository-level tasks, such as test generation. However, when directly prompted to generate tests, these agents can fail to reason about the code and its underlying contracts, thereby missing edge cases and behavioral boundaries that affect test quality. To address this limitation, we propose Spec-Driven Test Generation, where we instruct an agent to first reason about -
papers.summary_zh: 當 LLM 代理被直接要求為既有程式碼生成測試時，往往無法推理程式背後的行為合約，遺漏邊界條件與錯誤案例。這篇 Google 團隊的論文提出規格驅動測試生成：指示代理先回溯推導並以半正式規格文件記載程式元件的前置條件、後置條件與未定義行為，作為後續測試生成的認知鷹架與測試預言。評估採用 Google 生產系統 90 個歷史錯誤的修復資料集，於移除既有測試的 Greenfield 設定下，比較規格驅動代理與直接生成測試的基準代理。結果顯示規格驅動代理在 k=5 時錯誤偵測率達 63.2%，較基準的 53.4% 提升 9.8 個百分點（p=0.0352），分支覆蓋率提升 2.5 個百分點（p=0.0034）；LLM-as-a-Judge 評估中，其測試套件在 77.8% 案例優於基準代理，並在 56.7% 案例優於人類工程師撰寫的測試。作者另提出 ContractCoverage 指標，顯示規格成功涵蓋被違反的合約時偵測率為 54.9%，未涵蓋時僅 19.4%，代價是約 38% 的 token 開銷。限制包括僅涵蓋修改單一檔案的錯誤，且資料取自單一企業程式碼庫。此工作證明以半正式規格作為前置步驟可顯著提升代理測試品質，並促成合約覆蓋與偵錯成功的關聯分析。

links.title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation

evidence: Abstract: TDD-Agent generates executable tests first, then performs iterative dual-track refinement over code and tests using execution feedback; source at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TDD-Agent-Framework-6370/
§3.1 Table 1: TDD-prompt pass@1 70.04/67.86/44.87 (GPT/DeepSeek/Qwen) vs best baselines 68.48/67.46/42.99 on LiveCodeBench (224 problems, 10 samples, unbiased pass@1, Appendix B)
Appendix B Table 6: removing the test-generation instruction from TDD-prompt yields 68.39/67.28/43.84, showing the isolated test-first effect is only ~0.6-1.7 points
§3.4 Table 2: TDD-Agent-iter10 78.24/90.77/59.34 vs mini-SWE-agent 61.31/84.18/52.97 on RepoEval function completion (455 problems, 8 repositories)
§4.4 Table 4: ablations Vanilla 68.35/73.63/52.97, Reflect, Single-track, iter1 all below full TDD-Agent 78.24/90.77/59.34, supporting both test-first and dual-track components
§4.3/Figure 5: generated-test pass rate, coverage rate (pytest-cov), and mutation score (MutPy, 20 mutants) improve across iterations
Appendix C Table 11: credit-assignment problem rate in failures is 3.03%/4.76%/8.10% (max under 10%); §4.5 reports most failures are matched (false-positive verification)
Appendix A Table 5 + Appendix D/E: generation parameters, tool implementations (allowlisted search commands), and all prompts provided
Limitations: Python-only evaluation, lightweight repository tools, execution-feedback reliability (flaky tests), and computational overhead acknowledged
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agent/code-generation paper: LLM backbones (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3-Coder), agentic tool use (function calling, run_tests, early terminator), test-first reasoning and iterative refinement. The framework design is solid and evaluation is unusually thorough for this space (two benchmarks, four prompting baselines, four agent/retrieval baselines, ablations, token/time costs, failure analysis). Novelty is moderate: test-generation plus execution-feedback loops exist (AgentCoder, LLMLOOP, TENET, Mathews & Nagappan all cited); the differentiators—single-agent dual-track co-refinement of tests and code, tests as evolving artifacts—are an incremental reconfiguration of known components. Evidence is decent but the isolated test-first effect is small (Appendix B Table 6: removing test generation from TDD-prompt drops pass@1 by only ~0.6-1.7 points), no significance testing or variance reported, and the DeepSeek mini-SWE-agent jump (84.18 vs GPT 61.31) is unexplained. Only Python, only RepoEval function-completion subset for the agent study; authors flag Python-only scope, limited repo understanding, and flaky-test risk. Anonymous code release plus full prompts and generation parameters support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generati
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在程式碼生成上進展顯著，但在複雜的儲存庫層級任務中確保正確性仍具挑戰。既有方法多將生成的測試視為靜態的事後驗證器，難以引導實作，且當測試本身不完整或錯誤時可能提供誤導回饋。這篇論文提出 TDD-Agent，將測試驅動開發（TDD）範式具體化：單一代理先扮演測試設計者生成可執行測試，釐清預期行為後再實作程式碼，並透過執行回饋對程式碼與測試進行雙軌迭代精煉，使兩者共同演化為推理產物而非固定驗證器。作者先在 LiveCodeBench 上以 TDD-prompt 變體隔離測試先行推理的效果，顯示其在三個模型上皆超越 CoT、SCoT、Self-Planning 等基線；再於儲存庫層級基準 RepoEval（455 個函式補全問題）評估完整框架，迭代十輪時在 GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2 與 Qwen3-Coder-30B 上分別達 78.24%、90.77% 與 59.34%，一致超越 mini-SWE-agent 等基線。分析顯示生成測試的通過率、覆蓋率與突變分數隨迭代提升；失敗案例多屬測試與程式碼內部一致但未涵蓋預期行為。限制包括僅支援 Python、工具集輕量對儲存庫理解有限，且迭代帶來額外 token 與延遲成本。此工作證明測試可作為演化中的推理工件，提升儲存庫層級程式生成的可靠度。

links.title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs

evidence: Section 2, 'The cost objective': Eq. (1) defines a batch-average cost penalty with operator-set threshold tau and graded slope kappa; the penalty exists only at training time, while 'held-out and leaderboard evaluations report raw score and cost as separate axes'.

Section 2, 'Evolving agents over a menu of models': nine priced handles across three providers spanning ~10x per-token price; the fourteen board entries use one to five models, with cascades, ensembles, and per-stage assignment discovered rather than hand-designed.

Section 3, 'Frontier results': every ReAct and Smolagents entry on the DS-1000 board is dominated by a RoboPhD point; the only non-RoboPhD survivor board-wide is the hand-built Button (0.836 @ $0.028 vs. best RoboPhD 0.862 @ $0.127).

Section 5, 'Experimental evidence on resistance to overfitting': four runs at five waypoints show monotonic held-out score increases (15/15 steps, Table 7 / Appendix D) — a conceptually sound but small-n check with no statistical test; PaperFindingBench waypoint scores are on the internal judge basis, 'within-arm comparisons only'.

Section 6, items 1-3: verbatim-evidence grounding enforced evaluator-side pre-judge; judge-cost exploitation (mean evidence 976 to 1,257 chars, then capped at 2,500); wall-clock and 60-minute session-cap incidents; 'every cap breach on record occurred at kappa/tau >= 0.2' with no breach under kappa <= 0.1tau across ten runs.

Appendix G: PaperFindingBench standard errors ~0.016-0.018; the board leader's +0.0076 score edge over Asta Paper Finder is inside one stderr while its 21% cost edge is ~8 stderr; the 0.440 and 0.390 entries were 'awaiting maintainer confirmation' (Figure 1 caption).

Appendix A, 'Training-judge basis': submitted runs trained against gpt-5.6-luna (Cohen's kappa = 0.755 vs. official gpt-4o-2024-11-20 basis), disclosed as 'a systematic headwind on our reported PaperFindingBench results'.

Reproducibility statement: every run listed in Appendix A with tau, kappa, evolution model, and costs; boards reconstructable from the public allenai/asta-bench-results dataset; 'Raw full-precision submission files are archived with the paper materials'; however, the engine itself is described only in the companion RoboPhD paper and no code-release claim appears in this document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper applying the RoboPhD evolutionary engine (from a companion paper) to two AstaBench leaderboards with a new cost-targeted objective. Highly on-topic for LLMs, agentic tool use, multi-model orchestration, code generation, retrieval, and reward hacking. Novelty is a genuine but incremental increment: the batch-average free-zone cost penalty with settable slope (Eq. 1) and per-call-site model choice over a priced nine-handle menu are new relative to FrugalGPT/routing and the fixed-model harness-evolution wave, but the core engine, controlled baselines (GEPA, Autoresearch), and diversity mechanisms are deferred to the companion work. Rigor is strong on transparency (stderr reporting in Appendix G, disclosed train/score judge mismatch, full run registry) but thin on controlled ablations: the kappa two-arm experiment and the four-run waypoint overfitting analysis are small and narrative, and leaderboard 'domination' is partly by construction since tau targets were set at incumbent prices and entries were post-hoc selected from runs. Evidence is unusually detailed and internally consistent, with officially scored submissions and a public results dataset, though two entries awaited maintainer confirmation and headline claims rest on external leaderboards. Generalizability is plausibly broad ('if you can benchmark it...') but demonstrated on only two tasks within one benchmark suite, both with automatic verifiers. Reproducibility is good on the evaluation side (public dataset, verbatim objective/seed documents, archived submission files) but the engine code release is never explicitly claimed here.
topics: cost-quality Pareto optimization of LLM pipelines

primary_link.title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs

papers.summary: Consider a firm that surveys its competition for a particular agentic task and seeks to offer superior accuracy at every competitor price point. A firm that Pareto-dominated its competitors would leave no rational customer a reason to buy elsewhere. This paper shows a path to this kind of capability via agentic evolution over a menu of LLMs, from training pools of at most 100 examples. Given a priced menu of nine LLM endpoints; brief documentation of the task, objective, and API; a simple seed a
papers.summary_zh: 企業部署 LLM 代理必須權衡品質與推論成本，理想目標是在每個競爭對手的價格點提供更優準確度，達成帕累托支配。這篇論文展示 RoboPhD 演化式元代理如何達成此目標：給定九個計價的 LLM 端點選單、任務說明文件、簡單種子代理與操作者設定的成本目標，RoboPhD 在 Claude Code 環境中以演化會議迭代改寫完整代理程式，目標函數結合批次平均正確率與超出成本門檻的梯度懲罰（斜率 κ=0.1τ），並以 Elo 頭對頭錦標賽選拔；每輪隨機抽樣批次，並明確告知最佳化器「可見批次是訓練訊號而非目標」以抵抗過擬合，訓練池僅 66 至 100 筆範例。在 AstaBench 的 DS-1000（資料科學程式碼生成）與 PaperFindingBench（科學文獻檢索）兩個公開排行榜上，官方計分的 14 個提交幾乎占滿成本—品質帕累托前沿：DS-1000 僅保留手工打造的 Button，PaperFindingBench 僅保留較便宜版的 Asta Paper Finder；演化代理長 302 至 2,781 行，自主發現級聯、組合與逐階段模型指派等策略。論文亦記錄管理元代理的經驗，如要求證據逐字可溯源、為評審成本與執行時間等未計價資源定價。限制包括訓練與計分評審不一致，以及兩個手工系統仍未攻下。此工作展示成本感知的代理演化可成為自動設計平台。

links.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Automated Safety Benchmarks for Small Language Models

evidence: Abstract / Section 1 contributions: '741,312 model-prompt evaluations across five benchmark suites over 26 SLMs, with 715,312 judge-scored safety evaluations and 26,000 BBQ bias evaluations'
Section 3.1: 'We evaluate 26 SLMs spanning 124M to 4B parameters across different model families'; judging by 'GPT-4o (openai/gpt-4o-2024-05-13)' with Llama 3.1 405B retained for robustness
Section 3.2: SALAD-Bench reinterpreted via 'Otsu-based thresholding' into a ternary scale, acknowledged in Section 5.3 as needing 'validating ... under different threshold choices'

Section 4.2 Table 1: within-benchmark ambiguity prediction, AirBench best classifier Random Forest Acc 0.786 / Bal. Acc 0.773 / ROC-AUC 0.855; Table 3 unseen-SLM transfer HarmBench LightGBM ROC-AUC 0.905

Section 4.2 Table 4: instruction tuning r=-0.49 (p=0.011) and attention heads r=-0.42 (p=0.035) vs ambiguity rate across n=26 models; paper states these are 'descriptive evidence ... not causal claims'
Section 4.2 Table 5: judge agreement 0.75 (HarmBench) and 0.81 (Simple Safety), with disagreement concentrated at 0.5<->{0,1} boundary (0.21 vs 0.04 direct flips on HarmBench)

Section 5.2: proposes ambiguity-adjusted score 'S_adj = S_raw(1-AR)' as a penalized diagnostic; Section 5.3: 'Our core claims do not require human ground-truth validation'; no code or data release statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A meta-evaluation of automated LLM safety benchmarks (HELM Safety, AirBench, SALAD-Bench, HarmBench, SST, BBQ) on 26 SLMs, squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: LLMs, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation, plus scaling/efficiency via the SLM focus. Strengths: very large-scale measurement (741,312 evaluations, Section 1 contributions), unified ternary rubric, FDR-corrected metric-ambiguity correlations, ambiguity-prediction classifiers with cross-benchmark and unseen-SLM transfer, judge-robustness comparison (GPT-4o vs Llama 3.1 405B, Table 5), and careful hedging that findings are correlational (Section 4.2). Novelty is moderate: judge sensitivity to surface features is known (Section 2.3, citing Zheng et al.), and the S_adj = S_raw(1-AR) proposal is trivial (Section 5.2); the SLM-specific ambiguity/brittleness analysis is the main increment over prior safetywashing-style critiques. Weaknesses: metadata correlations rest on only 26 models (Table 4), the SALAD Otsu ternary mapping is ad hoc and unvalidated (Section 3.2, 5.3), no human ground truth for ambiguous labels, and no code/data release statement despite detailed hyperparameters (temperature 0, seeds, judge versions in Section 3.1). Evidence for rank brittleness is strong and mathematically grounded; evidence for the capability-safety confound interpretation is solid but inferential. Not out-of-scope: this is language-model methodology, not a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Automated Safety Benchmarks for Small Language Models

papers.summary: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in resource-constrained, privacy-sensitive settings, where safety and bias failures can cause security and societal risks. However, existing AI safety\slash security\slash compliance benchmarks are designed for large language models that may not transfer reliably to SLMs. We therefore ask: Can these benchmarks effectively and reliably evaluate SLMs? To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale assessment of the effectiveness and robustn
papers.summary_zh: 小型語言模型（SLM）廣泛部署於資源受限且隱私敏感的環境，但現有 AI 安全基準多為大型 LLM 設計，未必可靠地適用於 SLM。這篇論文以 26 個開源 SLM（124M 至 4B 參數）在五個常用基準套件（AirBench、SALAD-Bench、HarmBench、Simple Safety Tests、BBQ）上執行約 741,312 次模型—提示詞評估，以統一評分準則（0 為有害、1 為安全、0.5 為模糊）檢視自動化評審管線的有效性與穩健性。研究發現模糊判定占主導地位，且與提示詞複雜度、輸出品質及模型架構相關：模糊率隨詞彙密度、輸出困惑度與長度上升，隨詞彙精緻度、自我連貫性與回覆相似度下降；模糊標籤可由分類器預測，在未見模型上 ROC-AUC 達 0.877 至 0.905，顯示能力—安全混淆效應。由於模糊比例偏高，平均分數排行榜在數學上脆弱：改變模糊標籤的處理方式（樂觀、悲觀、移除或部分給分）會使模型排名大幅變動。作者建議明確報告模糊率、發展 SLM 專屬基準，並提出以原始分數乘上（1−AR）的調整分數。此工作對安全評估用於合規與採購決策時的可信度具重要意涵，呼籲為 SLM 開發更貼合其能力的評測方法。
