links.title: Polaris: Learning to Generate Table Descriptions from Retrieval Feedback

evidence: Abstract: 'trains an LLM to generate table descriptions directly from retrieval feedback... use the resulting preference pairs to fine-tune the LLM with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).'

Section 3.4: 'We use Llama 3.1 8B Instruct as the base model, with 4-bit quantization and LoRA... 167M trainable parameters out of 8.2B total (2.05%). We train for one epoch with beta=0.1, learning rate 5e-6.'
Section 4, Tables 2-3: 'NDCG@100 on LTER: 0.356->0.515, +44.6% relative, and NDCG@5 on AW: 0.555->0.731, +31.7% relative'; 'On the last dataset, WikiTables, both methods perform similarly.'
Section 4 (Ablation, Effect of DPO Training): 'The exception is ECIR, where accuracy decreases (e.g., .495 vs .570 at @5)' — honest reporting of a negative ablation.
Section 5: 'The closest concurrent work is Coelho et al. (2025), who optimize query generation using retrieval feedback' — bounds novelty of the retrieval-feedback-DPO idea.

Section 7 Limitations: 'Our current training objective derives preferences solely from BM25 retrieval scores... may not transfer to retrieval systems based primarily on dense embeddings or hybrid ranking.'
Section 1: 'The code is available at github.com/anhaidgroup/polaris, and the datasets at hf.co/collections/anhaidgroup/polaris-v1' (claimed, not verifiable from document).
Appendix A.5 (Downsampling Strategy): WikiTables and WTR corpora downsampled via BM25 top-50 retrieval plus all gold tables, a protocol deviation not stress-tested against full-corpus evaluation.
Section 4 (Sensitivity): 'Table 13 shows that Polaris with Qwen outperforms Polaris with Llama on AW, Arctic, and WikiTables, but underperforms on LTER' — mixed LLM-dependence reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: fine-tunes Llama 3.1 8B via DPO (Section 3.4, QLoRA/LoRA details) using preference pairs automatically derived from BM25 retrieval effectiveness over existing query-table relevance benchmarks, with name expansion and a 6-dataset benchmark. Strongly matches LLM, Alignment/DPO, RAG/retrieval, and NLP preferences; not in any excluded out-of-scope category. Novelty is genuine but bounded: the paper itself cites concurrent DPO-from-retrieval-feedback work for query generation (Section 5, Coelho et al. 2025) and document rewriting (Uzan et al. 2026), so the contribution is the application to table descriptions and benchmark-repurposing framing. Rigor is decent: leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, ablations (Tables 9-12), sensitivity to LLM/beta/K/epochs (A.8-A.11), and honest negative results (DPO hurts ECIR, .495 vs .570; WikiTables near-parity). Weaknesses: no significance testing or variance across runs, only one system baseline (AutoDDG) with no direct comparison to the six solutions AutoDDG beat, and BM25-based downsampling of WikiTables/WTR corpora (A.5) alters the original benchmarks. Evidence is mostly solid: headline numbers verified from Tables 2-3 (LTER NDCG@100 .356->.515, +44.6%; AW NDCG@5 .555->.731), but some claims (approximation 'negligible loss', 'largest benchmark to date') are asserted without shown data. Generalizability is limited by the need for relevance labels and BM25-specific optimization, both acknowledged in Section 7. Reproducibility is good: full prompts (A.1-A.2), hyperparameters (Table 8), Elasticsearch settings, dataset construction details, and stated code/dataset releases.

primary_link.title: Polaris: Learning to Generate Table Descriptions from Retrieval Feedback

papers.summary: Many table-centric NLP tasks such as NL2SQL first retrieve relevant tables from large collections using keyword search. Recent work uses LLMs to generate natural-language table descriptions to improve retrieval, but they are typically optimized for fluency rather than retrieval effectiveness. We present Polaris, a system that trains an LLM to generate table descriptions directly from retrieval feedback. Our key insight is that existing table retrieval benchmarks already contain the supervision n
papers.summary_zh: NL2SQL 等表格任務需先透過關鍵字搜尋從大量表格中檢索相關資料，但表格與欄位名稱常晦澀簡短，直接搜尋效果不佳。近期研究以 LLM 生成自然語言表格描述改善檢索，卻多為流暢度而非檢索效果進行最佳化。這篇論文提出 Polaris，其核心洞察是既有表格檢索基準本身已含訓練所需的監督資訊：給定查詢—表格相關性標註，系統為每個 gold 表格生成多個候選描述，依 BM25 檢索效果排序構成偏好對，再以 Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）微調 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct（搭配 LoRA 與 4-bit 量化），並結合表格與欄位名稱擴展（如將 DTPh 展開為 daytime phone）以降低詞彙不匹配。作者建構涵蓋企業、科學、政府與網頁領域的六個標註資料集，為迄今最大的表格關鍵字搜尋評測基準。留一資料集實驗顯示 Polaris 全面超越現有最佳方法 AutoDDG，例如 LTER 上 NDCG@100 相對提升 44.6%，平均描述長度縮短 47-59%；結合多欄位（描述、名稱擴展與脈絡）的 BM25 檢索可再進一步提升。限制包括需要相關性標註、偏好訊號僅源自 BM25 故未必遷移至密集檢索，且不使用表格內容。此工作示範檢索基準可轉為訓練檢索導向元資料生成器的監督來源，對資料目錄與資料探索深具價值。
papers.title: Polaris: Learning to Generate Table Descriptions from Retrieval Feedback
papers.title_zh: Polaris：從檢索回饋學習生成表格描述

links.title: VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience

evidence: Abstract: claims improvements of 'increasing mean scores by 3.20–4.98 points' via distilling public skill version changes into reusable experience.
Section 3.1: motivation study constructs 'a comparison corpus containing 400 skill-change units from each source' with LLM-judge annotation verified by humans.
Section 5.2 / Table 1: VCE improves every benchmark score for each base evolver; ~1.1M additional tokens, 'approximately 10% additional token overhead relative to the best-performing baseline.'
Section 5.1: 'Each experimental configuration is independently run three times, and we report the mean results' — no variance or significance tests reported anywhere.
Section 5.3: 'w/o Dist even falling below SkillOpt on all four models'; adaptive attention ablation (w/o Atte) still beats base on 3 of 4 models.
Section 5.4 / Table 2: transfer gains of 6.04, 5.25, 5.15 average points over SkillOpt for three target models; Appendix C.3 reports all 60 benchmark-level comparisons positive.
Appendix D, Table 6: human audit HAR 86.5%-100.0% and Cohen's κ 0.75-0.84 across six LLM-based decision types.
Appendix B: full system prompts (Figures 4-11) and Algorithms 1-2 given; however no code or data availability statement appears in the paper.
Appendix B.1: experience banks are benchmark-specific, 'we manually select the five skills most closely aligned with its task' — a manual step limiting automatic generalization.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM-agent skill self-evolution method (Agents & Tool Use, weight 2.5) that mines public skill version histories (GitHub/ClawHub) into structured 'version-change experience' and adaptively fuses it with trajectory-derived proposals from base evolvers. The motivating pilot study (Section 3, 400 matched change units per source) and the provenance-tagged attention fusion are reasonably novel, though the retrieve-external-experience-then-fuse pattern is incremental and the attention update is a simple clipped scalar heuristic (Eq. 16, η=0.1, clip [0.3,0.7]). Rigor is solid: 5 benchmarks, 4 models, 3 base evolvers, 3 runs each (Section 5.1), ablations (Section 5.3), hyperparameter sensitivity (Appendix C.2, Table 5), 12-pair transfer matrix (Appendix C.3), and a human audit of LLM decisions with κ 0.75-0.84 (Appendix D, Table 6). Key weaknesses: no variance or statistical significance testing despite 3-run means, uniformly positive gains across all 60 transfer comparisons with no error analysis, no explicit limitations section, and experience banks are manually curated per benchmark (Appendix B.1), limiting plug-and-play use. Detailed prompts, algorithms, and hyperparameters support partial reproducibility, but no code/data release is stated and dependency on future API models and unavailabile base evolvers hinders replication.

primary_link.title: VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience

papers.summary: Agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to encode task knowledge, tool-use procedures, and validation rules. Existing skill self-evolution methods primarily revise skills using execution trajectories collected from current tasks, leaving the evolution knowledge accumulated in public skill version histories largely untapped. Our pilot study reveals a clear complementarity between the two sources: public skill changes provide reusable evolution priors, whereas trajectories provide evidence gro
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理日益依賴可重複使用的技能套件，但既有技能自我演化方法主要利用當前任務的執行軌跡修訂技能，忽略了公開技能版本歷史所累積的演化知識。這篇論文的先導研究比較 GitHub 與 ClawHub 上的公開技能版本變更與軌跡衍生變更，發現兩者互補：公開變更涵蓋更廣的元件、意圖與模式（如 BFCL 領域有 5 個公開專屬意圖類別），軌跡變更則提供任務在地證據。據此作者提出 VCE-Skill，分為兩階段：經驗蒸餾將原始 diff 抽象為更新事件，再逐步泛化為更新模式、技能層洞察與領域洞察，構成經驗庫；最佳化階段由基礎演化器從軌跡產生自我提案，LLM 選擇器依任務與技能狀態檢索至多五條經驗，並以自適應注意力權重（初始各 0.5，依來源歸因與驗證回饋以步長 0.1 更新並裁剪至 [0.3, 0.7]）融合兩者。在 SearchQA、OfficeQA、ALFWorld、Spreadsheet 與 BFCL-v4 五個基準、四個 LLM（Qwen3.5-27B、GPT-5.2、DeepSeek-v3.2、Claude Sonnet 5）上增強三種基礎演化器，平均提升 3.20 至 4.98 分；跨模型遷移實驗平均再提升 5.15 至 6.19 分，顯示外部經驗降低對源模型的依賴。限制包括需人工挑選技能、額外約 1.1M token 開銷，且稽核顯示經驗選擇的人類接受率最低（86.5%）。
papers.title: VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience
papers.title_zh: VCE-Skill：以版本變更經驗強化技能自我演化

links.title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness

evidence: Abstract: 'a comparative evaluation across six benchmarks and four instruction-tuned models' studying NLE source (human, self-generated, external LLM) and selection (random vs faithfulness-based) in ICL
Table 1 (§5.1): LLM-NLEs often best on classification-style benchmarks (e.g., boolean 0.916 with LLM-o3 vs 0.877 self-NLE); CoT baseline strongest on gsm8k (0.809)

Table 3 (§5.2): faithful selection of self-NLEs yields small average gains (+0.010 fm1, +0.009 fm2) vs random; lowest-faithful harmful on average (-0.035 fm1, -0.041 fm2), with metric- and model-dependent effects (gsm8k: +0.350 Llama-70B vs -0.405 Mistral-7B under faithful-fm2)
Table 9 (Appendix L): average disagreement rate between fm1 and fm2 faithfulness metrics is 0.504 across datasets and models
Appendix A (Limitations): fixed 6-shot setup, four models, limited budget, OOD setting restricted to LLM-NLEs, and evaluation-subset variation across selection settings acknowledged
Contributions (§1): 'we will release all code, explanation datasets, and prompts used in this study upon acceptance' - release promised, not verified
Table 11 (Appendix M.2): Stuart-Maxwell significance tests with matched no-rationale baselines FS-fm1/FS-fm2 used as references
Appendix H, Table 7: ablation comparing gold-label-conditioned vs original post-hoc Ph-CoT self-explanations (overall avg +0.047 in favor of gold conditioning)
Appendices E-G: full prompt templates for prompting, faithfulness metrics (fm1 sub-metrics, fm2 counterfactual), and LLM-NLE generation; Appendix B: seeds, temperature, n=6, 3-step Ph-CoT specified
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM/NLP empirical study: compares human, self-generated (post-hoc CoT), and external LLM-generated natural language explanations as few-shot rationales in ICL across six benchmarks (ECQA, e-SNLI, SNARKS, Boolean, Causal Judgment, GSM8K) and four instruction-tuned models (GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Mistral-7B), with faithfulness-based selection and misalignment stress tests. Strong preference relevance to LLMs, prompting/ICL, chain-of-thought, and explainability/faithfulness. Novelty is moderate: the framework reuses error-based sampling and Ph-CoT from Bhan et al. (2024) and adopts both faithfulness metrics from prior work; the main new contributions are the systematic source comparison, the ~0.5 disagreement rate between faithfulness metrics (Table 9), and OOD-rationale stress tests extending Zhou et al. (2024). Rigor is solid but constrained: 5 runs with std devs, Stuart-Maxwell significance tests against matched no-rationale controls (FS-fm1/FS-fm2), a gold-label-conditioning ablation (Table 7), and honest limitations; however, evaluation subsets vary across selection settings, dataset pools are small (168-310), average self-NLE gains are small (+0.010/+0.009), and some cells show high variance (e.g., std 0.244, Mistral/ECQA lowest-faithful). Evidence is quantitatively supported by Tables 1-4 and 9, though headline conclusions partly rest on noisy model-dataset aggregates. Generalizability is limited by fixed 6-shot setup, only two datasets with human rationales, and OOD restricted to LLM-NLEs. Reproducibility is aided by full prompt templates, implementation details, and a promised (not yet verifiable) code/data release.

primary_link.title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness

papers.summary: Natural language explanations (NLEs) are increasingly used as inputs, for example, as few-shot rationales that influence model behavior in in-context learning (ICL). However, it remains unclear how different types of NLEs compare in their effects on downstream model performance in explanation-augmented prompting. Therefore, we provide a comparative evaluation across six benchmarks and four instruction-tuned models, studying how NLE source (human-written when available, self-generated explanation
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討自然語言解釋（NLE）作為 few-shot 提示中的推理依據時，其來源與選取策略如何影響大型語言模型在 in-context learning（ICL）下的下游表現。作者在六個基準資料集與四個指令微調模型上，系統比較人類撰寫、模型自我產生（self-NLE）與外部 LLM 產生的解釋，並以兩種忠實性（faithfulness）指標進行高低篩選，另加入隨機置換與跨領域解釋的穩健性測試。主要結果顯示：在分類型任務上，加入解釋常優於無解釋的 few-shot 提示，其中外部 LLM 產生的解釋效用最強且穩定，與人類解釋相當甚至更佳；自我解釋則對選取策略較敏感，且在數學推理上效果更依賴模型與來源。以忠實性為基礎篩選自我解釋僅帶來小幅平均增益，效果隨指標、任務與模型而異；兩種忠實性指標的分歧率約達五成，顯示指標選擇本身就是重大決策，單一指標不應視為真值。錯位解釋雖降低效能但模型不會崩潰，呈現部分穩健性，證明語意對齊確實貢獻增益。此研究為實務上挑選與報告提示用解釋提供了明確依據。
papers.title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness
papers.title_zh: 自然語言解釋何時有助於 in-context learning？自然語言解釋類型與忠實性的比較研究

links.title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning

evidence: Abstract: PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6% of tested problems vs up to 45.3% for adapted LLM-Formalizers and 74.5% for direct LLM planning on the NL-pddlgym test set.
Section 4 (Evaluation): 'Each model, problem and approach configuration was evaluated once. The reported results therefore do not quantify sampling variance between different runs.'

Section 3.1: 23 domain descriptions and seed problems manually authored; remaining problem descriptions generated by DeepSeek v4 Flash, the same model that achieves the best evaluation result (Table 3, 89.6% level-3).
Section 4.3 / Table 5: ablations show removing PlanAgent drops level-3 by 20.8 pp; rigid execution drops to 60/106; CRU-only reaches 68/106; PlanAgent feedback costs a 2.74x output-token increase.
Section 3.1: NL-pddlgym has 711 problems across 23 domains with executable pddlgym environments; test set is 106 problems across 4 held-out domains, plans of 2-557 steps.
Section 4 (Evaluation): MapAgent verified at 98.1% success when mapping plans from ground-truth PDDL files.
Title page: code released at github.com/vDawgg/PDDLCoder; Appendices D-G supply all agent, rigid-pipeline, and baseline prompts; Appendix A lists hardware and per-model sampling parameters.
Section 4.2 / Table 4: adapted baselines include modified VML_PDDL (LLM grading instead of log-prob selection 'due to restrictions of the DeepSeek API'), limiting strict comparability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM methodology paper: an agentic (ReAct/DSPy) framework where an LLM autonomously generates, edits, and refines PDDL via tool calls (syntax checks via VAL, planning via Fast Downward, LLM plan feedback), plus an executable benchmark. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: the agentic loop is an application of established ReAct/SWE-agent-style tooling to PDDL, and the benchmark reuses pddlgym and classical-domains assets with LLM-authored NL descriptions; the adaptive (non-rigid) refinement and plan-applicability verification are genuine but incremental contributions. Rigor benefits from four ablations, adapted baselines (NL2Plan, VML_PDDL, ISR-LLM, CoT), and six open-weight models, but is limited by single-run evaluations, a small 106-problem test set over 4 held-out domains, and modified baselines (e.g., LLM grading replacing log-prob selection in VML_PDDL). A notable validity concern is that DeepSeek v4 Flash, the top-scoring model, was also used to generate most benchmark NL descriptions, risking style advantage. Evidence is quantitatively supported (level-3 counts, per-domain rates, token costs, MapAgent 98.1% sanity check), though without variance estimates. Generalizability is constrained to deterministic STRIPS-style classical planning and is highly model-dependent (several models score ~0). Reproducibility is good: public GitHub repo, full prompts in Appendices D-G, hardware and sampling parameters in Appendix A.

primary_link.title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning

papers.summary: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated veri
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在長程規劃上常產生邏輯不一致或無法執行的行動序列，既有的 LLM 形式化方法又依賴固定流程、部分規格或人類回饋，且缺乏含自動驗證的標準化基準。PDDLCoder 提出一個 agentic 框架，將自然語言迭代轉換為規劃領域定義語言（PDDL），再交由符號規劃器產生可驗證計畫。系統以 ReAct 式代理運作，配備建立、讀取、編輯 PDDL 檔案的工具，以及語法檢查、計畫生成與由 PlanAgent 提供的計畫可行性回饋，可自主決定修正步驟，全程零樣本且無需人類介入或預定義領域檔案。作者並發布 NL-pddlgym 基準，含 23 個領域、711 個規劃問題與可執行的 gym 環境，直接驗證計畫能否實際執行並達成目標。在 4 個保留領域、106 個問題的測試集上，搭配 DeepSeek v4 Flash 的 PDDLCoder 達到 89.6% 的可適用計畫成功率，優於改編自 NL2Plan 等既有方法的 45.3%，也勝過直接 LLM 規劃的 74.5%。消融實驗顯示各項回饋工具與彈性執行流程皆有貢獻，但成效高度取決於模型產生語法正確 PDDL 與可靠計畫回饋的能力；較弱模型常重複套用無效編輯而耗盡預算。此工作為 LLM 輔助符號規劃建立了可重現的評測基礎。
papers.title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
papers.title_zh: PDDLCoder：用於 LLM 輔助符號規劃的 agentic PDDL 生成

links.title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning

evidence: Sec. 1: primary capability is 'agentic task completion: multi-step planning, tool/function calling, and long-horizon task completion' on a 744B/~40B-active MoE base
Sec. 4.2: two-gate acceptance (verifier scoring vs teacher answer, cheating filter rejecting 4-gram overlap >0.8 with demonstration), rollout caps of 20 tool calls and 6 attempts
Sec. 4.4: primary recipe is 12 private datasets totaling 626 curated trajectories, offline SFT only
Sec. 5.1: ASFT loss with DFT token weighting plus KL anchor K=0.1 using the k3 estimator on teacher target tokens
Sec. 5.5: systematic matrix of twelve SFT/ASFT runs varying objective, KL strength, LR, batch size, context length, and six data recipes; zero-LR sanity run
Sec. 6.1-6.2: comparisons produced 'within WRITER's evaluation infrastructure' against internal prior default; Palmyra x6 tops BFCL Core at 0.785 with six-benchmark mean 0.765
Sec. 7.2: admits the hypothesis that the KL anchor preserves alignment/refusal behavior 'have not verified this latter hypothesis with rigorous experimentation'
Sec. 7.4: bias eval with 8 endpoints, 19,674 responses, 33,862 blinded judge scorings, 556 paired prompt families, paired bootstrap/Wilcoxon/BH correction
Sec. 7.5: FORTRESS evaluation shows adversarial safety 67.0 vs base 58.4 with system message, benign 96.4
Sec. 8: limitations acknowledge coverage bounded by 12 task domains and ~626 single-epoch trajectories
llm_evaluation.rationale: A technical report squarely within core preferences: LLM post-training for agentic tool use, with a borrowed-but-sensibly-adapted objective (ASFT with DFT weighting and a k3 KL anchor, Sec. 5.1), a Muon+Adam optimizer hybrid, and a synthetic on-policy-style trajectory pipeline with verifier and leakage-control gates (Sec. 4.2). Rigor is moderate-to-good: a 12-run ablation matrix varying objective, KL weight, LR, batch size, context, and data mixes (Sec. 5.5), a zero-LR sanity run, and statistically supported bias/safety evaluations (Sec. 7.4-7.5). However, headline capability evidence rests on a private internal harness and a private 'prior default' comparator (Sec. 6.1), key results are figure-only, and the authors concede the alignment-preservation claim of the KL anchor is unverified (Sec. 7.2). Novelty is limited to application and engineering refinements (e.g., Muon Split for MLA, cheating filter), since ASFT, Muon, and SDFT are all cited prior work. Reproducibility is hampered by fully private training data (626 trajectories) and a commercial license, despite unusually detailed hyperparameters and infrastructure disclosure (Tables 1-2, Sec. 5.4).

primary_link.title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: Palmyra x6 is a large language model optimized for use with enterprise-oriented agentic tasks. The model was built by post-training a Mixture-of-Experts base model with Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning on a compact corpus of verified, synthetic tool-use trajectories, optimized with a Muon + Adam hybrid. The recipe is deliberately conservative and deliberately controlled: 626 trajectories, a single epoch, a low learning rate, and a KL anchor to the frozen base. The model shows substantial gains ov
papers.summary_zh: Palmyra x6 是 Writer 推出的 agentic 工具使用模型，聚焦多步驟規劃、函式呼叫與長程任務完成。團隊選用總參數 744B、每 token 約啟用 40B 的 GLM-5.2 混合專家（MoE）基底，以錨定監督式微調（ASFT）後訓練：損失結合 DFT 式 token 機率加權與對凍結基底模型的 KL 錨定（K=0.1），並採用作用於 2-D 權重矩陣的 Muon 與 Adam 混合最佳化器。訓練資料全為合成的 agentic 工具使用軌跡，涵蓋金融研究、資料分析與程式設計、醫療代理、MCP 工具套件、模擬世界與 RAG 六類，經結構過濾、任務驗證器與雙模型評審三道關卡後僅保留 626 條軌跡，以單一 epoch 與低學習率完成訓練，全程離線、無 RL。評測顯示 Palmyra x6 在六項基準上全面超越 Writer Agent 先前預設模型（如 MCP-Atlas +0.320），並以 BFCL Core 0.785 與六基準平均 0.765 領先同期多款前沿模型；安全評估呈現均衡的政治立場、低過度拒答與良好的對抗安全表現，FORTRESS 上系統訊息使對抗安全提升 8.6 分。限制在於專精 agentic 負載、資料覆蓋受限於 12 個任務領域，且比較主要在自家評測基礎設施內進行。此案例說明少量高品質軌跡搭配錨定目標，即可賦予工具使用行為而不侵蝕基底能力。
papers.title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning

links.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract: 'on ALFWorld, SOPD improves the average success rate by 13.4 points over Vanilla OPD' — verified from §5.1 Table 1 deltas (+18.57 Seen, +21.64 Unseen, +0.00 Hard average to 13.40).
§5.1 Table 1 caption: 'TCOD supplies all rows except SOPD' — agent baselines are imported from Wang et al. (2026) rather than rerun under identical conditions.
§5.1 Table 1 Hard split: SOPD SR 10.74 with '↔ 0.00' change from Vanilla OPD and below TCOD-B2F at 13.22, contradicting a uniform-improvement reading.
§5.2 Table 2: SOPD Avg4 57.7 vs OPD 47.7 (+10.0); caption notes 'The first three rows are reference results reported by G-OPD', so part of the comparison is cross-paper.

§4.4: one-step limit recovers the sequence teacher-forcing loss (Eq. 8) and one-token limit equals cross-entropy = teacher entropy + forward KL on student prefixes (Eq. 9); derivation is correct but mathematically standard.
Appendix A.1: SOPD uses learning rate 2e-6 while OPD uses 1e-5, with no equal-tuning justification; both run only ten optimizer updates.
Appendix A.1: full teacher GRPO config (batch 128, lr 1e-6, 500 updates), evaluation seeds 42+32i+j, 960 responses per benchmark, Math-Verify rule-based checking — supports reproducibility.
Reproducibility Statement: 'The submission source includes the figure-generation scripts and the aggregated records' — no explicit commitment to release training code.
Appendix B: generative AI used for language editing and LaTeX; authors state they verified all reported results.
§2 Related Work positions SOPD against TRD, OEC, TCOD, Guided-OPD, and ReOPD, indicating a highly active adjacent space that limits the incremental novelty claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology (on-policy distillation for math reasoning and interactive agents) with a strong match to preferred topics. The interpolation framing between SFT and forward-KL OPD via step granularity is clean and the two-limit derivation is correct, but novelty is tempered by a crowded step-level OPD landscape the paper itself documents (TRD, TCOD, Guided-OPD, ReOPD, SOD, StepOPSD, SAF-OPD). Rigor is moderate: single runs without variance or significance testing, only one model pair per domain, no ablations over step-partition rules, unequal learning rates for SOPD vs OPD, and the Hard split shows no gain over Vanilla OPD (and trails TCOD-B2F). Quantitative claims are internally consistent (13.4-pt ALFWorld average and 10.0-pt math average both verified from the tables), yet key baselines are imported from prior papers rather than rerun, and math evaluation rests on 30-problem sets. Reproducibility is above average given full hyperparameters, seeds, public checkpoints and datasets, though training-code release is not explicitly committed.

primary_link.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student model with a teacher's logit distribution on student-generated trajectories. This approach has achieved strong empirical gains and can often surpass conventional off-policy distillation with substantially less data. However, standard token-level OPD can provide only fragmented corrections along an erroneous student trajectory and cannot unfold a complete and correct repair path. Motivated by this limitation, we propose \emph{Step-Level On-Policy Dist
papers.summary_zh: On-policy 蒸餾（OPD）讓學生模型在其自行產生的軌跡上對齊教師的 logits 分布，資料效率高，但標準 token 級 OPD 只能在錯誤軌跡上提供片段式修正，無法展開完整正確的修復路徑。本文提出步驟級 on-policy 蒸餾（SOPD）：先讓學生完成完整軌跡並依領域特性切成自然步驟（數學推理以段落邊界、代理任務以環境互動回合為單位），再於每個學生前綴上請教師獨立產生一個目標步驟；教師輸出不進入後續狀態，因此保有 on-policy 的狀態分布。訓練採用步驟平衡的交叉熵損失以防止長目標主導，並以 packed attention mask 在單次前向傳播中平行處理。理論上，當步驟等於整段回應時 SOPD 化約為 SFT，當步驟縮至單一 token 時則近似前向 KL 的 OPD，揭示兩種典範間的連續光譜；且僅需教師文字輸出、不需 logits，適合黑箱蒸餾。實驗涵蓋 ALFWorld 與數學推理：SOPD 在 ALFWorld 的 Seen/Unseen 成功率較 Vanilla OPD 分別提升 18.57 與 21.64 個百分點並減少互動輪數；數學四項競賽基準平均由 47.7 提升至 57.7。限制包括步驟切分依賴領域啟發式規則，評測亦集中於特定模型配對。
papers.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 步驟級 On-Policy 蒸餾：在 On-Policy 蒸餾與監督式微調之間插值

links.title: Historical Backtesting for Scientific Question Discovery: A Protocol and Astronomy Pilot

evidence: §1 Contribution 1: formalizes historical backtesting with question freezing, temporally isolated corpora, and a two-dimensional outcome/premise taxonomy defined independently of the generator.

§8 Table 6: at n=125, random claims 72.8% [64,80] vs direct-LLM 96.0% [91,99] engagement (p<1e-4); scaling overturns two n=10 conclusions (refutation exclusivity; answered floor of 11.2% for random templates).

§9.1 Table 7: structure→LLM refutes 13% [8,20] vs LLM-only 0%; §9.2 Table 8: pipeline B refutes at all four cutoffs including the post-training one (5 at c2024), while pipeline A's answered rate is flat across the training boundary (14.7% vs 16.0%, p=0.82).
§10.4 Table 10: human-human outcome κ=0.17; models vs professional annotator κ=0.17–0.26; frontier model pair κ=0.60; taxonomy declared underdetermined and absolute rates rater-relative.

§5 'What is released': corpus manifests, frozen questions, retrieval records, adjudicated labels with rationales, four baseline submissions, and §4: one-command metrics with CI failing if committed numbers do not reproduce bit-identically from raw annotations.

§12: power analysis — detecting 10% vs 3.2% premise-refutation rates at 80% power requires n≈209 per arm; the flagship evidence-graph submission remains n=10 (power ~12%), and self-evaluation plus judge-only baseline labels are listed as standing limitations.
§14: prospective instance of 200 questions from four generators frozen 2026-08-17 with SHA-256 digests and a pre-registered 2027–2030 scoring window executable no earlier than 2031.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An evaluation-methodology paper for LLM-generated scientific questions, not a pure domain application: LLM prompting, LLM-as-judge, and weight-channel contamination are the core objects of study, giving solid but not top-tier preference relevance (strong match to LLM and LLM-judge/benchmark topics; no Japanese NLP, agents, or reasoning-benchmark content). Novelty is high: a falsifiable historical-backtesting protocol with question freezing, a two-dimensional outcome/premise taxonomy, premise-refutation-as-success metric, and a clean generator decomposition (LLM-only vs structure-only vs structure→LLM) crossed with a training-boundary stress test. Rigor is unusually strong: Clopper-Pearson intervals, power analysis (n≈209 per arm for the headline comparison), a mismatched-evidence control, prompt-sensitivity and cross-judge robustness checks, explicit Bonferroni accounting, and self-revising conclusions when scaling from n=10 to n=125. Evidence strength is good for comparative claims (survive three judges with failures only as zero-ties) but the flagship system rests on n=10 and absolute rates are admitted to be rater-relative after the taxonomy failed human-human validation (κ=0.17). Generalizability is moderate: protocol is model/domain-agnostic by design, yet instantiated in one domain with one judge family and one generator LLM. Reproducibility is excellent: released manifests, frozen questions, retrieval records, 798 judgments, CI-enforced bit-identical metric reproduction, and a SHA-256-hashed prospective instance.

primary_link.title: Historical Backtesting for Scientific Question Discovery: A Protocol and Astronomy Pilot

papers.summary: Systems that generate scientific research questions are evaluated today by expert scores, LLM-as-judge ratings, or curated case studies -- all subjective, none falsifiable. We formalize historical backtesting as an alternative: a system generates questions from a corpus frozen at a historical cutoff, the questions are frozen before any access to later literature, and a temporally isolated future corpus then determines whether each question was subsequently answered, partially addressed, independ
papers.summary_zh: 本文指出AI生成科學研究問題的評估長期依賴專家評分、LLM評審或個案研究等主觀且無法證偽的標準,據此提出「歷史回測」(historical backtesting)評估協定:系統僅能使用歷史截斷日之前的文獻生成問題並凍結,再由時間隔離的未來語料庫,透過固定檢索與受引用約束的評審模型,判定各問題隨後是被回答、部分處理、獨立提出或遭忽略,及其前提被支持或駁斥。作者釋出可重現的天文學基準實例(截斷2020-12-31;過去2,512篇、未來1,891篇論文):證據圖系統產生的十個問題全被後續文獻實質觸及,兩題被回答、七題部分處理、一題獨立提出仍開放;HD 209458 b「低於太陽豐度的水含量」前提更被三項獨立分析駁斥,正是該問題預先指定的檢驗。擴大版v1L(424題基線)修正兩項小樣本結論:參與率在n=125確能區辨系統,前提駁斥雖罕見但非該系統獨有。生成器分解與四截斷時間壓力測試顯示,純LLM生成呈「記憶到的相關性」而非具體預見;結構優先生成在含訓練資料之後的時期皆能駁斥前提,顯示預見訊號主要存在於截斷前的證據結構。七位評分者一致性研究發現兩位人類標註者間κ僅0.17、前沿模型間卻達0.60,顯示結果分類法本身未通過驗證,絕對比率皆相對於評分者。論文最後釋出前瞻實例(2026年凍結、2027–2030年評分),使核心主張成為不受污染、由時間檢驗的測試。
papers.title: Historical Backtesting for Scientific Question Discovery: A Protocol and Astronomy Pilot

evidence: Table 1 (Section 5.2): best configuration is Gemini 3 Flash on full video at 61.1% (+/-3.8); no closed-book lower CI bound exceeds 25%; subtitles-only reaches 48.1% for Gemini 3 Flash
Section 3: expert human accuracy 82.0% measured on 133 questions across 10 movies answered by co-authors who did not write them

Section 4 and Appendix D: memorization filtering with three frontier LLMs (Gemini 39.4%, Opus 40.7%, GPT 38.8% closed-book rates) reduces 779 to 628 questions, with per-category exclusion rates in Table 4

Section 2.1: extraction validated on 4,072 gold tuples from 21 issues (7 dev + 12 held-out, an unexplained 2-issue gap); main text reports rho=0.961 while Appendix B Table 3 reports 0.966 [0.953-0.977] for Gemini 3 Pro, and Appendix B mentions 12 issues

Section 5.2 vs Appendix E: Section 5.2 states the largest frame-budget gain is +3.6 pp (N=64 to 256), but Appendix E also reports Qwen3-VL-8B's +4.5 pp from N=64 to 128, and describes 'three of the six' backbones while listing four names

Section 5.2/Table 2: per-film accuracy correlates with subtitles-only accuracy (rho +0.40 to +0.52, p <= 0.002) while web-prevalence and title-prediction correlations are negative, arguing against memorization driving gains; authors note Gemini's captioner role leaves a per-film signal (rho_gcb +0.43 for Gemini, +0.37/+0.22 for Claude/GPT)

Section 7 (Limitations): corpus restricted to popular (box-office) Classical Hollywood films through 1963, sound films only, questions authored by US-university researchers, with explicit acknowledgment that performance may not generalize outside this period

Section 6 and Section 2.1: public availability claimed at github.com/bamman-group/variety-boxoffice (1.4M weekly box office numbers, 24,000+ movies) and github.com/bamman-group/chnb (benchmark and code)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LLM benchmark/evaluation paper (in scope: video-language understanding with frontier LLMs, captioning pipelines, and agentic retrieval; not pure CV or a pure domain application). Preference relevance is solid: it evaluates LLMs/VLMs (Gemini, GPT-5-mini, Claude, Qwen3-VL, GLM), compares five paradigms including agentic retrieval, and contributes datasets/benchmarks, though it lacks core language-methodology contributions (no training, reasoning, or alignment methods). Novelty is moderate: the copyright-stable public-domain corpus construction and the first open historical box-office database are genuinely new, but long-video narrative benchmarks (MovieQA, CinePile, HourVideo, MF2, LVBench) and the Socratic/VideoAgent paradigms already exist. Rigor is generally high (closed-book/subtitle baselines, memorization filtering to ~25% chance level, CIs, Spearman correlations with p-values, frame-budget sweeps) but is undercut by internal inconsistencies: 21 labeled issues vs 7+12=19 used (Section 2.1), main-text rho=0.961 vs Table 3's 0.966, Section 5.2 claiming a +3.6 pp largest frame-budget gain while Appendix E also reports +4.5 pp for Qwen3-VL-8B, and 'three of the six' backbones listing four names. Evidence strength is decent: the headline 61.1% vs 82.0% human and the audio-importance finding are quantitatively supported, but the audio conclusion rests on a single audio-visual model and a captioner (Gemini) shared with the QA backbone creates a confound the authors only partially analyze. Generalizability is limited by design to Classical Hollywood-era, English, US-popularity films (acknowledged in Section 7), though the copyright-clearance methodology transfers. Reproducibility benefits from two public GitHub repositories and detailed pipelines, but depends on closed-source APIs and Internet Archive hosting.

But the creation of stable benchmarks built around Hollywood films is complicated by copyright protections. In this work, we address these concerns directly, by building a new collection of Hollywood films defined by two criteria: box office popularity (where we publish the first large-s
papers.summary_zh: 多模態語言模型有望支援大規模的電影計算分析,但好萊塢影片受版權保護,穩定基準難以建立。本文以兩項標準界定資料集:其一,從Variety雜誌1922–1979年的週票房紀錄建立首個大規模開放的歷史票房資料庫(逾140萬筆週票房、約2.4萬部影片),定義「受歡迎」為每年票房前100名;其二,透過查核美國《著作權登記目錄》的登記與續展紀錄,篩選極可能屬公眾領域的61部有聲電影,以降低DMCA下架風險。作者據此建立涵蓋時間性、情節、角色、場景、視角、再現、象徵與物件辨識八類的多選題敘事理解基準,共628題(先過濾151題可被前沿模型僅憑片名與年份答對的記憶題)。人類水準為82.0%;多數視覺語言模型接近隨機,僅以含音訊的完整影片輸入的Gemini 3 Flash達61.1%,遠低於人類。closed-book基線低於25%顯示無記憶污染;僅對白字幕即達48.1%,顯示對白是主要資訊來源;由256影格改為完整影片帶來+21.8個百分點,而CLIP影格檢索代理幾乎貼近隨機,凸顯聲音與對白之關鍵。限制包括僅以票房代表文化重要性、題目出自美國研究者,範圍限於古典好萊塢時期;但此舉為可長期穩定的影片基準奠定基礎。

links.title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.2 (Table 1): QUMem overall accuracy 61.02% with GPT-4o-mini vs Mem0 52.99%, and 70.58% with Gemini-3.5-flash vs Mem0 63.29%, across 32K/128K/1M context configurations.
Section 4.2 (Table 2): KnowU-Bench overall SR 17.4% vs best baseline Mem0 12.8%; hard-task SR 11.6%, with authors noting low absolute success rates.
Section 4.3 (Table 3): component ablations show w/o Reconstruction drops overall from 61.02 to 54.51, w/o Memory Decomposition to 57.11, w/o Episode Construction to 58.38 on PersonaMem (GPT-4o-mini).
Section 4.3 (Figure 3 paragraph): retrieval depth sweep k in {3,5,10} yields 59.10%, 61.02%, 60.78% overall, motivating k=5.
Section 4.4 (Table 4): QUMem uses 81.4 LLM calls/100 turns and 1,221.2 tokens/turn vs Zep 331.8 calls and 13,337.3 tokens; text states classifier inference cost is excluded from these statistics.

Section 4.1 (Experimental Details): continuity classifier fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-4B on LoCoMo dialogues; 'Additional implementation details are provided in the appendix'; no code release or artifact availability is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM-agent memory framework combining episode segmentation, typed memory stores, and a three-agent retrieval/inference pipeline, evaluated on PersonaMem and KnowU-Bench against A-MEM, Mem0, and Zep. Preference relevance is high (agents, LLMs, RAG-style retrieval, long-context memory). Novelty is moderate: individual pieces (topic-aware segmentation, query rewriting/planning, multi-agent RAG) exist in cited prior work (SeCom, PlanRAG, Chain-of-Note); the typed factual/preference/insight decomposition and joint user-state inference are the main new combination. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: component ablations and a retrieval-depth sweep are present, but no statistical significance, seeds, or variance are reported, and the three-agent inference-time cost is not analyzed (efficiency analysis covers construction only and explicitly excludes classifier inference). Evidence strength is decent: consistent gains across two base models, three context lengths (e.g., 61.02% vs 52.99% overall on PersonaMem), plus KnowU-Bench (SR 17.4% vs 12.8%), though KnowU gains are modest and absolute hard-task SR is low. Generalizability is supported by two benchmarks and two downstream models but limited to proprietary APIs. Reproducibility is weak: implementation details are deferred to a non-supplied appendix, no code or artifact availability is claimed, and prompts/retrieval encoders are not described in the main text.

primary_link.title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use external memory systems to support personalization by drawing on long and evolving interaction histories, in which user preferences may be distributed across time, change with context, and conflict with earlier evidence. However, existing systems face three limitations: fixed-turn, fixed-token, or session-based boundaries can mix unrelated dialogue or split an event from its causes, decisions, and outcomes; storing multiple pieces of user inform
papers.summary_zh: LLM代理要成為持續的個人化助理,必須從漫長且持續演變的互動歷史推論使用者當前狀態;但現有記憶系統有三項限制:固定輪數、token數或對話分段可能拆散事件的因果與結果;同一次互動中的多筆資訊被綁成單一記憶,難以獨立檢索;僅以當前任務作單一top-k相似度查詢,無法兼顧偏好演變、時間有效性與情境適用性。QUMem提出結構化記憶框架,包含三模組:動態情節建構以微調的Qwen3.5-4B語意連續性分類器,將歷史切成變長情節以保留事件脈絡;型別化記憶分解將每段情節拆成可獨立檢索的事實、偏好與可遷移洞見記憶,並保留時間位置與來源證據;查詢條件式使用者狀態推論則由資訊需求、檢索規劃與狀態推論三個代理依序合作,規劃多查詢檢索並聯合詮釋分散於時間的證據。在PersonaMem上,QUMem以GPT-4o-mini將整體準確率由最強基線52.99%提升至61.02%,以Gemini-3.5-flash由63.29%提升至70.58%;在KnowU-Bench整體成功率由12.8%升至17.4%。消融實驗證實三模組互補,效益隨歷史增長而擴大;其每百輪LLM呼叫(81.4次)與每輪建構token成本(1,221)皆為最低。限制為困難任務成功率仍偏低、「建議新點子」類別最弱,且1M token長度下效能下降。本研究顯示,保存事件脈絡、區分證據角色並進行任務驅動的狀態推論,是長期個人化記憶的關鍵。

links.title: Token Optimization and Context Window Management in Multi-Agent AI Workflows

evidence: Abstract, Page 1-2: 50:50 condition improves relevance accuracy +0.077 over 100% signal (CI [+0.056,+0.098], Cohen's d=0.49, Holm-adjusted p<.001, n=220), summarized as +0.084 across nine model families.
Section 4.2, Page 10: matched-item sensitivity analysis gives +0.076; per-model gains vary roughly tenfold (Appendix D, p25: DeepSeek-V3.2 +0.123 to Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh +0.013).

Section 3.1, Page 6: token usage 'estimated using character-count approximations'; only six of 25 recorded runs have measured elapsed times; pre-optimization 3.5-10.5 min baseline is an operational estimate.
Appendix C, Page 22: optimization table figures labeled 'operational estimates... not the paper's controlled experiment'; semantic caching 'not benchmarked'.

Section 7, Page 16-18: limitations include single-annotator labels by the author, single-week single-domain corpus, nested signal subsets, 9 non-independent model families; no population-level p-value claimed.
Section 7 Release controls, Page 17: 'The underlying communication data is not published. Raw prompts, raw model outputs, per-item IDs, and message content remain private.'
Section 5, Page 14: reference implementation context_arranger.py released (MIT, stdlib only), but keyword fallback heuristic 'not independently validated'.

Section 6, Page 15: positions the finding against Cuconasu et al. 'The Power of Noise' (SIGIR 2024), differing in task (relevance scoring/extraction vs RAG answer generation) and mechanism (same-domain contrast vs random documents).

Appendix E, Page 29: Fusion-of-N result—learned self-fusion (DeepSeek-V3.2) did not beat mechanical set union (fusion-union -0.073; recall-tuned fusion -0.002), acknowledged as single-model, single-corpus, self-fusion setup.

Appendix D, Page 26: effect concentrates in email targets (+0.119) vs meetings (+0.002) and chats (+0.017); corrected-corpus rerun reproduces gain (+0.083 corrected vs +0.092 fresh original arm) over 4,400 calls with two independent scoring implementations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A practitioner study squarely within scope: multi-agent LLM workflows, token optimization, context-window management, and prompt composition (matches Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Prompting/ICL, Long Context). The controlled context-composition experiment (2,420 trials, 11 configurations) with a counter-intuitive relevance-contrast finding is the strongest asset, supported by unusually careful statistics: Holm correction, matched-item sensitivity (Sec 4.2, p10), dependence-aware family/block intervals (Sec 7 item 6, p17), metric-robustness recomputation, and a corrected-corpus rerun with two independent scoring implementations (Appendix D, p26-27). Novelty is moderate: the noise-helps phenomenon is adjacent to Cuconasu et al.'s 'Power of Noise' and distractor literature (Sec 6, p15), and the six optimization patterns (semantic caching, stratification, schema contracts) are largely known practitioner techniques. Evidence for the headline effect is solid within-corpus, but production latency/token claims rest on estimates: only 6 of 25 runs measured, token counts via character approximation, cached loads and parse success not benchmarked (Sec 3.1 p6; Appendix C p22). Generalizability is limited to one worker, one week, one domain, with the effect concentrated in low-base-rate email items (Appendix D, p26), which the authors candidly scope. Reproducibility is partial: only context_arranger.py is released (Sec 5, p14); the corpus, raw prompts, and outputs remain private (Sec 7 release controls, p17), so the central experiment cannot be exactly replicated.

primary_link.title: Token Optimization and Context Window Management in Multi-Agent AI Workflows

papers.summary: Multi-agent AI workflows are limited not only by model quality but by token cost, latency, and context-window quality. This paper presents a practitioner framework for token optimization and context-window management, grounded in an internal production dashboard that extracts structured work items from meetings, email, and chat with LLMs and routes summaries across workstreams. Six patterns are described: context stratification, fetch-once/process-locally architecture, schema-contracted prompts,
papers.summary_zh: 這篇實務研究探討多代理 AI 工作流程中 token 成本、延遲與上下文視窗品質的問題。作者以一個內部生產儀表板（擷取會議、電子郵件與聊天內容並抽取結構化工作項目）為案例，提出六種最佳化模式：上下文分層、一次擷取本地處理、結構描述約束提示、token 感知的備援鏈、語意快取與代理間通訊壓縮。生產管線冷載入延遲從約3.5至10.5分鐘降至61至116秒，歷史 token 用量估計減少60-70%。對照實驗含2,420次確認性試驗、11個模型組態，核心發現反直覺：在固定10個項目的提示中，混入同領域低相關性項目（50:50 訊號雜訊比）反而提升模型對目標項目的相關性評分一致性，增益約+0.077（Cohen's d = 0.49），作者稱之為「相關性對比上下文」，推測低相關性範例協助模型校準相關性門檻；另發現按內容類型路由可再提升品質。Fusion-of-N 追加實驗則顯示，機械式集合聯集是學習式融合難以擊敗的強基線。限制包括：資料僅來自單一知識工作者一週通訊、由作者單人標註、生產管線 token 為估算值、220個配對觀測不獨立（僅9個模型家族），故效應被定位為有限語料內的描述性比較。本文價值在於提供可重複的工程模式與評估方法，讓代理工作流程更省、更快、更可靠。

Section 2.1: task design criteria (skills absent from base model, decomposable stages, verifiable success, disjoint training corpora); suite of 5 task types x 10 tasks x 10 YAML inputs with 9 held out.

Figure 2 caption: fused and fauxthon adapters drop to 3.7% and 7.3% on HumanEval+ while routed conditions (autoswitch, subagent, arrow) stay close to base.
Appendix C: single run, n=50 per cell, one seed, one sample per task; Wilson 95% half-width up to ~14pp; no multiple seeds due to compute cost.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM agent paper where the agent autonomously hot-swaps LoRA adapters as tools (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Training/LoRA, code tasks), with release of adapters, harness, and prompts. The contribution is a genuine but incremental extension of existing LoRA-as-tool and LoRA-library work (Arrow, Adaptive Minds), with the new twist of repeated mid-trajectory self-routing and a discovered non-obvious routing policy (faux adapter used to write Python). Rigor is respectable for a workshop paper: well-specified synthetic task design criteria, controls that isolate the agentic confound (Table 2), capability-tax retention probes (IFEval, HumanEval+, MATH-500, BFCL-lite), Wilson intervals, and honest limitations (single model, single seed, one sample per task, two-adapter library, weak heuristic baseline). Evidence is internally consistent (autoswitch 116/200 vs subagent 59/200; fused adapter strong on subtasks yet 0 on agentic tasks), but rests on a single run with CI half-widths up to ~14pp, a derived '18x capability tax reduction' not fully shown, and entirely synthetic tasks, limiting generalizability. Score reflects strong preference fit and reproducibility against moderate novelty and single-setting evidence.

This poses a problem in long agent trajectories that compose different capabilities. We reject this tradeoff by giving an agent a tool to switch between specialized LoRA adapters mid-trace. To test its effectiveness, we compose two synthetic coding tasks that are logically simple but require specialization. We find that this allows the mod
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討後訓練能為模型解鎖專業能力，卻常伴隨災難性遺忘的問題，這對需要組合多種能力的長程代理軌跡尤其不利。作者提出讓代理在單一軌跡中，透過工具呼叫自行熱切換不同的 LoRA 轉接器，以同時保留專業化與通用能力。實驗設計兩個合成程式任務：Faux 翻譯與 Fauxthon 程式撰寫，兩者分別是將 JSON 與 Python 的關鍵字輪替後的合成語言，且訓練資料完全互斥。以 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 為基礎，比較單一轉接器、融合轉接器、Arrow、子代理與啟發式切換等配置。結果顯示：各專用轉接器個別表現良好，但融合轉接器在代理式任務全數失敗，印證災難性遺忘；自動切換總分 116／200，優於人類啟發式的 101 與子代理的 59，且模型自行發展出「用 Faux 轉接器寫 Python」的新策略；相較子代理最多可減少 46.1 倍 token 用量，並將能力稅最多降低 18 倍。限制包括任務皆為合成設計、僅測試單一基礎模型與訓練種子、路由庫只有兩個轉接器，而人類啟發式僅是固定的副檔名規則，並非最佳策略。此研究顯示模型已能自主學習路由政策，為模組化代理以低成本擴充專業能力指出方向。

links.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models

evidence: §3.3: defines length-normalized CLL margin (Eq. 1) and reports sign agreement with generated source choice on 75.4% of 26,893 decidable observations.

§3.5: primary within-item asymmetry A_i tested with two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, 95% paired-bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples), and paired randomization test; secondary slope calibration uses per-unit unimodal accuracy loss.
Table 1 (§4): median asymmetries positive for five of six models on GSM8K/SVAMP (e.g., Idefics3-8B A=+3.877) and negative for all six on ChartQA-Conflict (e.g., Idefics3-8B A=-2.175) with CIs.
Appendix G / Table 9: chart-versus-table control; every A_table CI excludes zero, and the paper notes the chart-vs-table difference is not systematic (four of six intervals include zero).
Appendix H / Table 10: asymmetry sign and significance preserved across normalization exponents alpha in {0, 0.5, 1} for all model-benchmark cells.
§3.2.2 and Appendix I: ChartQA-Conflict has 229 items after a post-run audit removed one item; two author reviewers, not blind to the design, verified entailment (also flagged in Limitations).

Limitations: conflict settings confound task, representation, and construction; calibration slopes use only three degraded levels; results limited to evaluated 2B-8B models; framework does not test conflict awareness or abstention.

Appendix A: pinned Hugging Face checkpoint revisions, greedy decoding, seeded deterministic corruptions (42+i), and full software stack; §3.4 lists released datasets (HuggingFace) and §Abstract lists a code repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled empirical study of how vision-language models (multimodal LLMs) reallocate reliance between conflicting image and text sources under graded degradation. It matches Multimodal AI, Evaluation/Benchmark, and moderately Reasoning (GSM8K/SVAMP arithmetic) preferences, though it is not core LLM-methodology work and is not among the out-of-scope categories. Novelty is moderate: conflicting-modality studies exist (Hua et al., CMC-Bench, Deng et al.), but the within-item paired image-vs-text degradation arms, CLL preference margin, and the chart-vs-table control are distinct contributions. Rigor is strong: counterbalanced Source A/B labels, dual behavioral/CLL measures, Wilcoxon/bootstrap/permutation testing, severity calibration via unimodal accuracy loss, normalization-sensitivity checks (Appendix H), and an honest Limitations section that itself flags the key confounds (task vs. representation not isolated; author annotators not blind; nominal rather than psychometric degradation matching). Evidence is convincing for the evaluated models, with a task-dependent reversal replicated across six CLL-scored models and two frontier models behaviorally, though the 75.4% measure agreement shows the CLL margin is an imperfect proxy. Generalizability is limited by 2B-8B open models in the primary analysis, numeric-answer tasks only, and the authors' own caution against model-family-wide claims. Reproducibility is excellent: pinned checkpoints, seeds, software versions, ~400 GPU-hours documented, and released code, datasets, and exclusion records.

primary_link.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) combine images and text, but when the two conflict and one becomes harder to read, it is unclear how a model shifts its reliance between them. We study this modality reallocation with a controlled setup: we degrade either the image or the text across four levels of legibility while keeping the other clean, and track how the model's preference changes. We build conflicts from GSM8K and SVAMP by pairing the rendered image of one arithmetic problem with the text of ano
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLM）同時接收圖像與文字，但當兩者衝突且其中一個變得難以判讀時，模型如何在模態之間重新分配信任仍不清楚。本文提出「模態重新分配」的研究框架：將一題算術題渲染成圖像，並與另一題的文字配對形成衝突；在固定另一來源的前提下，對圖像或文字分別施加四級（L0/L2/L4/L5）可讀性退化，並以生成答案與長度正規化的條件對數概似（CLL）差距衡量來源偏好。資料涵蓋 GSM8K、SVAMP，以及新建立的 ChartQA-Conflict（229 筆經人工審查的圖表—報告衝突）。評估六個開源 VLM 顯示依任務而異的不對稱：在算術衝突上，六個模型中有五個在文字退化時更強烈地偏離文字來源；但在 ChartQA-Conflict 上，六個 CLL 評分模型全部反轉，改為在圖表退化時更強烈地偏離視覺來源。此反轉在以單模態準確率損失校準、以及把圖表換成純表格圖像後依然成立；兩個前沿 API 模型（GPT-5.6-Luna 與 Gemini-3.5-Flash）在行為層面也重現 ChartQA 的反轉方向。限制包括框架僅適用於可歸因的數值答案、CLL 分析限於 2B–8B 開源模型、兩種衝突設定無法完全分離任務與表徵因素，且退化階梯僅依名目層級配對而非心理測量嚴重度。整體而言，VLM 對模態的依賴並非固定偏好，而是由任務、證據結構、模型與提示框定共同塑造的行為。
papers.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: benchmark contains '153 top-level inputs and 242 Feature points (F-points)' with Final Build Success Rate 94.77-100.00% vs Task Completion 48.36-58.39%, showing buildability is saturated while behavioral correctness is not.

Section 2.4: every retained F-point must satisfy a fail-to-pass criterion; 'At least two curators independently validate each retained test' and each F-point must pass on the reference solution in at least two validation runs.
Section 4.4 / Table 3: all results use the fixed DevEco Code agent framework with eight LLMs, temperature=0, 200K context, and three independent full-suite runs per configuration.
Section 5.1: ranks are 'a descriptive ordering for this three-run snapshot rather than as a strict statistical separation'; Kimi-K3's run range [53.59, 62.09] contains GLM-5.2's mean.
Section 7: limitations acknowledge a single agent framework, only three runs without inferential intervals, and possible pre-training exposure for the PR-derived bug-fix source.

Section 4.5 / Availability: task descriptions, reference solutions, executable tests, evaluation scripts, and aggregation code are released at the official website with a versioned task snapshot (v1.0, 2026.7.31).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: an LLM-based coding-agent benchmark (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs) spanning app-level feature implementation, spec following, and bug fixing. Novelty is moderate rather than high: the SWE-bench-style fail-to-pass design and app/build evaluation extend known paradigms (MobileDev-Bench, WebApp1K) to the underexplored OpenHarmony/ArkTS ecosystem with on-device Hypium UI checks. Rigor is solid: three independent full-suite runs per configuration, explicit metric formulas, no-op floor and reference ceiling, two-curator test validation, and honest limits (single agent scaffold, descriptive rather than inferential rank separation). Evidence is internally consistent (Final Build 94.77-100% vs Task Completion 48.36-58.39%; spec-driven below 35%) but limited to eight models under one fixed DevEco Code framework with no ablations and a questionable citation pairing (DeepSeek-V4-Pro attributed to Alibaba Cloud in Sec 4.4). Generalizability is constrained by platform-specificity and the single-scaffold design the authors themselves flag. Reproducibility is strong: full artifact release plus a detailed version/SDK/device/run-parameter snapshot (Table 3).

primary_link.title: OpenHarmony Bench: Evaluating LLMs and Coding Agents on OpenHarmony App Development

papers.summary: We present OPENHARMONY BENCH, an app-level coding benchmark for evaluating LLM-based coding agents on OpenHarmony ArkTS applications. Unlike function-level benchmarks, it evaluates complete app-level changes: each task requires an agent to modify a buildable ArkTS project so that a requested behavior works end to end, involving UI state, data persistence, build configuration, and platform APIs. The benchmark installs and drives the delivered application on a device to check whether the behavior
papers.summary_zh: 既有程式基準多評估函式層級生成或儲存庫層級的議題修復，難以衡量代理能否在真實平台專案中交付可建置且行為正確的應用程式。本文提出 OpenHarmony Bench，一個針對 OpenHarmony ArkTS 應用開發的應用層級編碼基準，包含 153 個頂層任務與 242 個可執行行為檢查點（F-point），分為三類來源：32 個新功能需求、50 個規格驅動任務（含 139 個 F-point）、71 個取自真實 PR 的 bug 修復。評估管線會建置專案、安裝至模擬器，並以 Hypium UI 測試驗證實際行為；主要指標為頂層任務完成率，專案必須建置成功且所有可執行檢查通過才算完成。在固定的 DevEco Code 代理框架下測試八個 LLM，每個配置執行三次完整套件並取平均。結果顯示 GLM-5.2 以平均 58.39% 任務完成率居首，Kimi-K3（57.30%）與 Qwen3.8-Max-Preview（55.99%）緊隨其後；最終建置成功率介於 94.77% 至 100%，顯示可編譯不代表行為正確；規格驅動任務因要求全部 F-point 通過，完成率最低，無任何配置超過 35%。限制包括僅使用單一代理框架、三次運行不足以進行推論統計，且 bug-fix 任務源自公開儲存庫的歷史 PR，可能存在預訓練污染風險。此基準填補了行動應用層級交付評估的缺口，並透過官網釋出完整任務、測試與評估腳本以利重現。

links.title: CompoSkill: Compositional Skill Chain Attacks from Individually Scanner-Passing LLM Agent Skills

evidence: Abstract: 'CompoSkill achieves risk Chain Formation Rates (CFR) up to 83.3% in the white box setting and 80.6% in the black box setting, while existing skill scanners block only a limited fraction of the risky compositions.'

Experiments > Evaluation Metrics: 'All per-instance outcomes are decided by an LLM-as-a-judge... All LLM-as-a-judge annotations were subsequently verified through manual inspection by the authors' — judge model unnamed, validation limited to author self-check.
Experiments > RQ2, Table 3: Defense Bypass Rates of 0.58 (SkillsGuard), 0.65 (Cisco), 0.50 (SkillSpector) against CFR 63.2% with no scanner on Nanobot.
Methodology Section 3.3 / Algorithm 1: chain synthesis reduced to YenKSP with output budget K=10 and oversampling factor alpha=10 over capability-overlap edge weights.
Experiments > RQ3: 'ASR rises from 35.2% at L=2 to 55.4% at L=3, then drops to 37.8%, 33.6%, and 21.8% for L=4,5,6' — bridge-bonus-then-hop-decay pattern.
Benchmark Design: '380 long-horizon task instances... clean, explicit-injection, and implicit-injection variants forming 1,140 records in total' across five threats and 76 roles.

Experimental Setup > Platforms and Models: evaluation on Nanobot and OpenClaw with GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-flash, DeepSeek-V4, LongCat-2.0; white-box results (Figure 3) reported only for Nanobot/DeepSeek-V4 with average utility 75.3%.
Availability: 'Code and data: https://github.com/Limax666/CompoSkill. Benchmark dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Limax11/CompoSkill-Bench' (links stated, not verifiable from the document).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical match: the paper studies LLM-agent security (agent skills, prompt injection, red-teaming, safety benchmarking), aligning with high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming, LLMs). Novelty is moderate: framing per-skill scanning as a node-level blind spot and modeling path-level attacks is a genuine step beyond cited pairwise/audit work (SkillProbe, SkillReact, SCR-Bench), but the core technique (capability-overlap graph + Yen k-shortest paths) is standard, and 'benign components compose into harmful paths' is already anticipated by related work. Rigor is limited by exclusive reliance on an unnamed LLM-as-judge whose only validation is author self-inspection, no variance/significance reporting over stochastic agent runs, varying and partly unexplained per-threat denominators (e.g., 11.1%/44.4% suggest n=9 for Multi-Agent Hijacking), a white-box headline (83.3% CFR) shown for a single platform/model configuration (Figure 3, Nanobot/DeepSeek-V4), and no limitations section. Evidence strength is moderate: Tables 2-3 and Figure 5 give internally consistent numbers (e.g., DBR 0.50-0.65; ASR 35.2%->55.4%->21.8% for L=2,3,6), but headline 'up to' figures cherry-pick best cells and judge reliability is unverified. Generalizability is fair (2 runtimes, 4 models, 5 threats, 6 scenarios) though results are strongly model-dependent and specific to the ClawHub-style skill ecosystem. Reproducibility is partial: code/benchmark URLs and hyperparameters (K=10, alpha=10) are given, but payload-generation prompts, judge prompts, and scanner configs are unspecified. Not out-of-scope; no instruction-following content detected in the paper text.

We show that this assumption fails under skill composition. A skill may pass the per-skill scanner individually yet participate in a risky composition when an agent connects its outputs, capabilities, or side effects with those of other scanner-passing skills. This makes skill com
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理的安全審查多停留在單一技能層級：市集掃描器逐一檢查技能套件，全部通過即視為生態安全。本文指出此假設在技能組合下失效——個別通過掃描的良性技能，可能被代理串接成「來源—橋接—終端」的風險鏈，例如讀取設定檔的技能搭配格式化與寄信技能，即可將機密外洩。作者提出 CompoSkill 攻擊框架與雙攻擊者系統：白盒攻擊者知道受害者的技能池，直接注入具名技能序列；黑盒攻擊者僅依使用者角色輪廓與市集的中繼資料建構技能組合圖，並透過受限 k 最短路徑搜尋合成不含技能 ID 的隱式攻擊鏈。基準 CompoSkill-Bench 涵蓋五種威脅與六種專業情境，共 1,140 筆紀錄，於 OpenClaw 與 Nanobot 平台評估四種模型。結果顯示白盒攻擊的鏈形成率（CFR）最高達 83.3%，黑盒達 80.6%；三款主流掃描器即使在嚴格封鎖模式下，防禦繞過率仍達 0.50–0.65，代表至少一半的組合能力存活。研究亦發現「橋接增益後跳數遞減」模式：加入一個橋接技能可提升攻擊成功率，平均 ASR 由 35.2%（兩技能）升至 55.4%（三技能），但鏈長超過三個技能後一路下滑至 21.8%。限制包括評判仰賴 LLM-as-a-judge（雖經作者人工核驗）、鏈長掃描僅在單一模型與平台上進行。此研究說明單一技能認證無法保證組合安全，防禦應轉向路徑層級的評估。

Section 5.3 RQ4, Table 4: transfer is mixed — rewrite-antipattern-v7 retains 38.2-63.6% ASR on JBB-Original while rewrite-schema-v2 and rewrite-implicit-v5 degrade to 1.8%/0.0% ASR on GLM 5.2; macro averages reported per target with honest qualification ('qualified positive result')
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit paper: LLM jailbreak red-teaming via an agent-skill library with failure-driven evolution, strongly matching the LLM, agents/tool-use, AI-safety, and red-teaming/evaluation preferences. Methodologically it is a coherent, well-documented incremental advance over existing agentic red-teamers (AutoDAN-Turbo, AutoRedTeamer, AutoRISE, MemoAttack): the distinctives are SKILL.md-style executable skill artifacts, risk-conditioned UCB routing, and refine/combine/discover operators. Experimental design is above average: budget-matched baselines under a shared OpenRT protocol, a UCB-vs-random routing ablation, dual metrics (strict score-5 ASR plus StrongREJECT HS), auxiliary cost accounting, and honest caveats. However, three issues limit the evidential weight: (1) Stage 2 candidates are accepted only if they recover the same unresolved prompts on which final ASR@30 is reported, an adaptive-selection advantage the paper concedes in Appendix E; (2) all success labels come from a single GPT-4o judge with no human audit and no significance testing or seeds; (3) headline target models (GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM 5.2) and most 2026-dated references are unverifiable/future versions, weakening external credibility despite good internal numerical consistency. Transfer (RQ4) is genuinely tested but mixed and mechanism-dependent. Reproducibility artifacts (hyperparameters, judge prompts, pseudocode, skill code, GitHub link) are unusually thorough but unverified.

primary_link.title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills

papers.summary: Automated red-teaming has produced a growing collection of attack strategies, yet they typically remain scattered across prompts and workflows, making them difficult to systematically integrate, reuse, and improve at scale. We introduce \textsc{JailbreakSkill}, a skill-centric framework for scaling automated red-teaming through reusable and continuously evolving attack capabilities. \textsc{JailbreakSkill} packages existing attack strategies into modular, agent-ready skills that can be directly
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益應用於安全關鍵場景,自動化紅隊測試已成為部署前找出漏洞的重要手段,但既有攻擊策略散落在提示與工作流程中,難以系統性整合、重用與規模化改進。本文提出 JailbreakSkill,一個以技能為核心的框架,將攻擊方法封裝為模組化、可供代理直接呼叫的技能,並由規劃器依風險條件化的 UCB 分數選擇與排序技能。框架包含三類技能:改寫技能產生對抗性提示;失敗分析技能診斷反覆出現的失敗模式;演化技能則對既有技能進行精煉、組合或發現新方法。流程分兩階段:第一階段以含 16 個初始技能的技能庫暖身並累積攻擊經驗;第二階段利用失敗痕跡驅動技能演化,經驗證能改善攻擊表現的候選技能將回存技能庫持續擴充。在 AdvBench 與 HarmBench 涵蓋八個目標模型的實驗中,演化使巨觀平均攻擊成功率分別提升 17.5 與 13.4 個百分點,其中對 GPT-5.4 於 AdvBench 提升 48.6 點,並產出如把直接請求改寫成未完成文件補全任務等新策略。部分演化技能無需再調整即可遷移到未見提示與其他模型,但遷移程度依技能機制與模型配對而異。此研究對防禦方具警示價值:自動化攻擊已能自我累積與演化,安全評估須正視此趨勢。
papers.title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills
papers.title_zh: JailbreakSkill:以可重用且持續演化的技能擴展自動化紅隊測試

links.title: FTA-Mem: Fact-Time-Affect Anchored Memory for Low-Density Long-Term Dialogue

evidence: Abstract: FTA-Mem achieves 0.3871 F1 and 0.6668 BERTScore on ES-MemEval; method combines BWS segmentation, Fact-Time-Affect units, and structured context synthesis
Table 2 (ES-MemEval): FTA-Mem with Qwen3-8B obtains 38.71 All F1 and best average rank 1.5 vs MemoryBank/MemGPT/MemoryOS/A-Mem/CompassMem (27.08-32.33 F1)
Table 3 (LoCoMo): FTA-Mem average F1 32.45 vs CompassMem 31.65 on Qwen3-8B; GPT-4o-mini 25.53 vs 24.75
Supplementary 'Paired Bootstrap Uncertainty Check', Table 10: LoCoMo FTA-Mem minus CompassMem mean 0.55 with 95% CI [-0.01, 3.18]; paper states LoCoMo difference 'should be interpreted cautiously'
Supplementary Table 9: density-gain Pearson correlations (e.g., fact r=-0.39) have permutation p of 0.110 and 0.077, described as 'diagnostic evidence rather than a causal claim'

Experiments 'Implementation Details': all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, tau=0.35, lambda=0.8, K=10 (ES-MemEval) and K=25 (LoCoMo); Supplementary Reproducibility Details states main Tables 2-3 used K=7 and K=10 instead
Supplementary 'Baseline Selection': ES-Mem and SGMem excluded because 'no official implementation was publicly available'
Table 6 (Granularity): on LoCoMo turn-pair construction (38.28 F1) slightly outperforms FTA-Mem (37.35) at ~2.9x construction cost; FTA-Mem framed as trade-off
Supplementary 'Memory Quality Audit': 100 sampled units, fact/time anchors score 2.00, affect/context 1.48 (ES-MemEval) and 1.38 (LoCoMo) on 0-2 scale

Supplementary Prompt Templates, Figures 6-9: full segmentation, unit extraction, link maintenance, and density annotation prompts provided with 'runnable configurations ... included in the supplementary code'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM agent memory paper, strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and Long Context & Memory preferences: it builds a retrieval-augmented structured memory (FTA units, BWS segmentation, linked neighbor expansion) for LLM-based dialogue agents evaluated with Qwen3/GPT-4o-mini backbones. Novelty is moderate: situation-level units with fact/time/affect anchors and boundary-preserving carryover are incremental over existing event-segmentation memory work (ES-Mem, CompassMem, FraCom) that the paper itself cites. Rigor is above average: two benchmarks, three backbones, five baselines, granularity ablation (Table 6), component ablations (Fig. 3, Table 8), BWS-vs-fixed-window control (Table 7), manual memory audit, and cluster bootstrap. However, evidence is asymmetric: ES-MemEval gains are large (38.71 vs ~30-32 F1, Table 2) but LoCoMo gains over CompassMem are marginal (32.45 vs 31.65, Table 3) and the paper's own paired bootstrap CI is [-0.01, 3.18] (Supplementary Table 10), essentially inconclusive; density-gain correlations rest on 10-18 clusters with non-significant permutation p-values (0.077-0.154, Table 9). Internal inconsistency between main-text K settings (K=10/25, Implementation Details) and supplementary disclosure (K=7/10 for Tables 2-3) slightly dents rigor; token costs are not budget-matched (Table 5). Generalizability is decent across density regimes and backbones but limited to dialogue QA. Reproducibility is good: prompts, hyperparameters (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, tau=0.35, lambda=0.8, temperature), and runnable supplementary code are provided, though ES-Mem/SGMem baselines were excluded for lacking implementations.

primary_link.title: FTA-Mem: Fact-Time-Affect Anchored Memory for Low-Density Long-Term Dialogue

papers.summary: Long-term emotional-support agents require memory mechanisms for personalized understanding across sessions. However, emotional-support dialogue is often low-density: turns are incomplete, evidence is scattered, and user states evolve over time. Existing memory methods usually rely on fixed units, such as turn-level notes or session summaries, which may lose details or introduce redundant noise. We propose FTA-Mem, a structured memory framework for low-density long-term dialogue. FTA-Mem uses Bo
papers.summary_zh: 長期情感支持對話常呈低密度特性:單一回合罕有完整事實,有用證據零散、隱含且隨時間演變;既有記憶方法多採固定單位,如逐回合筆記或整段摘要,不是漏失細節就是引入冗餘雜訊。本文提出 FTA-Mem,為低密度長期對話設計的結構化記憶框架。它先以邊界保留式視窗分割(BWS)切出連貫的情境片段,再轉換為同時編碼事實錨、時間錨與情感錨的 FTA 記憶單元;未完成的單元會跨片段攜帶,相鄰片段的單元於賦予永久 ID 前融合,並為定案單元維護時間連結與關係標籤。檢索時,系統改寫查詢,結合嵌入相似度與結構化線索評分選取單元,再擴展關聯鄰居,最後合成結構化上下文供答案生成。在 ES-MemEval 與 LoCoMo 兩基準上,FTA-Mem 於 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B 與 GPT-4o-mini 等骨幹下取得最佳或接近最佳的整體表現,於 ES-MemEval 達 0.3871 F1 與 0.6668 BERTScore。消融顯示移除時間資訊影響最大;情境級建構在證據保留與建構成本間取得較佳折衷;相關分析指出其優勢集中在事實密度低、語意隱含的對話。作者坦承連結關係較嘈雜、統計屬診斷性證據,並提醒長期記憶帶來隱私與錯誤記憶風險,實際部署須有同意與管控機制。

links.title: STAGE: Controlled Objective Admission for Multi-Preference LLM Alignment

evidence: Section 4.3 / Table 2: STAGE raises Qwen3-0.6B average from 32.78 to 44.81 (+12.03) and Llama3-8B-Instruct from 52.38 to 62.93 (+10.55), 5.49/5.34 points above the strongest non-STAGE baselines.
Section 4.4 / Table 3: component ablation shows APW only +5.35, APW+ISG +8.88, APW+ISG+WSG +9.44, and Full STAGE +12.03, supporting each controller component in this configuration.
Section 4.5 / Table 4: scorer-sensitivity audit swaps GPT-5-chat for the Qwen3-235B training scorer with Pearson r=0.998 across cells; STAGE remains the top method (45.23 vs 39.51 next best).

Table 2: SPO-adapted and SPO-Reverse-adapted baselines collapse to averages of 6.63 and 5.23 on Qwen3-0.6B (base 32.78), indicating the sequential-baseline adaptations may be broken rather than fairly compared.

Limitations section: authors concede single-run estimates, no multi-seed uncertainty, no human preference validation, fixed 15-objective inventory, and that baselines are shared-budget adaptations rather than exhaustive reproductions.

Appendix C / Table 6: complete training configuration (veRL, PPO with GAE lambda=1 gamma=1, actor lr 1e-5, 600 steps, 20k queries, vLLM rollout, ISG/WSG thresholds epsilon=0.05/0.1) plus full prompt templates in Appendices G-L support replication.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/RLHF methodology paper: multi-preference PPO with a stability-gated active-set controller over 15 preference dimensions, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, RLHF/alignment, training & optimization). The temporal 'objective admission' framing (when objectives enter the active set, versus how they are scalarized) is a genuinely distinct angle versus curriculum-over-examples (Curri-DPO) or sequential single-objective stages (SPO), though it combines known ingredients (curriculum learning, soft max-min weighting, patience/fallback heuristics), capping novelty. Rigor is mixed: two backbones, six shared-budget baselines, component ablations, a scorer-sensitivity audit (Pearson r=0.998 between GPT-5-chat and Qwen3-235B judges), and a patience sweep are commendable, but all results are single-run without variance estimates, the evaluation is entirely LLM-judge-mediated (including classification endpoints scored via a binary semantic-match prompt), and the catastrophic collapse of SPO-adapted baselines (avg 6.63 vs base 32.78 on Qwen3-0.6B, Table 2) suggests fragile adaptations that inflate the contrast with sequential scheduling. Evidence supports the claims within this setting but not beyond it: fixed K=15 inventory, one RL framework (veRL/PPO), and the authors' own Limitations note absent multi-seed, human-preference, and objective-scaling validation. Reproducibility is above average due to exhaustive hyperparameters (Table 6), full prompt appendices, and public data sources, though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: STAGE: Controlled Objective Admission for Multi-Preference LLM Alignment

papers.summary: Multi-preference alignment is often framed as scalarization: combine reward dimensions, then optimize. This leaves a temporal decision underspecified: when should each preference dimension enter policy optimization? We propose \methodname, a stability-guided active-set controller for controlled objective admission. \methodname starts from a small active set, retains admitted objectives, and expands when reward-deviation gates indicate low recent deviation or a patience budget is exhausted. A pro
papers.summary_zh: 多偏好對齊常被框架為純量化問題:組合獎勵維度後直接最佳化,卻忽略了時間性決策——每個偏好維度該在何時進入策略訓練。本文提出 STAGE,一個以穩定性為導向的主動集合控制器,將目標納入時機變成可控制的變數。方法上,STAGE 先以短暫探測階段,依早期增益與波動性估計各偏好維度由難到易的順序;訓練從小主動集合出發並採累積保留,已納入的維度不會退出;只有當即時穩定性閘門(ISG)與視窗化穩定性閘門(WSG)同時滿足、或耐心預算耗盡時,才納入下一個維度。階段內以自適應偏好加權強調表現落後的維度,合成純量 PPO 獎勵。實驗在 Qwen3-0.6B 與 Llama3-8B-Instruct 上,以 15 個訓練偏好維度與 16 個保留測試基準進行:STAGE 分別將平均分數由 32.78 提升至 44.81、由 52.38 提升至 62.93,優於同預算下的多目標 PPO、Reward Soups 及改編版 RCS、SPO、Curri-DPO。消融實驗支持自適應加權、偏差閘門與探測排序各自的貢獻;耐心預算分析顯示較長預算僅帶來遞減的邊際改善。限制包括僅依賴自動評審、單次執行、固定 15 個目標,且基準為同預算改編版本。本研究凸顯訓練時程安排是 RLHF 中具體可行的槓桿。

links.title: Governance at the Boundary: How Agent Decomposition Degrades Policy Compliance

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 4: fact attenuation at distance 2 is 0% (D0), 9/16 (56%, D1), 22/26 (85%, D2) on Qwen2.5-32B versus 0%, 1/30 (3%), 1/18 (6%) on gpt-4.1-mini; denominators are 16-30 discovered facts per condition with no statistical tests.
Section 5.3 Limitations: 'Governed success is 8/596 (1.3%)' and 'Substring triggers measure phrasing alongside governance; an LLM simulator exists but was not used for the reported episodes.'

Section 3.1 Invariant 1 and Section 3.2 Invariant 2: environment owns the audit log with actor attribution from topology code, and verification replays trajectories against a fresh environment copy evaluated at each tool call's state.

Appendix B, Table 6: full grid shows truncation of 37-54 of ~100 episodes per arm and gpt-4.1-mini D0 propagation loss of 14 with 0 attenuation, indicating capability failures independent of the attenuation mechanism.

Section 7 Conclusion: authors state the effect is 'not shown at frontier-model scale', not shown 'beyond KYC/AML', and not shown reducible 'by better handoff prompting'; the benchmark, tasks, policy packs, and harness are claimed open-source but no repository URL or commit is provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled agent-evaluation study squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and LLM evaluation preferences: it varies architecture (single ReAct loop vs pipeline vs orchestrator-subagent) while holding task and model fixed, and measures policy compliance degradation via 'fact attenuation' at handoff boundaries. The benchmark design is genuinely thoughtful (environment-owned audit logs, trajectory-replay verification, paired mirror tasks preventing always-escalate gaming, P0/P1 access-mode ablation, oracle/trap scripts over 100 variants). Novelty is moderate-good: the architecture-as-independent-variable framing and re-scorable metric family are fresh, though the underlying mechanism (summarization loss across handoffs) is intuitive. Rigor and evidence are held back by small denominators (attenuation computed on 16-30 discovered facts per condition with no confidence intervals or significance tests), a very low 1.3% governed-success base rate, 37-54% truncation per arm, GPTQ-Int4 quantization on the 32B model, and only two models, one behind an API. Generalizability is explicitly unproven (KYC/AML only, no frontier-model test, no intervention evaluation). Reproducibility is supported by full prompts (Appendix A), full per-arm counts (Appendix B), and a deterministic harness, but the open-source claim carries no verifiable artifact URL.

primary_link.title: Governance at the Boundary: How Agent Decomposition Degrades Policy Compliance

papers.summary: Existing agent benchmarks ask whether the agent finished the task. We ask whether it finished it within policy. We introduce Fiducia-bench, a benchmark for the governability of financial agents---whether they escalate when obligated, abstain when required, and leave an auditable trail---and use it to study a question no prior benchmark addresses: does decomposing an agent into components degrade its governance? It does, and the mechanism is specific. Policy-relevant facts discovered by one compo
papers.summary_zh: 既有代理基準多半只問任務是否完成,本文則問是否在政策規範內完成。作者提出 Fiducia-bench,衡量金融代理的治理能力——該上報時上報、該拒絕時拒絕,並留下可稽核軌跡——藉此探討先前未被檢視的問題:把代理拆解成多個元件,是否會削弱其政策遵循?在 100 個 KYC/AML 任務變體、兩個模型與三種架構、共 626 回合的實驗中,答案是肯定的,且機制明確:某元件發現的政策相關事實會在交接邊界被衰減,無法抵達必須據以行動的元件。以 Qwen2.5-32B 為例,在約束距離 2 的任務上,單迴圈基準的事實衰減率為 0%,固定管線為 56%,orchestrator-subagent 架構高達 85%;較強的 gpt-4.1-mini 則僅 3% 至 6%,顯示拆解成本部分取決於模型能力。更關鍵的是,同一機制會因遺漏事實屬風險訊號或開脫證據,分別導致低度上報與過度上報。基準以機器可檢查的政策包、軌跡重播進行可重現的驗證,並由環境自有稽核日誌,全部開源。作者承認研究尚未涵蓋前沿規模模型、限於 KYC/AML 情境,且治理成功率本身偏低。此研究對企業部署多代理系統是直接警示:交接摘要是一個能力基準不會檢視、卻治理攸關的介面。

evidence: Abstract and §6.1: SPC solid success 37/38 (97.4%) vs 21/38 (55.3%) for DDL baseline; two-sided exact McNemar p=3.05e-5 on 16-0 discordance
§5.3/Figure 2: 'Both information and mechanism differ; the contrast estimates a complete-system effect, not compilation in isolation' - explicit non-causal framing
§5.5: six-item exclusion registry 'constructed post hoc during reference auditing after system outputs had been inspected', not preregistered; all-44 sensitivity reported (§6.4, McNemar p=1.45e-4)

§9 Threats to Validity: single ACME domain, compiler/resolver developed while inspecting benchmark questions, no held-out construct-combination result, LLM judging with small calibration and no independent human adjudication

§5.6 and Code and Data Availability: archive lacks SQLite databases, counterfactual environment, exact working-tree state, and per-run verdict files for secondary boards; 'the study is not currently reproducible end to end'; public MIT snapshot excludes questions, gold labels, fixtures, harness, verdicts, and traces

§6.2-6.3: strict-scoring sensitivity strengthens difference (McNemar p=3.81e-6); SPC robust across gpt-5.6-luna (37/38), gpt-5.4 (36/38), gemini-3.6-flash (35/38), but only Luna has a paired baseline
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit for LLM agent/tool-use and text-to-SQL preferences: a multi-turn bounded planner agent, typed tool calling, structured output, and enterprise workflow reliability (§4, Fig. 1). Rigor is above average: paired 3-run design, exact McNemar test, strict-scoring and conservative sensitivities, all-44-item accounting, and an unusually candid threats section (§5.4-5.5, §6, §9). However, the headline contrast is confounded by design - both information and mechanism differ (§5.3, Fig. 2), no component ablation separates semantic knowledge from bounded compilation, the compiler was developed while inspecting the benchmark with no held-out construct evaluation (§7, §9), sampling-parameter parity is unverified, and adjudication relies on a single mutable gpt-4o alias with small calibration and no independent human review (§9). Evidence is solid for the narrow end-to-end claim on one benchmark but limited by a 38-question single-domain set, possible training-data exposure, and non-archived secondary-model artifacts. Novelty is moderate and partly self-disclaimed: ontology-mediated querying (ATHENA/Ontop), semantic layers (MetricFlow), and IR/compilation approaches are acknowledged prior art, with the contribution framed as a system contract rather than a new mechanism (§2). Generalizability is explicitly limited to ACME insurance. Reproducibility is weak despite MIT code and a Zenodo DOI: the public snapshot excludes questions, gold labels, fixtures, harness, verdict artifacts, and traces, and the paper states the study is not reproducible end to end (§5.6, Code and Data Availability).

primary_link.title: Bounded Semantic Planning and Deterministic Compilation for Reliable Enterprise Text-to-SQL

papers.summary: Direct text-to-SQL asks a language model to do two jobs: interpret the business question and construct the complete relational query. In enterprise schemas, SQL can execute successfully while using the wrong relationship role or aggregation grain. We study an alternative placement of the stochastic boundary. A multi-turn planner grounds phrases and selects from question-specific governed options; graph traversal, role predicates, grain lowering, SQL construction, and deterministic checks are imp
papers.summary_zh: 企業級 Text-to-SQL 的挑戰不在於語法正確，而在於商業語意：SQL 可能執行成功卻選錯關聯路徑、角色或彙總粒度。本文提出語意路徑編譯（SPC）系統，重新劃分隨機性邊界：語言模型只負責解析問題並從受限選項中選擇，而圖遍歷、角色謂詞、粒度調整、SQL 建構與檢查全部由確定性程式碼完成，模型無法直接命名資料表、欄位或 SQL 片段。在 ACME 保險基準的 38 題配對比較中，SPC 每題三次執行皆正確的比例達 97.4%，遠高於直接由 DDL 生成 SQL 基線的 55.3%，McNemar 檢定 p 值約 3×10⁻⁵。SPC 在 114 次執行中僅一次拒答、零次執行錯誤，基線則有 29 次被判定錯誤卻仍執行；嚴格評分的敏感度分析更擴大差距。限制包括單一領域、編譯器於檢視基準期間開發，且 SPC 獲得基線所沒有的語意知識，故只能視為端對端系統比較而非因果結論；部分實驗工件未封存，尚無法完整重現。此研究顯示，將關聯式決策交給確定性機制，能顯著提升重複執行的可靠度，並以明確拒答取代錯誤答案。
