evidence: Abstract: 'semantically informative action labels reduce exploration in favour of exploitation... negative rewards trigger substantially more exploration than equivalent positive rewards'
Section 4.4: evaluates OLMo-3.1-32B-Instruct, Qwen3-32B, and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite against a UCB1 classical baseline with 10 replicates per condition (Section 4.6)
Table 2: normalized cumulative regret for ordinal nomenclature spans 0.00-0.13 in helpful vs 0.27-1.00 in misleading conditions across models and scenarios (high scale, no variance)

Section 7 Limitations: 'A major limitation of our work is the limited number of replicates we performed due to computational constraints. Further experimentation is necessary to make conclusive statistical claims'

Section 5.2 / Figure 5(a): scale sweep isolates a sign-based exploration threshold but reports 'impact of reward magnitude is unclear and highly non-monotonic' with weak, inconsistent evidence for other thresholds
Appendix A.2 (Figure 6): full prompt template budget_summhist_v1 and nomenclature word pools disclosed; no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper
Appendix B.5: qualitative reasoning trace shows Gemini explicitly rejecting the 'tank top' arm due to its semantic label despite contradictory reward evidence
Related work: claims 'we are the first to characterize the potentially misleading semantic biases involved' in ICRL exploration, extending Monea et al. (2024)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-methodology paper: controlled study of how semantic priors (action labels, reward sign) bias LLM in-context exploration in bandits, directly touching LLMs, agents, in-context learning/prompting, and AI robustness. The 'semantic bandit' formalization and the reward-polarity/expected-scale finding are genuine but incremental over Monea et al. (2024) and perturbation-robustness literature. Design is careful (alphanumeric control, helpful/misleading swaps, UCB1 baseline, variance/3-vs-5-arm/model-scale robustness checks), but only 10 replicates per condition, no significance tests or CIs, and the causal attribution to 'pre-training reward conventions' is untested. Effects are large and consistently tabulated, though the synthetic 3-arm setting and absence of real agentic tasks limit external validity. Prompts and implementation details are disclosed, but no code/data release is stated and one closed model (Gemini) is used.

primary_link.title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in settings that require sophisticated environmental exploration. However, existing work has raised questions about how LLMs actually balance exploration and exploitation. Unlike classical agents, LLM agents engage with tasks through natural language, exposing them to semantic information with no formal counterpart in the task structure. We introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the multi-armed bandit settin
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被部署為決策代理，但其情境內的探索—利用行為可能受語意先驗干擾。本文提出「語意老虎機」，在經典多臂老虎機上明確參數化動作的文字標籤與情境，用以研究預訓練中語言與報酬關聯所形成的歸納偏誤。實驗以抽象老虎機、農場與服裝推薦三種情境，搭配字母數字、情感詞、序數與世界知識四種命名方式，測試 OLMo-3.1-32B、Qwen3-32B 與 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite，並以 UCB1 作為符號基線。主要發現有三：語意豐富的標籤會降低探索、轉向利用，對齊時可大幅降低遺憾，錯位時則嚴重惡化表現；負向報酬觸發的探索遠多於等值正向報酬，顯示模型以預期尺度而非抽象數值解讀報酬；兩種偏誤會交互作用，負報酬會削弱標籤偏誤。在最簡單的三臂、零變異設定中，僅改變標籤即可使行為從近乎最佳滑落至近乎最差，凸顯評估時語意對齊的隱藏風險。限制為重複次數有限與環境過於簡化，未來需在更複雜的脈絡式老虎機與真實部署情境驗證。
papers.title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors
papers.title_zh: 語意老虎機：情境內探索與利用行為受語意先驗偏誤影響

links.title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors

evidence: Abstract + §3.3: LLM multilingual safety steering evaluated on Gemma 7B, Llama 3.1-8B, Qwen 7B-Chat with MultiJail, translated OR-Bench, Global MMLU.
§3.1: vector extraction reuses difference-in-means (Arditi et al. 2024) and Wang et al. (2024) datasets (n=128), confirming derivative method design.
Table 4 / §4.2: true-refusal-only baseline drives OR-Bench over-refusal to 0.45-0.90, supporting the combined-intervention claim but also showing gains depend on ablation choice.
Tables 6-9 (Appendix A): full λ/α grids with per-language MultiJail/OR-Bench/MMLU numbers back headline claims (e.g., Gemma Bengali 37→54).
Figure 2 caption vs Table 5: inconsistent 'best' hyperparameters for Qwen; §3.1 kl_threshold 0.1 vs Appendix D ablate_kl_threshold 0.2.
§3.4: refusal labels via WildGuard on X-ALMA back-translations; single classifier, no inter-annotator or significance checks.
§6 + Ethical Considerations: authors concede English-centric norms and MT-only pipeline; §4.3 notes multilingual human evaluation was out of scope.
Appendix D: full config, seeds (42/1), batch sizes, ~100 A100 GPU hours; §3.4 footnotes 2 and 4 state code and translated dataset are publicly released (links redacted).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: LLM safety alignment via activation steering (Abstract; §3.3 evaluates Gemma 7B, Llama 3.1, Qwen 7B on MultiJail, OR-Bench, Global MMLU), touching AI safety, interpretability (refusal directions, §3.1), and evaluation (RQ 4.1-4.3). Novelty is incremental: §3.1 explicitly adapts difference-in-means extraction from Arditi et al. (2024) and the orthogonalized true/false-refusal vectors of Wang et al. (2024), while §1 and §2 acknowledge Wang et al. (2025) already showed refusal directions transfer across languages; the new elements are the combined add+ablate intervention applied multilingually and a translated multilingual OR-Bench resource (§3.3). Rigor is moderate: a full hyperparameter grid with per-language tables (Tables 6-9, Appendix A) and a true-refusal-only baseline (Table 4) are provided, but there are no significance tests or error bars, missing MMLU cells in Tables 8-9, internal inconsistencies (Figure 2 caption lists Qwen best as λ=0.6/α=0.8 while Table 5 bolds Qwen 0.85 at λ=0.8/α=0.8; §3.1 states KL threshold 0.1 but Appendix D config sets ablate_kl_threshold 0.2), and visibly garbled prose in §3.2 and §4.2 suggesting weak polish. Evidence is traceable (e.g., Bengali refusal 37→54 and Gemma ~11pp average in Tables 6-7) but rests entirely on one automated classifier (WildGuard) plus machine back-translation (§3.4), with §6 conceding machine-translation nuance limits and no human evaluation (§4.3). Generalizability is decent across eight typologically diverse languages and three model families (§4.1, Table 2) but limited to ~7B-scale models and English-centric safety norms (§6). Reproducibility is supported by full configuration, seeds, and compute budget in Appendix D, though code/data links are redacted for anonymity.

primary_link.title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed globally in high-stakes settings, yet most safety research and alignment efforts remain concentrated on English. Thus, users interacting with LLMs in other languages may encounter weaker safeguards despite relying on the same systems for similarly sensitive tasks. In this work, we investigate whether safety signals learned from a high-resource language, like English, can improve multilingual safety. We propose BabelSteering, an activation steering method
radar.summary_zh: LLM 全球部署，但安全研究高度集中於英語，非英語使用者可能面臨較弱防護。本文提出 BabelSteering，一種推論時的激活導向干預：從少量英文資料（128 筆）提取拒答向量與過度拒答向量，將後者相對前者正交化以分離兩種行為，再於推論時加入拒答向量並跨層消融正交化的假拒答成分，以同時提升安全並抑制過度謹慎；此法不需再訓練、不增加推論成本。評估涵蓋八種語言（含阿拉伯語、韓語、孟加拉語）與三個模型家族（Gemma 7B、Llama 3.1-8B、Qwen 7B-Chat），共同測量 MultiJail 有害拒答、翻譯版 OR-Bench 過度拒答與 Global MMLU 效用。結果顯示：Gemma 7B 有害拒答率平均提升 11 個百分點，孟加拉語提升 17 個百分點，而 MMLU 幾乎不受影響；但偽有害拒答也隨之上升，低資源語言的變化最明顯。這支持安全概念在潛在空間中具跨語言共通性。限制包括方法內含英語中心的安全規範、無法處理文化特定危害，且翻譯採機器翻譯而非人工校對。
radar.title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors
radar.title_zh: BabelSteering：透過英文導向向量實現多語言安全對齊

links.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models

evidence: Abstract: Mint-Ag reported at 98.33 RFC-Bench, 76.00/60.49 FinanceAgentBench v1.1/v2, 89.04 FinSearchComp T2; Mint-Cu 69.86 T2 and 41.98 FAB v2.
Section 6.1 Protocol: 'we use the 50 public v1.1 tasks and 27 public v2 tasks' for FinanceAgentBench; FAB v2 run three times with variance, other benchmarks single-run.

Section 6.1 Protocol: on FinSearchComp, Mint and all frontier models are run in the authors' MintHarness while ASearcher/OpenResearcher/Tongyi retain official harnesses—an evaluation-harness confound.

Section 3.1-3.2: atomic tasks retained only if supp(r)⊆E, replayable, and uniquely answerable; long-horizon tasks require replayable hidden answer graphs—but no counts for D_atom/D_long or corpus statistics are reported anywhere.

Section 5.1-5.3: SFT traces sampled from GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro with three filtering gates; RLVR uses difficulty-refreshed active batches and GSPO; critical-step OPD uses an LLM judge to select failed-trajectory turns; sampling weights α_R/α_A, A_max, and learning rates are never specified.

Table 3 (Section 6.4): only ablation—MOPD improves the TIES-merged 9B checkpoint by 1.33/3.86/4.00/3.19 on FinanceBench/BizFinBench/FAB v1.1/FinSearch T2; no ablations of data engine, verifier, or curriculum.
Appendix A: RFC-Bench restricted to Task 2 label classification; official/judge prompts documented for BizFinBench, FinanceBench, FinSearchComp, and FAB.

Section 6.3: API-equivalent costs estimated by applying base-model prices (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B) to measured token usage; models locally hosted; project website given but no explicit open-source release of weights, data, or training code.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Finance-vertical but methodology-centric agentic LLM work (SFT, RLVR with GSPO, cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation, TIES merging, agent harness with evidence ledger), giving strong coverage of high-weight Agent/LLM/Reasoning preferences, though the finance domain focus and absence of Japanese NLP dilute fit. Novelty is mostly integrative—TIES, GSPO, GOLD-style OPD and MOPD are adopted—leaving the provenance-verified answer-graph data engine and critical-turn OPD as the main new elements. Rigor and evidence are limited by unreported dataset sizes and hyperparameters (mixture weights, A_max, learning rates), tiny FinanceAgentBench test sets (50 v1.1 / 27 v2 tasks), evaluation of frontier baselines inside the authors' own MintHarness on FinSearchComp, single-run scores on most benchmarks, and a single integration-stage ablation (Table 3). Headline claims of beating GPT-5.6/Claude-class models with a 27B model are plausible but rest on judge-scored small-N evaluations. Reproducibility is partial: judge prompts and benchmark scripts are documented, but no weight, data, or training-code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models

radar.summary: Financial agents must do more than recall domain knowledge: they must be both reliable, executing precise operations over grounded evidence, and executive, sustaining long-horizon research whose conclusions remain auditable. We present Mint-Agent, a family of finance-native agentic models designed around these two scales of financial intelligence. Mint-Agent is built upon three pillars: data, harness, and algorithm. Our data engine constructs clean, specialized tasks for atomic financial capabil
radar.summary_zh: 金融研究任務要求代理不僅給出答案，更要能追溯證據來源並重現計算。本文提出 Mint-Agent，一系列金融原生代理基礎模型，圍繞三大支柱：資料引擎從 EDGAR、XBRL、FRED 等原始來源合成原子能力與長程任務，每個任務附帶完整隱藏證據圖以利確定性驗證；MintHarness 以證據分類帳與工作記憶支援可審計的狀態化執行，將觀察、計算與結論串成可回放的軌跡；訓練流程結合 SFT、關鍵步驟 on-policy 蒸餾與可驗證獎勵的強化學習，先分別訓練推理與執行專家，再以 TIES 合併與多教師 on-policy 蒸餾整合，產出 Mint-Cu（9B）與 Mint-Ag（27B）。在七項專業基準上，Mint-Ag 於 RFC-Bench 達 98.33%、FinanceAgentBench v1.1 達 76.00%、FinSearchComp T2 達 89.04%，超越 GPT-5.6-Sol 等前沿模型且成本更低。失敗模式分析顯示 v2 的主要瓶頸已轉為證據抽取。限制包括 FinanceAgentBench 缺乏保留驗證集、公開任務可能已見於訓練資料，以及成本比較以基礎模型定價估算。
radar.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models
radar.title_zh: Mint-Agent：金融原生代理基礎模型

links.title: Breaking Planner Integrity Boundary: Enviroment State-Text Injection Attack on LLM-Driven Embodied Agents

evidence: Abstract: claims ESTI improves planning-level and execution-level attack success rates 'by up to 89.32% and 43.69%' relative to baselines; these exact figures do not correspond to any derived quantity in Tables 1-4.
Table 1 (DeepSeek-V4-Pro, AI2-THOR): ESTI reports 100.00% P-ASR / 48.08% E-ASR vs EIRAD 17.31% / 12.50% and BADROBOT-contextual jailbreak 8.65% / 6.73%.
Section 4.2: stated average P-ASR/E-ASR gains of 18.63 and 11.13 points over Vanilla IPI (99.12%/45.75% vs 80.49%/34.62%) recompute correctly from Table 1 across the three environments.

Table 5 (Ablation): removing Native-Carrier Matching drops P-ASR from 100.00% to 12.50%, Representation Consistency to 37.50%, while Runtime Re-grounding removal costs only 1.92 points; ablation is honestly caveated about shared denominators.

Section 4.1: each condition is 'repeated three times' and averaged, but no standard deviations, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests are reported and per-condition sample counts are not given.

Section 4.6: real-robot proof of concept manually instantiates planner-visible state in text ('the environmental state is manually instantiated from the real scene'), leaving fully closed-loop perception-planning evaluation to future work.
Sections 4-5: no code, ESTI-Bench release, prompt templates, or artifact-availability statement appears anywhere in the paper, limiting reproducibility of the payload construction and benchmark.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent security paper squarely within high-weight preferences (agents/security, AI safety, red teaming, prompt injection): it targets LLM planners, not pure robotics, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Novelty is moderate: framing planner-visible environment-state text as an independent, schema-compatible injection surface and separately measuring planning-to-execution transfer (P-ASR vs E-ASR) is a distinct advance over command-style IPI/suffix/jailbreak attacks, but it is an incremental extension of a busy subfield. Rigor is solid but incomplete: a formally specified threat model, clean/control/attack protocol, matched-groundability baselines across three environments and three planners, and informative ablations; however, no variance or significance testing, small-sample percentages (e.g., 5.71%, 6.73%) without denominators, and the abstract's headline 'up to 89.32%/43.69%' gains are not traceable to any table (though stated averages of 18.63/11.13 points over Vanilla IPI are verifiable). Evidence strength benefits from internally consistent tables (Table 2 transfer rates and averages recompute correctly from Table 1), but there is no released benchmark, code, or payload templates, and the single real-robot demo manually instantiates state text, which limits external validation and reproducibility. No defense evaluation is attempted, acknowledged as future work.

primary_link.title: Breaking Planner Integrity Boundary: Enviroment State-Text Injection Attack on LLM-Driven Embodied Agents

radar.summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven embodied agents rely on environment states to interpret scenes, generate high-level plans, and drive physical execution, making planner-visible state representations a critical security boundary. Existing attacks primarily manipulate user instructions, prompt contexts, model behavior, or perceptual inputs, while paying limited attention to whether environment-state text itself can serve as deceptive task evidence and propagate beyond planning to affect execution
radar.summary_zh: LLM 驅動的具身代理依賴環境狀態文字來解讀場景、生成規劃並驅動執行，但現有攻擊多針對使用者指令、提示內容或感知輸入。本文提出首個閉環環境狀態文字注入攻擊（ESTI）：攻擊者不修改使用者指令、模型參數或執行器，而是將預設對抗目標改寫為符合原生狀態表示的假證據，透過物件屬性、空間關係、可供性、任務階段規則與執行回饋影響目標綁定與行動排序。作者建構 ESTI-Bench，分別測量規劃層與執行層攻擊成功率（P-ASR、E-ASR），在 ProgPrompt/VirtualHome、VoxPoser/RLBench 與 AI2-THOR/iTHOR 三種異質環境中，ESTI 的規劃層成功率最高達 100%，執行層較最強基線提升最多 43.69 個百分點，並在真實人形機器人完成概念驗證。消融顯示原生載體匹配與表示一致性最關鍵；規劃到執行的轉移率存在明顯落差，顯示僅欺騙規劃器不足以衡量具身攻擊。此工作指出規劃器可見的環境狀態是獨立的安全邊界，防禦需涵蓋狀態來源追蹤與執行時驗證。
radar.title: Breaking Planner Integrity Boundary: Enviroment State-Text Injection Attack on LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
radar.title_zh: 突破規劃器完整性邊界：針對 LLM 驅動具身代理的環境狀態文字注入攻擊

links.title: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis

evidence: Sec. VI-B: 'To curate these canonical responses, we used Claude-Opus-4.5 model to generate high-quality outputs... hold this response constant across all evaluated models' — acknowledges this 'controlled experimental abstraction' does not evaluate model-specific generation
Sec. VI-A: dataset is one real attack in the GOAD environment (October 2025), 10 windows, 587 compressed logs, 20 ground-truth attack entries (Tables I-II)

Table III (Sec. VI-C): TAD accuracy 0.9847/0.9779/0.9830/0.9830 (Direct) across Qwen3-4B, Gemma-3-4B, Qwen2.5-7B, Granite-4.1-8B; Sec. VI-C reports average precision margins of 39.47%, 47.46%, 40.88% over the closest baseline for Direct/Regular/Indirect
Sec. V: complexity analysis O(M·L·T²(d+log T)) with screen-then-confirm reducing passes to M=O(√N); H1 extension noted as cubic and deferred (Appendix A, Table IV)
Sec. VI-B: 'The code & data is available at: https://github.com/RezzFayyazi/TAD'; Appendix C provides judge/citation baseline prompts; greedy decoding for baselines
Sec. VI-C and Sec. VII: no statistical significance tests, single-domain evaluation, and future-work caveats on per-layer importance and scalable Vietoris-Rips variants
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: segment-level RAG attribution via persistent homology (H0) on hidden states, evaluated on four LLMs, directly serving LLM (2.5), RAG (1.8), and interpretability (1.8) preferences with an agentic-AI trust motivation. Novelty is solid—prior TDA-for-LLM work does not do segment-level ablation attribution, and the screen-then-confirm O(√N) design is a reasonable engineering contribution—though the core signal is leave-one-out ablation with a new geometry-based distance. Rigor and evidence are capped by a single curated GOAD attack dataset (10 windows, 587 logs, 20 ground-truth), the use of a Claude-Opus-4.5-generated canonical response held fixed across models rather than each model's own generations, no significance testing, and an illustrative Fig.1 case that is separate from the evaluated dataset. Results tables (Table III) are detailed and internally consistent, with reported precision margins of 39-47% over baselines, but external validity beyond this one lab attack is undemonstrated; generalizability is asserted (model-agnostic design, four architectures) not shown on non-security RAG data. Reproducibility is good: public code/data URL, Algorithm 1 pseudocode, baseline prompts, hardware, and complexity analysis.

primary_link.title: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in cybersecurity operations to assist cybersecurity analysts with rapid decision-making against emerging threats. However, there is a main criteria that must be met when using LLMs in cybersecurity, that is, trust in the generated outputs. As Agentic AI is integrated into operational systems, a robust evidence attribution and provenance tracking technique is essential to trace the origins of model generations. When autonomous agents ma
radar.summary_zh: 在網路安全營運中，RAG 系統需要可靠的證據歸因：當代理做出決策，分析師必須能追溯是哪份日誌支撐了回應。現有方法如 LLM 自評、餘弦相似度或 token 級歸因，在高度相似的事件日誌上容易失效。本文提出拓撲歸因距離（TAD）：對每個檢索片段進行消融，計算回應嵌入在各 Transformer 層的 H0 持續同調圖，並以 Wasserstein 距離量化幾何形變；形變最大的片段即為最有影響力的證據。為控制成本，採「先篩選後確認」策略，先以約 √N 個批次粗篩，再於高歸因批次內逐條確認。在真實攻擊日誌（GOAD 環境，壓縮後 587 筆）上，涵蓋 Direct、Regular、Indirect 三種難度情境，TAD 在四個 LLM 上平均準確率超過 97%，Precision 較最佳基線高出逾 39 個百分點，且在幾乎無關鍵詞重疊的 Indirect 情境優勢最大。限制包括消融式推論成本隨片段數量增長、H1 同調計算更昂貴，以及實驗以固定典範回應替代各模型自由生成以利比較，未必反映真實部署差異。
radar.title: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis
radar.title_zh: 拓撲歸因距離（TAD）：揭示事件日誌分析中 RAG 片段層級對 LLM 輸出幾何的影響

links.title: KernelArc: A Multi-Agent Framework for GPU Kernel Optimization

evidence: Abstract: KernelArc ranked first on every representative L1, L2, Quantization, and FlashInfer task in the August 20, 2026 SOL-ExecBench leaderboard snapshot, with trajectories supporting shared multi-agent search within a fixed candidate budget.

Section 4.3: FI-014 ablation with five trajectories per configuration; Multi-unbounded geometric-mean speedup 2.04x Single and 1.59x Multi-bounded; permutation test p=0.0466 weakens to p=0.0906 when excluding the legacy non-conforming Single trajectory.

Section 4.3 'Uncertainty and interpretation': configurations change several factors together (agent count, memory scope, campaign-leaderboard access, retention horizon), so data support a workload-specific trend, not a causal estimate for any single knob.

Section 4.1: single-agent Hopper GEMM campaign reaches 766 TFLOPS BF16, 3.2% above the matched cuBLAS baseline (742 TFLOPS) on one fixed 4096x4096 shape under a detailed Hopper-specific playbook, explicitly framed as a depth boundary case.
Section 4.2: only one task per category evaluated out of 235 SOL-ExecBench problems, 'primarily because of access and cost constraints'; described as case studies, not a suite-wide win-rate estimate.

Section 5 'Limitations': rankings are time-specific, the Hopper-Blackwell contrast changes workload and hardware, the ablation has few heterogeneous runs and uses evaluated candidates rather than wall time, tokens, or cost.

Section 3.4 and Table 1: architecture details (eight strategy skills, conclusions-only wins/traps memory capped at 16 entries by default, cascade gate, REJECT/KEEP/ACCEPT/REVERT actions, plateau drafting threshold) are specified, but no public code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.
Appendix A: per-task final SOL scores and rankings (L1-030 SOL 0.546380, L2-025 0.535106, Quant-031 0.988423, FI-014 0.986154) with detailed algorithm pseudocode for each submitted kernel.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent and coding-agent research (multi-agent orchestration, shared memory, deterministic guard) applied to GPU kernel optimization, so it is squarely in scope rather than a pure domain application. Preference relevance is high via Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLMs. Rigor is mixed: a formal objective, deterministic benchmark guard, locked-clock protocol, five-trajectory ablation with geometric means, bootstrap CIs, and permutation tests are positives, but the ablation covers a single task (FI-014), confounds agent count, memory scope, leaderboard access, and retention horizon, and its key contrast is marginal (p=0.0466 weakening to p=0.0906 excluding a legacy trajectory). Evidence for breadth rests on five case studies and time-specific public leaderboard ranks; the authors honestly flag that these are not suite-wide win rates and that per-mechanism causal attribution is open. Generalizability is limited by one-task-per-category coverage and H100/B200 specificity. Reproducibility is weakened by the absence of any code or artifact release statement, despite detailed algorithms, skill tables, and kernel descriptions. Novelty is moderate: strategy-specialized multi-agent kernel optimization exists (Astra, AccelOpt, CORAL cited); KernelArc's conclusions-only memory with configurable retention, deterministic guard, and plateau drafting is an incremental combination, and the paper itself leaves which coordination feature matters as an open question.

primary_link.title: KernelArc: A Multi-Agent Framework for GPU Kernel Optimization

radar.summary: We present KernelArc, a multi-agent framework for autonomous GPU kernel optimization across heterogeneous workloads. Strategy-specialized agents run in parallel and coordinate through conclusions-only shared memory, a deterministic benchmark guard, and read-only cross-agent state with plateau-triggered drafting. We evaluate KernelArc on NVIDIA H100 and B200 GPUs using category-representative SOL-ExecBench workloads. The resulting implementations span custom BF16 GEMM, static cuBLASLt Expert-API
radar.summary_zh: GPU 核心手動調校門檻高，單一 LLM 代理的循序搜尋又容易陷入局部平台期。本文提出 KernelArc，一個多代理 GPU 核心最佳化框架：策略專精的代理並行探索不同最佳化家族，僅透過「只含結論」的共享記憶交換成功經驗與陷阱；確定性守衛負責正確性檢查、基準測量與保留或回復決策；平台期觸發改寫促使代理改用不同演算法、DSL 或資料布局。在 H100 上，配備詳細 Hopper playbook 的單代理迴路於固定形狀 BF16 GEMM 達 766 TFLOPS，比同協定下量測的 cuBLAS 基線高 3.2%；在 SOL-ExecBench 多形狀任務上，多代理系統將 L1-030 從單代理的 0.441 平台期推升至 0.546，多個代表性任務在 2026 年 8 月公開排行榜名列第一。FI-014 消融顯示，在約 100 候選預算下，共享無上限記憶的雙代理配置幾何平均加速為單代理的 2.04 倍。限制為個案例研究而非全基準勝率估計、排行榜具時效性，且各協調特徵的貢獻難以單獨歸因。
radar.title: KernelArc: A Multi-Agent Framework for GPU Kernel Optimization
radar.title_zh: KernelArc：GPU 核心最佳化的多代理框架

links.title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents

evidence: Abstract: claims token reductions of 14.67%, 17.93%, and 20.08% on Robotouille synchronous, asynchronous, and ALFWorld on tasks solved by both methods.
Figure 1: strict leaf/action grounding calls are 23.67%, 29.56%, 45.73% of LLM calls in successful Qwen3.5-27B ReCAP trajectories on Robotouille sync, async, and ALFWorld.

Section 4.1: leaf-reflex library built offline from 121 successful ReCAP trajectories containing 329 canonical rules; support threshold ablated over 1, 2, 4; low-temperature decoding, 30000-token context limit, 2048 max generation.
Table 1: end-to-end Robotouille success rates CoT 6%/0%, ReAct 22%/6%, ReCAP 75%/46%, HaReCAP s=2 76%/48% (sync/async).
Table 2: both-success token reductions s=2 sync 772,053->658,777 (14.67%) and async 1,357,880->1,114,477 (17.93%); async both-success counts only 27-29 tasks.
Table 3 (Section 4.3): ALFWorld Qwen3.5-27B accuracy 93.28% vs ReCAP 94.03% with 20.7% token reduction; Gemma4-26B accuracy rises 66.42%->75.37% with 11.4% token reduction.
Table 4: ALFWorld both-success token reductions 20.08% (Qwen3.5-27B), 14.21% (Qwen3.5-9B), 21.09% (Gemma4-26B).
Algorithm 1: conservative leaf-reflex triggering with support gate m, unique valid-action match, ambiguity margin lambda=1, abstention fallback to ReCAP.
Section 3.2: canonicalization normalizes object ids to type placeholders (bread12->bread#); rules extracted only from successful trajectories with task-level deduplication.
Footnote 1: 'Code and data: https://github.com/agic01/harecap'; no limitations section or statistical significance reported anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent paper (agents, recursive planning, inference efficiency) squarely within preferred topics. The contribution is incremental: it caches/distills the final leaf-level action-grounding step of ReCAP into abstainable exact-match rules (essentially conservative memoization), explicitly avoiding macro skills; the abstention/unique-match trigger and margin scoring are careful but conceptually simple. Rigor is decent: CoT/ReAct/ReCAP baselines, support-threshold ablation (s=1,2,4), cross-environment (ALFWorld) and cross-model (Qwen3.5-27B/9B, Gemma4-26B) checks, and a thoughtful paired 'both-success' cost analysis (Section 4.1). Weaknesses: no seeds, variance, or significance testing; async paired sets are small (27-29 tasks, Table 2) and both-success sets shift across thresholds, making cross-threshold comparisons noisy; no limitations section; the tie-break score's magic constants (1.6, 1/10, margin 1 in Algorithm 1) are unjustified; offline library requires 121 successful baseline trajectories whose construction cost is not quantified. Quantitative claims are concrete and internally consistent (abstract's 14.67%/17.93%/20.08% match Tables 2 and 4). Generalizability is demonstrated only across two text-based embodied benchmarks with exact valid-action sets; applicability to open-ended action spaces is untested. Reproducibility is aided by a code/data link and pseudocode, but prompts and run counts are unspecified.

primary_link.title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents

radar.summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks require LLM agents to iteratively decompose high-level goals, revise plans in response to environmental feedback, and ground leaf-level subgoals into valid executable actions. Recursive context-management methods such as ReCAP improve planning stability through multi-level task decomposition and parent-node refinement, but still repeatedly invoke the LLM at leaf nodes to ground atomic subtasks into exact valid actions. We refer to this final grounding step as last-mil
radar.summary_zh: 長程具身任務中，ReCAP 等遞迴情境管理框架雖改善規劃穩定性，但在葉節點仍反覆呼叫 LLM，將原子子任務接地為精確的合法動作，形成「最後一哩接地冗餘」。本文提出 HaReCAP，一個低侵入的葉級接地擴充：離線從成功的 ReCAP 軌跡萃取高頻葉節點決策，編譯成可審計、可棄權的單步「葉反射規則」庫；線上執行時，只有當規則能在當前合法動作集中唯一確定一個動作時才跳過 LLM 呼叫，否則完整回退至原始 ReCAP，不干擾遞迴分解與回溯邏輯。規則採型別無關的正規化以跨物件 ID 重用，並以支援度門檻與歧視性視窗控制觸發保守性。在 Robotouille 與 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen3.5-27B 評估，於兩法皆解的任務上分別減少 14.67%、17.93% 與 20.08% 的 token 消耗，端對端成功率相近；跨模型實驗（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-26B）亦見類似降低，顯示機制不依賴單一規模或領域，為長程代理效率提供輕量且可審計的提升路徑。
radar.title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents
radar.title_zh: HaReCAP：遞迴式大型語言模型代理的習慣動作接地

links.title: PCA-guided Activation Scaling for Monotonic Bidirectional Control over LLM Sycophancy

evidence: Abstract: 'PAS achieves strong monotonicity (Spearman ρ = +0.92) and an average shift of 15.4% per direction, compared with 8.7% for the baselines' across 'three LLMs and three datasets'; code/data at https://github.com/Bellafc/PCS

Section 4.4: automated label-free grid search over layers L∈{20,23,25,27} (Gemma up to 31) and K∈{50,100,150,200}; selected layer 25/K=100 for Qwen (AUC 0.94) and Llama (0.85), layer 20/K=150 for Gemma (0.83)

Section 6.2 / Table 3: ablations confirm necessity of both components and exponents — Only PCA ρ=−0.21, Only Residual ρ=+0.18, Suboptimal Layer ρ=+0.18, best exponent variant (β^1.5, β^0.5) ρ=+0.48 vs full method +0.92

Section 4.3: authors concede mechanism is not explained: 'The behavioral direction of this rescaling is established empirically in Figure 3... rather than by a claim about the mechanism underlying it'

Section 5.4: open-ended transfer (ELEPHANT, OpinionQA) uses only 30 examples per model-dataset with a GPT-4o judge; authors state results 'should be read as indicative evidence... rather than as a definitive open-ended benchmark' (mean ρ=+0.94)
Table 1: PAS best in all four shift directions (Hon↑ 13.5, Hon↓ 18.0, Syc↓ 15.4, Syc↑ 14.5) and only method with ρ>0.5 (baselines: Angular −0.29, CAA −0.12, Conceptor −0.23, Few-shot +0.46)
Conclusion: 'Current limitations include the need for per-model grid search over layers and PCA dimensions, and evaluation restricted to 7B-9B models in multiple-choice sycophancy settings'
Appendix C: internal inconsistency — Llama β=1.8 example header reads '(X) ✗ Sycophantic' although the displayed generated answer is '(C)', the correct option
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM alignment/interpretability work: activation steering on three open LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B) to control sycophancy, matching the LLM (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), Alignment (2.0), and Interpretability (1.8) preferences. Novelty is moderate: steering via contrastive directions (CAA), angular steering, conceptors, and activation scaling all exist; the contribution is a PCA-subspace/residual decomposition with asymmetric exponents (β², β) plus a monotonicity evaluation criterion. Rigor is solid but not airtight: four baselines, systematic ablations (Table 3: best ablation ρ=+0.48 vs +0.92 full), AUC-based layer/dim selection (Section 4.4), yet no confidence intervals, ad hoc exponent choice with the authors admitting 'established empirically... rather than by a claim about the mechanism' (Section 4.3), and only 30 open-ended examples per pair (Section 5.4, self-described as 'indicative'). Evidence is extensive (Tables 1-2, 9-16) but contains internal inconsistencies (e.g., Appendix C Llama β=1.8 labeled 'Sycophantic' while outputting the correct (C)). Generalizability is limited to 7B-9B models with per-model grid search, acknowledged in the Conclusion. Reproducibility is aided by a claimed code/data release and detailed hyperparameters, but decoding settings and the GPT-4o judge prompt are unspecified.

primary_link.title: PCA-guided Activation Scaling for Monotonic Bidirectional Control over LLM Sycophancy

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit sycophancy, a tendency to agree with user beliefs regardless of factual accuracy. This can reinforce misconceptions, but eliminating it entirely risks over-correction against valid opinions. Effective control must therefore both reduce and increase sycophancy with predictable and gradual effect. Yet, existing methods fail to ensure a bidirectional and monotonic relationship between steering strength and behavioral outcome across models and datasets. We introd
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型普遍存在諂媚行為，即不論事實對錯都迎合使用者信念，可能強化錯誤認知；但完全消除又有過度矯正、不當反駁使用者正確意見的風險。現有方法無法確保控制參數與行為結果之間兼具「雙向」與「單調」的關係。本文提出PAS（PCA引導的激活縮放），先以配對的諂媚／誠實提示取得殘差流激活差異，利用PCA將激活分解為諂媚—誠實子空間與正交殘差，再分別套用β²與β的異質縮放指數，實現連續雙向控制。在Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5與Gemma-2三個模型及NLPClaim、Feedback、MATH三個資料集上，PAS達到強單調性（Spearman ρ=+0.92），四個方向的平均行為偏移為15.4%，明顯高於四種基線的8.7%；在開放式評測中單調性亦維持ρ=+0.94。消融實驗顯示分解結構、異質指數與層選擇缺一不可（最佳消融變體僅ρ=+0.48）。限制包括需對每個模型進行層與維度的網格搜尋，且評測限於7B–9B模型與選擇題情境。此研究讓從業人員能用單一參數可預測地調整諂媚程度，對AI對齊與部署控制具實務價值。
radar.title: PCA-guided Activation Scaling for Monotonic Bidirectional Control over LLM Sycophancy
radar.title_zh: PCA引導的激活縮放：對大型語言模型諂媚行為的單調雙向控制

links.title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection

evidence: Sec. 4.3-4.4: Evidence Verifier trained with soft labels from 3-annotator agreement (Eq. 1) used as GRPO reward (Eq. 2, 6-8), hybrid rule/model reward with αM=0.5 default.
Sec. 5.1: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct base, LoRA r=16/α=32, GRPO with DAPO modifications (no KL, token-level loss, clip higher, overlong masking); no code or data release statement appears in the paper.
Table 1 (Sec. 5.2): Defake-o3 0.992 Acc/F1 and IoU 0.311 vs Defake-CoT 0.992/0.280, FakeVLM 0.857 Acc, FakeShield 0.494 Acc on GroundFake test.
Table 3 (Sec. 5.3): FakeFrontier OoD classification Acc 0.9232 vs FakeVLM 0.7114, FakeShield 0.6127, CNNSpot 0.6499, NPR 0.4891.
Table 5 (Sec. 5.5): αM ablation showing rule-only (αM=0) yields IoU 0.252 vs 0.311 at αM=0.5, while verifier-only (αM=1) degrades BLEU-1 to 0.275.

Table 2 (Sec. 5.3): MLLM-judge protocol on 200 fake images with three judges (Qwen3-VL-235B, Kimi K2.5, GLM-4.6V); judges' Prior-Acc on fake images is low (0.074-0.353), and Defake-o3 ranks first in QS/Hit@Img/Hit@Evi under all judges.
Sec. G.3: annotation quality controls - 3 independent annotators per item, 74.99% valid under majority vote, 89.43% unanimous, batch rejection if control-item valid rate exceeds 5%.
Table S4 (Appendix F): throughput 2.606 samples/s for Defake-o3 vs 10.668 for Defake-Direct, acknowledging a real inference-cost trade-off.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An MLLM-based agentic detection system (Qwen3-VL-8B + zoom-in tool calling, structured JSON output) trained with GRPO and a human-verified Evidence Verifier reward, so it carries substantive language-model methodology (tool use, verifier reward shaping, CoT ablations, LLM-as-judge eval) rather than being pure computer vision; however, the task itself is AIGI image forensics, tempering preference relevance. Novelty is moderate: iterative zoom derives from DeepEyes/Pixel Reasoner/Mini-o3, and grounded explanation + RL exists in So-Fake/FakeXplain; the genuinely new element is a verifier trained from human valid/invalid evidence labels used as hybrid RL reward. Rigor is solid: retrained and official baselines, multiple ablations (Tables 1, 5, S2, S5), robustness and throughput tables, and annotation quality controls (Sec. G.3), but the LLM-judge persuasion protocol on only 200 fake images is somewhat circular and LEGION/FakeShield baseline collapses on FakeFrontier raises domain-shift concerns. No statistical significance or multi-seed reporting. No stated code/dataset release despite heavy human annotation and commercial Gemini annotation dependency, limiting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection

radar.summary: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that mo
radar.summary_zh: 生成模型快速進步使AI生成影像（AIGI）日益逼真，可解釋偵測器因此重要。然而現有以MLLM為基礎的方法常產生「推測性論述」：依賴模糊或幻覺式的瑕疵描述、無法檢視新近生成器的細微局部缺陷，也提不出可目視驗證的證據。本文提出Defake-o3，結合互動式視覺搜尋與驗證器引導的證據對齊：模型反覆放大可疑區域檢查細節，並以依人類驗證標註訓練的Evidence Verifier作為GRPO強化學習的獎勵，獎勵有依據的證據、懲罰無根據的主張。作者建構GroundFake訓練資料集（16,000張影像，含經人工驗證的邊界框證據與有效／無效證據標籤），以及由10個新近生成器輸出組成的FakeFrontier分布外基準與MLLM評測協定。結果顯示Defake-o3在GroundFake達0.992準確率並取得最高BLEU與IoU，在FakeFrontier與三個外部OoD基準均居首，其證據在品質與說服力指標上超越所有基線。限制在於多輪互動使推理吞吐量低於單次推理基線，且證據品質依賴標註與驗證器訓練。此方法讓偵測結論從「看似合理」進步到「可被驗證」，提升高風險場域的可信度。
radar.title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection
radar.title_zh: Defake-o3：從推測性論述到可驗證證據的可解釋AIGI影像偵測

links.title: DSPrompt: Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense Against M-RAG Corruption

evidence: Experiments > Main Results (Table 1): DSPrompt reduces PRR@1 from 82.30% to 6.71% and ASR from 81.15% to 6.66% on PE-C/Places365 with SUF@3 98.84% and TF 93.18%; on unseen attacks it cuts Clean-L ASR from 60% to 12% and GPA ASR to 0.64%.

Experiments > Experimental Setup > Baselines & Metrics: comparisons include only 'No Defense (raw CLIP retriever)' and RoCLIP; IRAG is described in Related Work as a concurrent defense but is not evaluated.

Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense > Defense Loss Functions and Dynamic Min-Max Training (Eqns 6-9): composite objective of q->d InfoNCE, symmetric loss, and clean-anchor regularization trained against an online PGD poison generator (epsilon=0.05, 20 PGD steps).

Experiments > Ablation (Table 4): insertion-depth and token-allocation ablations show the S->D (1/2/4) schedule beats uniform (2/2/2) and reversed (4/2/1), supporting the Eqn. 5 design; deep-only prompting lowers SUF (97.27%).

Implementation Details: OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 primary with SigLIP-SO400M validation, LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B and Qwen-VL generators, training on 5,000 M-BEIR (Oven task 8) queries; no code release, seeds, or significance testing stated.

Appendix C (Attack and Dataset Setting): evaluation uses original attack protocols, including an enhanced PE-C objective (Eqn. 15, beta=0.4) explicitly designed to bypass RoCLIP, and Table 2 reports 1.85x per-query runtime versus 3.08x for RoCLIP.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-RAG security paper squarely aligned with the RAG & Knowledge, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences, with secondary match to Prompting (soft prompt tuning), Multimodal (LVLM/CLIP stack), and partial LLM relevance (LLaVA/Qwen-VL generators, LLM-crafted poisons), though it is not core LLM-methodology work. Novelty is moderate: VPT-style prompt insertion, InfoNCE, PGD, and adversarial min-max training are established; the contribution is their combination for retrieval-poisoning defense plus a shallow-to-deep length schedule. Rigor is solid but limited: only two baselines (No Defense, RoCLIP), the concurrent defense IRAG is discussed but not compared, and Task Fidelity is measured against the undefended system's answers rather than ground-truth accuracy. Evidence is strong quantitatively (Table 1 PRR/ASR/SUF/TF across four benchmarks, Table 3 poison-density robustness, Table 4 ablations, Figure 4 retriever×generator grid) with mechanism analysis in Figure 3. Generalizability is decent (two retrievers, two LVLMs, unseen attack families GPA/Clean-L), but scope is confined to multimodal RAG with no text-only validation. Reproducibility is middling: detailed hyperparameters, attack budgets, and prompt templates in appendices, but no code release or seed reporting.

primary_link.title: DSPrompt: Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense Against M-RAG Corruption

radar.summary: Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation (M-RAG) is increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks where malicious data are crafted to produce embeddings that align with benign entries in the vector space, deceiving retrieval and inducing harmful outputs. Existing defenses primarily operate at query time, relying on auxiliary detectors, similarity re-ranking, or feature-consistency checks. However, these approaches suffer from non-trivial inference overhead, generalize poorly to unseen attack s
radar.summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成（M-RAG）易受對抗性污染攻擊：攻擊者注入經嵌入最佳化的惡意圖文對，使其在向量空間逼近合法條目、劫持檢索並誘導有害輸出。現有防禦多在查詢時以輔助偵測器或一致性檢查過濾，成本高且難泛化到未見攻擊。本文提出DSPrompt，直接重塑檢索器的嵌入語意而不改動檢索流程：在凍結的視覺與文字編碼器各層插入少量可學習軟提示，採「由淺至深」的長度排程，並以動態min-max訓練——線上攻擊者持續以PGD產生困難毒化文件，防禦者則將其推出top-k，並以乾淨錨定損失保留良性檢索品質。新增參數低於1%，文件可如一般稠密檢索預先編碼索引。在四個基準與三種攻擊家族上，DSPrompt將PRR@1壓至個位數，攻擊成功率由81.15%降至6.66%，效用保留近無損；對未見過的GPA與Clean-L攻擊亦有效。消融確認深層提示與淺到深配置最為關鍵。限制為每查詢約1.85倍的執行時間，且在GPA情境的效用指標略遜於RoCLIP。此研究證明在檢索器層級即可達成不依賴偵測器的可泛化防禦，對M-RAG系統安全具重要意義。
radar.title: DSPrompt: Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense Against M-RAG Corruption
radar.title_zh: DSPrompt：對抗M-RAG污染的動態軟提示防禦

Open Items item 1: repository material 'currently exists only in the authors' working repository and has not yet been published under a public, citable location'

Section 6.2: threat model framing activation-level transfer as removing human-readable oversight, citing encoded-CoT and steganographic collusion literature; scoped as 'proof-of-concept vulnerability'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Pure LLM-methodology paper squarely on-preference: cross-architecture activation transfer between open-weight LLMs (Qwen2, Phi-3, Mistral, FLAN-T5), with interpretability-style alignment metrics (CKA, Procrustes, mutual k-NN) and an AI-safety threat model on unmonitorable inter-model channels. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the end-to-end causal injection test with pre-registered criteria is a fresh combination, though representation-alignment (Platonic hypothesis) and activation-patching literatures are adjacent and some 2025 cross-model embedding-translation work is uncited. Rigor has genuine strengths (negative controls, random-init nulls, FDR correction, McNemar paired tests, honest null reporting) but is diluted by self-reported rather than externally registered pre-registration, a post-hoc switch to mutual k-NN after CKA/Procrustes showed an inverted trained-vs-untrained pattern (admitted in Sec. 6.1), and null baselines computable for only one model pair. Evidence is honestly scoped: the single positive causal result (Qwen2→Phi-3, 23.3% vs 0.0%, p=0.047 FDR-corrected) rests on n=30 trials with a wide CI, and both Mistral-targeted pairs are nulls; the paper itself calls the signal 'modest'. Generalizability is limited by 0.5B–7B scale, 4-bit quantization, and the architecture-dependence finding itself. Reproducibility is hampered because code/data reportedly exist only in a private working repository (Open Items), despite open-weight models and detailed method description. Overall a carefully scoped, honest but small-sample proof-of-concept.

primary_link.title: Architecture-Dependent Causal Transfer of Activation States Across Large Language Models

radar.summary: Direct communication between AI systems relies on natural language as an intermediate layer, incurring encoding/decoding overhead, token cost, and latency. We ask whether internal activation states can instead be transferred causally between different large language model (LLM) architectures via a learned projection, evaluated at three levels: representational similarity, cross-model retrieval from projected states, and end-to-end causal transfer via activation injection during generation. Using
radar.summary_zh: 目前AI系統間溝通依賴自然語言作為中介，產生編解碼成本與延遲。本文探問不同架構的大型語言模型之間，能否以學得的投影直接因果式轉移內部激活狀態，並以預註冊準則分三層檢驗：表徵相似性、投影後的跨模型檢索，以及生成時注入激活的端到端因果轉移。實驗使用Qwen2-0.5B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B與FLAN-T5-base四個模型。結果顯示訓練後模型的表徵對齊優於隨機初始化基線，且以排序為基礎的mutual k-NN指標比CKA與Procrustes更能抵抗大幅值離群值；投影網路對三組causal decoder-only模型對以45–50%的top-1準確率檢索出正確目標表徵（機率基準5%），但對雙向編碼器FLAN-T5僅達機率水準。端到端因果轉移卻只在Qwen2→Phi-3-mini一組顯著（23.3%對對照組0.0%，FDR校正後p=0.047），兩組以Mistral為目標的模型對皆無效果。作者強調這是表徵「載體」而非意義的轉移，並指出隱藏層對齊無法可靠預測生成層面的因果成功。此結果顯示激活層直連通訊目前受限於架構，同時揭露繞過自然語言審查的監督風險，值得安全研究者關注。

links.title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning

evidence: Abstract: SAUL evaluated on TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE with favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines
Section 3 Eq. (1): unlearning cast as min L_r(θ) subject to L_f(θ) ≥ α with user-specified forget threshold
Section 4.1: projected multiplier λ+ = [λ + μ(α − L_f)]+ gates off forget-side update when constraint satisfied
Table 1 (forget ratio 1%): SAUL HM 72.79 ± 0.54 vs Sharp Min–Max + ALM 67.11 at matched F_ROUGE ≤ 0.03; BLUR HM 71.40 but F_ROUGE 0.28 excluded from strict ranking
Table 3 (WMDP): SAUL MMLU 0.542 ± 0.003 vs BLUR 0.540 ± 0.004 and Sharp Min–Max 0.535 ± 0.002 at near-chance WMDP accuracy
Table 4 + Appendix B.1: MUSE-Books results from a single run due to 7B evaluation cost; SAUL PrivLeak −16.66 vs BLUR −30.77
Section 5.2 Ablation: SAUL w/o ALM HM 57.32 and w/o SAM HM 66.01 vs full SAUL 72.79 on TOFU 1%
Appendix B.4: GPT-5.1 used as sole entailment judge with fixed prompt; no human validation of the judge reported
Section 7 Limitations: optimal threshold α may depend on dataset, model scale, forget ratio, and metric; no formal guarantees against relearning or recovery attacks
Appendix E Tables 24–25: SAUL runtime 267s vs Dual-AdamW 164s; peak memory 86.5 GB vs 81.8 GB on LLaMA-3.2-3B TOFU 10%
Appendix B.2 Tables 6–11: full hyperparameter grids and final configurations reported for all benchmarks, but no code release statement appears in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on machine unlearning with strong safety relevance (WMDP hazardous knowledge, MUSE privacy leakage, TOFU fictitious author removal). The forget-side constrained formulation with an augmented-Lagrangian controller that adaptively deactivates forget pressure (Section 3 Eq. 1, Section 4.1) is a genuine but incremental twist: ALM, SAM, and dual optimizers are each established, and prior constrained methods (PDU) already use primal-dual control on the retain side. Rigor is solid: matched-forgetting criteria, ablations (w/o ALM, w/o SAM), 5 seeds on TOFU/WMDP, hyperparameter grids, and a margin-based certified instantiation (Appendix F). Evidence is weakened by single-run MUSE-Books results (B.1), an unvalidated GPT-5.1 entailment judge (B.4), WMDP gains over BLUR within noise (0.542 vs 0.540), and baseline tuning that leaves BLUR/PDU outside the matched-forgetting regime at 1%. Threshold α selection remains manual and dataset-dependent per the limitations section. No code release is stated, though hyperparameter tables, Algorithm 1, prompts, and hardware details support reproduction.

primary_link.title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning

radar.summary: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically s
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的機器遺忘面臨「刪除目標知識」與「保留通用效用」的兩難；既有方法多以加權目標隱含設定遺忘程度，權重對資料、模型與遺忘比例敏感。本文提出SAUL，將遺忘形式化為約束最佳化：在遺忘損失不小於門檻α的約束下最小化保留損失，遵循「遺忘夠用、不多不少」原則。核心是增廣拉格朗日控制器，依違反程度自適應調整遺忘側壓力，一旦準則持續滿足，乘數可降至零而關閉遺忘更新；並輔以對保留與遺忘兩側的銳度感知更新，及維持角色分離狀態的雙最佳化器以穩定訓練動態。在TOFU、WMDP與MUSE三個基準上，於匹配遺忘水準下SAUL取得較佳的遺忘—效用權衡：TOFU 1%遺忘比例取得最高調和平均72.79；MUSE Books上PrivLeak（−16.66）較BLUR（−30.77）更接近重訓參考。此外，將ALM控制器作為即插即用修飾套用到Sharp Min–Max等基線，可一致提升遺忘後效用。限制包括門檻α需依資料與模型調校、缺乏對對抗式提示與再學習攻擊的正式保證，且SAM帶來額外運算。此工作凸顯「明確遺忘控制」對實務部署的價值。
radar.title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning
radar.title_zh: SAUL：銳度感知增廣拉格朗日機器遺忘

links.title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: claims 'average Recall@1 gain of 6.70 percentage points across retrieval settings' and code availability at github.com/MatZaharia/Skill2Query.

Section 4.3, Tables 3-4: online expansion results are mixed-to-negative for strong retrievers, e.g., SkillRouter+S2Q online R@1 81.24 vs 82.73 baseline (TheoremQA), 18.42 vs 22.37 (LogicBench), 32.03 vs 35.80 (ToolQA); BM25+S2Q online LogicBench R@1 12.76 vs 15.39 baseline.
Section 4.4, Tables 5-6: Skill2Query training data achieves best R@1/N@1 on all four datasets, e.g., LogicBench R@10 49.34 (+10.79 pp over Few-shot, +7.23 pp over SkillFlow-style).

Appendix D, Table 12: w/o Exec-Verify ablation changes Exec-Pass 42.85 to 42.90 and Func-Coverage 11.32 to 11.27 (<0.1 pp), showing the verification module contributes negligible average-metric effect; w/o SKG drops Exec-Pass to 22.63 and Func-Coverage to 2.41.

Section 4.5, Table 7: end-to-end success rate with SkillRouter (FT) improves over no-skill baseline by 3.48 pp (GPT-5.4), 8.57 pp (DeepSeek-V4-Flash), 3.34 pp (Qwen3.6-Plus) on 747 TheoremQA instances; oracle gaps of 0.14-3.36 pp.

Section 5 Discussion: limitations admit SKG parsing quality is capped by documentation standardization and that applicability to larger repositories, other agent frameworks, and real user queries 'requires further investigation'.
Section 4.1: evaluation on 3,160 instances across TheoremQA/LogicBench/ToolQA/CHAMP with a shared 26,262-skill candidate pool from SRA-Bench; all experiments on 4x RTX 4090.
Appendix A-D: generation uses GPT-4o-mini at temperature 0.3; fine-tuning configs (InfoNCE tau=0.05, listwise CE tau=1.0, AdamW, seed 42) and full prompts are provided, supporting reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agent/LLM-retrieval paper: structure-aware pseudo-query generation (Skill Knowledge Graph + three-stage style/template/parameter filling) for agent skill retrieval, evaluated with LLM backends and end-to-end agent execution. Strong match to Agents & Tool Use, RAG/Knowledge, and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: doc2query/InPars-style pseudo-query generation is established; the intra-skill structure (capability grounding, parameter consistency) angle is a genuine but incremental refinement over SkillFlow-style and tool-retrieval query generation. Rigor is solid in design (4 datasets, 3 retrieval paradigms, generation baselines, ablations, controlled fine-tuning comparisons), but weakened by low absolute Func-Coverage (11.32%), no significance testing, and the w/o Exec-Verify ablation showing <0.1 pp effect, undermining one pipeline component. Evidence strength is mixed: offline augmentation and training-data gains (e.g., LogicBench R@10 +10.79 pp) are well supported, but online query expansion frequently degrades stronger retrievers (SkillRouter+S2Q online below baseline on all four datasets; BM25 online worse on LogicBench), contradicting the abstract's 'consistently improves' framing. Generalizability is limited by dependence on well-standardized SKILL.md documentation, a single SRA-Bench-derived skill pool, and admitted untested transfer to real user queries and other frameworks. Reproducibility is good: code link, full prompts, training hyperparameters, seeds, and hardware specified.

primary_link.title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval

radar.summary: Pseudo-query generation can alleviate the supervision bottleneck for agent skill retrieval, but existing document-level approaches typically leave the rich internal relations among capabilities, parameters, and usage examples implicit. As a result, generated queries may be topically relevant to a skill while lacking capability grounding and parameter consistency, raising the question of whether explicitly exploiting a skill document's internal structure can produce more effective retrieval signa
radar.summary_zh: 當AI代理人需從數千甚至上萬個候選技能中選擇，技能檢索品質直接影響任務成敗；然而高品質查詢—技能標註稀缺，偽查詢生成成為緩解之道，但既有文件層級方法將技能文件當成單一段落，忽略能力、參數與範例間的內部結構，導致生成的查詢雖主題相關卻缺乏能力接地與參數一致性。本文提出Skill2Query：先將技能文件解析為技能知識圖譜（含Skill、Capability、Parameter、Example節點與關係邊），再以三階段流程生成偽查詢——風格模仿器擷取官方範例的表達模式、查詢範本產生器為各項能力產生含參數槽位的範本、參數填入器依型別、範圍與列舉限制實例化並靜態驗證。生成的偽查詢可用於離線索引增補、線上查詢擴增與檢索器訓練。在近3萬技能、四個基準上，Skill2Query生成70萬筆偽查詢，Exec-Pass達42.85%，各檢索設定平均提升Recall@1約6.70個百分點；作為訓練資料亦取得最佳Recall@1與nDCG@1，端到端實驗顯示可提升代理人任務成功率（如DeepSeek-V4-Flash提升8.57個百分點）。限制在於知識圖譜解析品質受文件標準化程度制約，文件不完整時成效退回基線水準。此框架為大規模技能生態提供了可擴充的監督訊號來源。

links.title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards

evidence: Abstract: on the 2,885 internally-unanimous MultiPref items, expert and crowd pools assign different majority labels on 23.6% and opposite winners on 9.2%; both leaderboards remain bit-identical (Kendall τ=1.00, zero of six models displaced).

Section 2 (Pre-registration): committed rule 'kill if τ>0.9 and the CI lower bound >0.9; report the null and stop'; Section 5 reports an initial half-power judge run (−3.2pp, CI [−7.3,+1.2]) that failed its pre-registered bar.
Section 3/Table 1: independent MT-Bench pool contrast (authors vs recruited experts) on 246 cells shows 30.5% majority-label difference and 8.5% winner reversal with τ=1.0000, CI [0.733,1.000].

Section 4/Table 3: measured pool perturbation (SD=2.6pp on pairwise differences) yields displacement probability 0.28 at K=6 (bootstrap-validated at 0.282), 0.86 at K=10, and 0.9997 at K=20; authors state real arenas cluster more tightly, so these are lower bounds.

Section 5/Table 4: three judges (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-4-26B-A4B; two vendors) agree more with the crowd majority by −0.069, −0.052, −0.037 with 95% CIs excluding zero, on 1,383–1,904 order-self-consistent items.

Section 7 (Limitations): both corpora rank only six models, the MT-Bench contrast rests on 246 cells, three judges from two vendors is 'not a claim about judges in general', and code/outputs are only 'released upon acceptance' (Abstract).

Section 5 (controls): order-swap direction reversal of 44.6%/24.5%/23.7% across judges and a JSON-vs-bare-token format change drops judge self-agreement to 47.2% (n=500), with a prefill path recovering 94.6%, localized to scaffolding tokens rather than decoding.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation methodology paper: quantifies how the choice of annotator pool (crowd vs expert) changes per-item preference labels, shows six-model leaderboard invariance (τ=1.00) is a spacing artifact rather than robustness, and measures that three open-weight LLM judges from two vendors track the crowd pool over the expert pool. Highly relevant to LLM, evaluation/benchmark, and alignment-data preferences. Novelty is solid: it executes the exact 'intra-group variability' exploration MultiPref's Limitations deferred and adds a quantitative displacement-probability analysis vs leaderboard size K. Rigor is above average: pre-registered decision rules, tie-breaking sensitivity across five conventions, convention-free primary subset, paired bootstrap, and unusually honest reporting of a failed under-powered judge run and a withdrawn mechanistic explanation. Evidence is direct on the measured corpora, but weakened by only six models per corpus, a 246-cell MT-Bench contrast, three judges total, an extrapolation to K>6 that rests on Gaussian/independence assumptions, and per-item consequences for reward-model training being conjectured rather than measured. Generalizability is explicitly bounded by the authors (not a claim about judges in general; uniform-spacing lower bounds). Reproducibility is supported by detailed inference setup (Q8_0 GGUF, fixed seed/temperature, stratified 2,500-item samples) but all code and per-call outputs are only promised upon acceptance.

primary_link.title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards

radar.summary: Preference benchmarks are built by hiring annotators, and the identity of those annotators is treated as an implementation detail. We measure what that detail buys. On the 2,885 MultiPref items where both pools are internally unanimous, so no tie-breaking convention is consulted at all, expert and crowd annotators assign a different majority label to 23.6% and name the opposite winner on 9.2%; on the 246 comparably unanimous MT-Bench cells, benchmark authors and recruited experts differ on 30.5%
radar.summary_zh: 偏好基準由受僱標註者建構，但標註者群體的身分通常只寫在附錄裡便不再被討論。本文量化這個「實作細節」的代價：在MultiPref中群眾工作者與篩選過的專家兩群標註者皆內部全體一致的2,885個項目上，多數標籤不同的比例為23.6%、命名相反勝者為9.2%；在MT-Bench的246個可比較單元上分別為30.5%與8.5%。然而兩個語料上的六模型排行榜竟完全一致（Kendall τ=1.00）。作者進一步顯示這種不變性極其脆弱：切換標註群體會使各模型勝率偏移（SD=1.9個百分點），同一擾動下十模型排行榜有0.86機率被擾動、二十模型為0.9997，因此觀察到的零位移是排行榜間距的結果，而非聚合程序的穩健性。更重要的是，所有逐項消費標籤的應用都不安全：實測顯示三個LLM評審（含不同供應商）均顯著更貼近群眾多數而非專家多數（−6.9、−5.2、−3.7個百分點），且評審對呈現順序與輸出格式極度敏感。作者建議：報告評審一致性時須揭露定義參考標籤的標註群體、永遠平衡順序、並保留逐標註者標籤。此研究對獎勵模型訓練與LLM評審驗證的測量效度提出根本性提醒。

links.title: What to Remember, What to Reveal: Privacy-Aware Memory for Conversational Agents

evidence: Abstract: SP-Mem decouples memory utility from exact private-value exposure; code and data claimed at https://github.com/Jensassss/SP-Mem
Section 4.1: comparison against Full-context, Zep, Mem0, and MemOS with four backbones (GPT-5.2-Chat, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-14B, DeepSeek-V3.2); GPT-5.2-Chat used for all memory construction

Table 2 / Section 4.2: privacy-entity identification accuracy 0.996, recall 0.992, precision 0.965 — but Appendix C.1.2/Table 8 shows most PII fields are rule-generated with strict format constraints, easing rule-based detection
Appendix E: P-TC/P-PQ use GPT-4.1 pairwise judging with order-swapped double evaluation and inconsistent judgments counted as ties; no human evaluation is reported anywhere in the paper
Section 4.4 / Figure 4: UPU exposure reduced from 16.00% (Full-context) to 0.33% on Preference-only tasks; 1.12% on Privacy-only-denied
Table 6: SP-Mem uses 26–31% of Full-context tokens across backbones, more than Zep/Mem0/MemOS but justified by quality gains
Section 4.6 / Table 7: ablation shows vector+graph beats single-branch variants with win-tie rates above 80% across backbones
Appendix A (Limitations): authors acknowledge fully synthetic profiles/dialogues/queries and that UPU does not cover re-identification, inference attacks, or stronger threat models
Section 4.4 text states 'Table 6 reports PAR precision and recall' but PAR results appear in Table 5 — minor cross-reference error

Section 3: benchmark of 1,000 synthetic profiles, 376 subtasks, and evaluation over 100 users with 2,100 history dialogues and 5,400 queries across finance, medical, education, and mental-support domains
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM-agent memory architecture (SP-Mem) with privacy-aware writing, partitioned storage, and consent-gated retrieval, plus a benchmark evaluating personalization, privacy behavior, and cost. Core idea (sanitize-then-store with authorized hydration) is a sensible but largely compositional combination of known PII sanitization, hybrid vector-graph memory (Mem0/Zep), and access control; the joint privacy+personalization benchmark is the most distinctive contribution. Rigor is moderate: good breadth (4 baselines, 4 backbones, ablations, per-domain tables) but the evaluation is fully synthetic with rule-generated PII following rigid formats (Appendix C.1.2, Table 8), which plausibly inflates the near-perfect rule-based detection accuracy (0.996, Table 2); response quality rests solely on GPT-4.1 LLM-as-judge win-tie rates with no human validation or significance testing; baselines lack any privacy mechanism, making UPU comparisons partly unsurprising. Evidence is detailed within the synthetic testbed but weak for real-world claims, which the authors concede (Appendix A). Code/data release and extensive appendices (algorithms, prompts, taxonomies, strategy mappings) support reproducibility, though closed-source APIs (GPT-5.2-Chat) and a minor cross-reference error (Section 4.4 cites Table 6 for PAR results that are in Table 5) slightly weaken it.

primary_link.title: What to Remember, What to Reveal: Privacy-Aware Memory for Conversational Agents

radar.summary: Long-term memory enables personalized conversational agents to retain user information across sessions. However, existing memory architectures primarily optimize for utility while neglecting the risks of unnecessarily storing and reusing private attributes such as personally identifiable information (PII). Addressing privacy risks in personalized memory is challenging because simply removing sensitive values can undermine system utility. Therefore, privacy protection for memory agents should gov
radar.summary_zh: 長期記憶讓對話代理跨場次保留使用者資訊以提供個人化服務，但既有記憶架構多半只最佳化效用，忽視不必要地儲存與重用個人可識別資訊（PII）的風險；單純刪除敏感值又會損害記憶系統的功能。本文提出SP-Mem，將記憶效用與精確私密值曝露解耦，治理完整生命週期：隱私感知寫入階段以規則策略偵測私密值，並以別名替換、保留尾碼遮罩、數值分桶與LLM泛化等策略消毒；分割式儲存層將可搜尋的消毒記憶與受保護的私密值倉庫分離，並以隱私映射層連結；查詢時期由查詢分析判斷任務是否需要私密資訊，需要時先徵求使用者同意，同意後才透過映射層還原所需精確值。作者並建構首個隱私感知記憶基準（四領域、1,000個使用者設定檔、2,100段歷史對話與5,400個評測查詢），同時評估回應品質、個人化、隱私行為與成本。實驗顯示SP-Mem隱私識別準確率0.996、不必要私密值曝露率降至0.33%–1.21%、授權請求的精確率為1.00，token用量僅為全上下文提示的26–31%，且回應品質與個人化在多數比較中優於Zep、Mem0、MemOS等記憶基線。限制為採合成資料的受控評測，且曝露指標未涵蓋重識別或推論攻擊等更強威脅。此工作確立「記憶代理需治理敏感值全生命週期」的設計原則。

radar.title_zh: 該記住什麼、該透露什麼：對話代理的隱私感知記憶

links.title: SkillEffect: Checked Lowering for Memory-Bounded Agent Tools

evidence: Section 4.2: 'The bounded-lowering arm completes 12 tasks at 64 MiB and all 24 from 128 MiB onward. Its normalized log-cap AUC is 0.950, versus 0.467 for direct execution.'
Section 4.4: 'It accepts all 60 legal configurations and rejects all 500 mutations.'
Section 4.5: 'Onboarding added an independently implemented 216-nonblank-line family checker, a 63-line bounded-VM operator, and a 197-nonblank-line untrusted builder.'
Section 6 Limitations: 'SkillEffect does not automatically verify arbitrary Python programs. Each supported computation requires an audited relation over a closed source grammar.'
Section 4.1 Testbed: 'Model generation runs separately with Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-AWQ or Mistral-7B served on one A800-80GB PCIe GPU.'
Section 4.3: 'The frozen generation pool contains 72 plans. Twenty-five attempts pass the verifier, covering 10 of 24 tasks.'
Section 4.7: fault injection at six lifecycle boundaries across 54 fault cases with no post-publication leakage; concurrency study reports 1.79x goodput at 16 contenders (Figure 3).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agent-systems paper squarely matching the highest-weighted 'Agents & Tool Use' preference (tool dispatch, skills, smolagents harness, capacity leasing) with LLM-generated code as the object being checked (Qwen2.5-14B, Mistral-7B), plus code-analysis and serving-efficiency angles; LLM methodology itself is secondary. Rigor and evidence are strong: preregistered 1,296-cell cap sweep, 3 repeats, mutation testing (500/500 rejected, 60/60 legal accepted, Section 4.4), onboarding and fault-injection studies, honest limitations, and explicit separation of operator-characterization from checked-runtime claims. Novelty is moderate: the proposal-check-execute trust boundary is a new integration, but it composes known ingredients (cgroups, sandbox limits, program rewriting, resource-aware planning). Generalizability is the weak point: only six audited relation plugins over closed source grammars, deterministic local read-only tools only, platform-specific calibration (Section 6), and a small model-plan pool (25 verifier-passing of 72, Section 4.3). No explicit code-release claim, though frozen hashes, pinned images, and detailed appendix protocols aid reproduction.

primary_link.title: SkillEffect: Checked Lowering for Memory-Bounded Agent Tools

radar.summary: Agent Skills can specify procedural and resource obligations for tool use, and language models instantiate them as concrete programs. However, when models turn this guidance into code for existing tool interfaces, even a semantically correct program may load an entire input and exceed the memory available to one tool call. We present SkillEffect, a checked-lowering runtime for computations with a recoverable source relation, an audited bounded implementation, and a registered output postconditio
radar.summary_zh: 語言模型依據 Agent Skills 產生的工具程式，即使語意正確，也可能在單次工具呼叫中載入整份輸入而超出記憶體上限。SkillEffect 提出一套「提案—檢核—執行」信任邊界：在授權執行前，由獨立檢查器依提交程式與不可變輸入重建每個降級方案，確認可回復的源關係、經稽核的有界實作與已註冊的輸出後置條件。每個關係外掛提供源識別器、輸入事實擷取器、有界 IR 建構器、容量界估算與後置條件；共用 runtime 則提供檢核式選擇、有界 VM 執行、原子容量租賃與分段發布。實驗涵蓋六個運算子家族，顯示有界存取大幅降低尖峰記憶體，並在 64–2048 MiB 外部固定上限下提升任務完成率；六個外掛實例化五種執行模式，XLSX 擴充與 Top-k 研究證明新關係可重用同一信任邊界，檢查器接受所有合法設定並拒絕全部 500 個對抗性提案。限制在於僅支援確定性、本機、唯讀工具，每種計算仍需人工稽核專屬外掛，且記憶體界限綁定特定平台清單。此研究把異質記憶體關係轉為可在工具派發時強制執行的實體契約，是記憶體受限 Agent 執行的系統基礎。
radar.title: SkillEffect: Checked Lowering for Memory-Bounded Agent Tools

links.title: SkillWatermark: An Embedded Skill Watermark of Progressive Privacy Inference via Benign Prompts

primary_link.title: SkillWatermark: An Embedded Skill Watermark of Progressive Privacy Inference via Benign Prompts

radar.summary: Skills for large language model (LLM) agents have been widely deployed across diverse application domains. However, we observe that these skills generate specific traffic patterns during execution. In this paper, we design a pipeline that generates specific traffic patterns by inserting carefully designed skill descriptions, which we term skill watermarks, so that a passive network attacker can establish a covert channel to encode private information within observable traffic across multiple con
radar.summary_zh: LLM 代理人的 Skills 在執行時會產生特定流量模式。本文設計一條管線，在原始技能描述中插入精心設計的「浮水印」（提示約束詞），使被動網路攻擊者能建立隱蔽通道，在多輪對話的可觀測流量中編碼私有資訊。當使用者提示觸發浮水印關鍵詞時，技能會調整回應長度、插入網路搜尋或 sleep 等行為，形成可從封包大小、方向與時間區分的編碼；攻擊者只需比對預建字典，即可還原年齡層、查詢領域與目標等屬性。由於這些浮水印是良性結構化語句，不外洩資料也不執行惡意程式碼，現有 LLM 安全稽核工具無法將其判定為風險。作者在 14 個領域量化各浮水印對流量的影響，並將方法套用於公開技能市集的百餘個技能；嵌入三階段浮水印後，解碼成功率達 98.8%，誤報率 8%，且跨模型與跨提示風格皆穩定。限制包括僅適用於可觀測網路流量的情境、無法處理離線部署與並行多工作階段，且端對端還原準確率尚未完整量化。此研究揭示流量模式可成為新型攻擊面，呼籲技能稽核框架納入對模式化流量的檢測維度。
radar.title: SkillWatermark: An Embedded Skill Watermark of Progressive Privacy Inference via Benign Prompts
radar.title_zh: SkillWatermark：以良性提示嵌入技能浮水印實作漸進式隱私推論

links.title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans

evidence: Abstract: 'On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans... The gaze process is not human... low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other.'
Sec. 4 Results: '3 models x 285 scenes x 5 seeds x nine conditions = 38,475 episodes, all completed (Sec. S10)'; TFP@1 0.97/0.97/0.80 versus human 0.49 (Table 1).
Sec. 3 Data: 'a frozen, category-stratified subset of 141 target-present and 144 target-absent scenes (all ten human scanpaths each)'.
Sec. S3.7 and Table S9: 'linear mixed-effects models with crossed random intercepts for scene and rater' with 95% CIs excluding zero for gaze entropy, saccade amplitude, and TFP@1.
Sec. 4.3: 'we do not manipulate architecture directly, so this attribution is by elimination (acuity and spatial prior ruled out) and a causal test imposing serial sampling is left to future work.'
Sec. 4.4: 'Cross-seed and human inter-observer agreement are not identical constructs... so we treat the determinism gap as suggestive.'
Sec. 6 Limitations: search-trained agentic, pointing-native and frontier closed-source models 'are not evaluated'; single prompt; fixation durations human-only.
Main page 1: 'Code available at: https://github.com/kmamine/MODG'; Sec. S12 supplies the full directive prompt; Sec. S1 gives the Geisler-Perry falloff equation with constants.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A behavioral evaluation of three multimodal LLMs (Qwen3.5, GLM-4.6V, Gemma-4) driven fixation-by-fixation through a foveated visual-search loop, showing dissociation between outcome and gaze-process axes. Topic relevance is moderate rather than high: MLLMs, an agentic look/found/absent loop, and model-evaluation methodology connect to LLM, agent, multimodal, and evaluation preferences, but the paper's center of gravity is human vision science (COCO-Search18 scanpaths), not language-model methodology, and it explicitly proposes no new language technique. Novelty is solid: the falsifiable 'matched retinal input should induce matched search' hypothesis and the three-axis (decision/finding/gaze) decomposition with an explicit stopping decision go beyond prior static attention-alignment comparisons. Rigor is unusually strong: 38,475 completed episodes across 3 models x 285 scenes x 5 seeds x 9 conditions (Sec. 4), a one-shot existence-test control (Sec. 4.1), signal-detection d' (Sec. S4), Cliff's delta plus mixed-effects models with crossed scene/rater intercepts and 95% CIs (Sec. S3.7, Table S9), tolerance and temperature robustness checks (Tables S7-S8, Fig. S10), and honest acknowledgment that the single-pass attribution is 'by elimination' (Sec. 4.3) and that cross-seed vs. inter-observer agreement is a construct mismatch treated as suggestive (Sec. 4.4). Evidence for the dissociation is quantitative and well supported (TFP@1 0.97/0.97/0.80 vs 0.49; cross-seed ScanMatch 0.84/0.91/0.71 vs ceiling 0.53). Generalizability is limited: one dataset, one prompt, three general-purpose models, no search-trained agentic or closed frontier models (Sec. 6). Reproducibility is good: code link, full prompt (Sec. S12), renderer equation with constants (Sec. S1), named public checkpoints, and a data-completeness section (Sec. S10).

primary_link.title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans

radar.summary: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated vie
radar.summary_zh: 人類的目標導向視覺搜尋是序列過程：中央窩必須落在候選物上才能確認。本研究檢驗若 MLLM 接收與人類相同的中央窩化（周邊解析度受限）輸入，是否會像人類一樣搜尋。三個通用 MLLM（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、GLM-4.6V-Flash、Gemma-4-E4B）在 COCO-Search18 上被逐步驅動，透過以 Geisler–Perry 敏銳度衰減校準的渲染器，逐注視點觀察場景並回傳 look/found/absent 指令。結果顯示三軸分離：在決策與找到目標兩軸，模型達到或超越人類，首次跳視即命中目標的比率為 0.97/0.97/0.80，遠高於人類的 0.49；但注視過程非人類，三者共享低熵、大振幅、高度自我一致的掃視路徑，跨種子 ScanMatch 相似度 0.84/0.91/0.71，遠超過人與人的一致性上限 0.53。此外，沒有任何退化條件能在維持人類水準成功率的同時重現人類式搜尋；當兩軸看似收斂時，模型其實是無法解析場景而非在搜尋。此分歧與單次通行、非序列架構一致。答案對齊與顯著性指標皆無法偵測此過程軸，因此零樣本 MLLM 適合結果與空間問題，不適合過程與時間層面的問題，注意力對齊分數也不能證明模型像人一樣地看。
radar.title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
radar.title_zh: 結果相符、視線分歧：中央窩化 MLLM 的搜尋行為與人類之比較

links.title: D2-ScaleAgent: Dual-Dimensional Scaling for Long Document Understanding

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'a Verifier agent-driven dynamic routing loop based on the intrinsic difficulty of the query, centered around a continuously updated evidence bank' with retrieval scaling and reasoning scaling
Sec. 4.2, Table 1: D2-ScaleAgent averages 63.7 vs MDocAgent 58.3 with GPT-4o across six benchmarks; best average on all four backbones
Sec. 4.2: 'VQA even outperforms D2-ScaleAgent on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL' under Gemini-3-flash-preview (65.0 vs 63.0; 65.4 vs 64.4), an acknowledged limitation of headline SOTA claims
Sec. 4.3, Table 2: removing the Verifier-driven loop drops MMLongBench-Doc accuracy from 52.0 to 44.1; oracle-evidence upper bound is 54.9
Sec. 4.4, Table 3: per-query cost profiling shows 21.4K tokens / 16.22s on MMLongBench-Doc vs 15.9K tokens / 11.89s on ViDoSeek

Appendix D.1: implementation uses ColQwen2-v1.0 retriever and smolagents framework with GPT-4o/Gemini/Qwen-VL backbones; Appendix D.3 Table 5 and Appendix E provide hyperparameters and full prompt templates
Limitations section: admits 'execution times significantly longer than standard single-pass inference' and unsuitability for latency-constrained deployment
No code, data, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper; Appendix D.2 notes GPT-4o is also the answer-extraction/judge model for several benchmarks
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic multi-modal RAG framework for long-document QA with a Verifier-driven routing loop, evidence-bank working memory, and dual test-time scaling (retrieval breadth vs. reasoning depth). Strong alignment with agent (Sec. 3.4, Alg. 1), RAG (Sec. 3.2), memory, and test-time-scaling preferences, tempered by a document-VQA-specific application. Novelty is moderate: verifier-driven iterative retrieval and multi-agent granularity pipelines exist (Llatrieval, ViDoRAG, MACT are cited as related), so the contribution is a recombination plus a breadth/depth gap taxonomy rather than a new mechanism. Rigor is fair: six benchmarks and four backbones with ablations on three benchmarks (Tables 2, 4) and cost profiling (Table 3), but only three baselines, no significance testing, and LLM-as-judge scoring on ViDoSeek (Appendix D.2). Evidence is consistent but qualified: with Gemini-3-flash-preview, plain full-document VQA beats D2-ScaleAgent on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL (Sec. 4.2), and the oracle gap on MMLongBench-Doc is only 2.9 points (54.9 vs 52.0, Table 2). Generalizability benefits from plug-and-play backbones (Appendix D.1) but is confined to document QA. Reproducibility is middling: hyperparameters (Table 5) and full prompts (Appendix E) are given, but no code or data release is claimed and the core engine is closed-source APIs.

primary_link.title: D2-ScaleAgent: Dual-Dimensional Scaling for Long Document Understanding

radar.summary: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a key technique for visually rich long document understanding. Existing multi-modal RAG methods are progressively advancing toward multi-agent systems: they first retrieve relevant pages based on a query, and then iteratively understand information within those pages. However, these methods typically rely on fixed workflows and lack the ability to dynamically scale computation at test time, often leading to insufficient evidence. To address thi
radar.summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）在視覺豐富的長文件問答上，常因固定工作流程而無法依查詢難度動態調整運算，導致證據不足。D2-ScaleAgent 提出雙維度擴展範式：以持續更新的證據庫（Evidence Bank）作為代理人的動態工作記憶，由 Verifier 代理驅動的動態路由迴圈嚴格檢查證據是否足以支撐答案。當偵測到廣度不足（缺少來源頁面），系統向外擴展，將查詢分解為屬性、平行檢索候選頁面並自適應剪枝；當深度不足（細節理解膚淺），則向內擴展，動態選擇不同粒度與成本的子代理（Global Surveyor、Region Locator、Fine-grained Extractor）萃取證據，直至證據鏈達成邏輯閉合。在 MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL 等六個基準上，D2-ScaleAgent 以 GPT-4o 等模型取得最佳平均準確率（如 63.7 對 MDocAgent 的 58.3），檢索的 Recall、nDCG 與 MRR 亦全面提升。消融實驗顯示移除 Verifier 驅動迴圈造成最大跌幅（降至 44.1）。主要限制是動態路由帶來的延遲與運算開銷增加，不適合即時或延遲受限的部署場景。此研究將長文件理解從固定流程轉為按需運算路由問題，凸顯證據充分性才是失敗根源。
radar.title: D2-ScaleAgent: Dual-Dimensional Scaling for Long Document Understanding
radar.title_zh: D2-ScaleAgent：以雙維度擴展實現長文件理解

links.title: Walk Before You Run: The Importance of Data Exploration for Data Analysis Agents

evidence: Section 5.1: evaluates Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, and GPT agent mode on one real Vitamin D workbook plus 12 selected DSBench tasks split 4 simple / 5 middle / 3 difficult

Section 4.3: specifies weighted alignment scores (s_T weights 0.42/0.10/0.08, retention thresholds s_T≥0.58 and s_C≥0.55, LLM-judged summary penalty capped at 30%) with no reported validation of the evaluator against human judgment

Section 6.2: downstream gains are small-N case studies — GPT 15/20→16/20→17/20 on the financial task, Claude 6/9→7/9→9/9 on depot allocation, and a counterexample where Gemini falls from 9/9 (Middle) to 7/9 (Treatment)
Section 5.1: 'The subset targets this setting rather than representing the full DSBench' — explicit acknowledgment of narrow empirical scope
Contributions section: 'we release the code, prompts, schema template, evaluation pipeline, and benchmark assets at https://github.com/coconut0621/walk-before-you-run'
Section 6.1: Treatment oracle artifact 'contains only pre-analysis metadata, not downstream answers' — guards against answer-leakage in the intervention design
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent benchmarking paper: makes 'Data Exploration' (dataset/schema understanding before downstream execution) an explicit, scorable stage for LLM data-analysis agents, which aligns strongly with the LLM (2.5) and Agents & Tool Use (2.5) preferences; not a pure domain-application paper despite the Vitamin D data source. Novelty is moderate: evaluating dataset understanding separately from task success, with a schema-fixed JSON artifact and provenance/profiling components, is a fresh framing for data-analysis agents, though adjacent to existing spreadsheet/table-understanding benchmarks. Rigor is limited by tiny evaluation scope (one real workbook, 12 hand-selected DSBench tasks), an unvalidated automatic matching metric with hand-tuned weights/thresholds (Section 4.3), LLM-judged summary quality, no significance testing or repeats, and results presented mostly as figures rather than numeric tables. Evidence is directional and supported by concrete case-study numbers (GPT 15/20→17/20, Claude 6/9→9/9, and an honest Gemini 9/9→7/9 treatment counterexample in Section 6.2), but aggregate claims rest on small N and hedged language ('often improves'). Generalizability is constrained: the authors admit the DSBench subset 'targets this setting rather than representing the full DSBench' (Section 5.1), and the real workbook is a single-domain instance. Reproducibility benefits from an explicit code/prompt/evaluator/benchmark release (Contributions section), tempered by reliance on proprietary frontier models and unclear availability of the human-subject Vitamin D data.

primary_link.title: Walk Before You Run: The Importance of Data Exploration for Data Analysis Agents

radar.summary: LLM-based data-analysis tools are increasingly used to help users analyze messy spreadsheets and workbooks, from answering questions over uploaded files to generating code, summaries, and visualizations. These systems are often evaluated by the correctness of their final downstream answers. However, reliable data analysis also depends on an earlier step: understanding what the dataset contains before solving the requested task. For complex workbooks, this Data Exploration step includes identifyi
radar.summary_zh: LLM 資料分析工具通常只以最終答案的正確性評估，忽略可靠分析前的關鍵步驟：理解資料集內容。本文將「資料探索」——辨識實體工作表背後的邏輯資料表、解讀欄位語意、還原鍵值與關係、偵測品質問題——列為一級評估目標。作者設計兩個基準：一個基於真實維他命 D 研究的多工作表活頁簿，以及為 12 個 DSBench 任務擴充 schema 固定的資料探索構件與標註。系統須產生結構化 JSON 構件，記錄邏輯資料表、欄位、語意角色、關係、剖析訊號與來源出處，並由自動管線評分。測試 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.6、GPT 5.4 等模型顯示，即使能讀取試算表內容，強大模型在邏輯綱要還原、隱含實體辨識與關係推論上仍有持續性缺口。下游實驗比較控制、中介（系統自行產生探索構件）與治療（提供黃金構件）三種條件，證明更強的資料探索支援常能提升下游正確性，但模型須主動使用並重新 grounding 該構件才有效。限制是資料集多樣性有限。此研究主張資料探索應成為可檢查的獨立階段，也是領域專家介入修正的自然人機協作檢查點。
radar.title: Walk Before You Run: The Importance of Data Exploration for Data Analysis Agents
